projects.name: Nexara Tower
description: Nexara Tower by 7th Key redefines modern residential living in Dubai's dynamic Jumeirah Village Circle. Designed with minimalist elegance and functional excellence, each home offers a lifestyle where contemporary design meets comfort. Every corner has been thoughtfully crafted to create spaces that feel calm, refined, and exceptionally livable.

This development stands out for its clean lines, abundant natural light, and seamless integration of indoor and outdoor spaces. More than just a residence, Nexara Tower is an investment in a lifestyle that grows with you, providing long-term value and comfort for discerning buyers.

projects.name: Havelock Residences
description: There's a lot of excitement surrounding the upcoming opening of Havelock Residences, AA & HMB Real Estate Development's ambitious residential project located in the lively Discovery Gardens. This development, which is expected to be finished in the last quarter of 2026, promises an enticing fusion of modern elegance and convenience, making it a sought-after location for modern living in Dubai.

Located in Dubai's Jebel Ali District's thriving Al Furjan neighborhood, Havelock Residences boasts a prime position that guarantees peace and connectivity. This vibrant neighborhood is well-known for its easy access to other areas of the city and family-friendly atmosphere. Havelock Residences' proximity to important monuments and transit hubs adds to its allure and provides inhabitants with an unparalleled quality of life.

projects.name: Aark Terraces
description: Designed to deliver a harmonious lifestyle, it combines architectural innovation, modern comfort, and serene surroundings. Featuring 131 elegantly appointed one and two-bedroom apartments—some with private pools—Aark Terraces is tailored for those who value luxury, tranquility, and community living.

Aark Terraces enjoys a strategic setting within the Dubai Land Residence Complex, offering effortless access to key destinations while preserving a peaceful environment. Its connectivity and proximity to major landmarks make it ideal for families and professionals seeking convenience without compromise.

projects.name: AB Cleo

Designed for those who value thoughtful architecture, functional living spaces, and a well-connected lifestyle, AB Cleo brings together a curated collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments that blend clean aesthetics with everyday practicality.

Jebel Ali Hills is one of Dubai's emerging residential communities, quietly establishing itself as a sought-after address for those who prefer space, serenity, and strategic positioning within the city. Unlike the more saturated pockets of Dubai, Jebel Ali offers room to breathe — with wide roads, planned infrastructure, and a growing network of amenities that continue to attract residents and developers alike.

projects.name: Bayview Boulevard By AB

Located on Dubai Islands, this modern project boasts breathtaking views of both the Arabian Gulf and Dubai's dynamic skyline. Bayview Boulevard By AB is strategically located on Dubai Islands, one of the most sought-after waterfront destinations in the region. This location ensures residents have easy access to major attractions and essential amenities.

projects.name: Kempinski Marina Residences
description: Kempinski Marina Residences, developed by ABA Group, is a new premium residential property located in the heart of the Dubai Marina. This great location provides quick access to key areas of Dubai, including historic monuments. The development's optimal location allows you to easily explore the neighboring neighborhood and the larger Dubai area.
These amenities guarantee that residents have plenty to keep them occupied, even on weekends, giving it the ideal balance of comfort and convenience.

projects.name: Celia Homes
description: Celia Homes by Abou Eid Real Estate Development brings modern premium living to the vibrant Dubailand Residence Complex. This 14-storey residential tower offers more than just apartments—it presents a lifestyle that combines contemporary design with functional comfort. Perfectly suited for residents who value both convenience and quality, Celia Homes redefines urban living in one of Dubai’s most promising communities.

With starting prices from AED 670,000 and flexible payment plans extending beyond handover, this development caters to both end-users and investors. Currently under construction, with completion scheduled for September 2028, Celia Homes features thoughtfully designed studios and 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, each planned to optimize space while delivering premium comfort.

projects.name: Aryam Tower
description: Aryam Tower is a premium residential development by Abu Al Naga Development, rising 18 storeys above the vibrant community of Al Furjan in Dubai's Jebel Ali District. Comprising a basement level, ground floor with retail spaces, two podium levels, 16 residential floors, and a rooftop, this thoughtfully designed tower brings together contemporary architecture and heritage-inspired detailing to create homes that feel both refined and genuinely…

Situated within the Jebel Ali District, the area has grown significantly over the past decade into a well-established destination for families and professionals alike.

projects.name: Altair 52
description: Altair 52 is a premier residential community in Dubai South, designed to combine modern architecture, comfort, and cutting-edge amenities. This thoughtfully planned development redefines family living with its mix of stylish homes, premium facilities, and strategic location in Dubai South (Dubai World Central).

With units ranging from studios to spacious 3-bedroom apartments, Altair 52 caters to diverse lifestyle needs while maintaining exceptional quality throughout. Every home blends smart technology with wellness-focused design, creating spaces where residents can thrive personally and professionally.

projects.name: Avior By Acube

Developed by Acube Developers, this iconic project provides easy access to key locations in Dubai while ensuring a lifestyle of comfort, elegance, and convenience.
Avior By Acube is strategically situated on Sheikh Zayed Road, one of Dubai’s most prestigious and well-connected areas.

projects.name: Electra
description: Electra by ACube is an upscale residential project located in the prestigious Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) area of Dubai. Offering a fusion of contemporary design and luxurious living, Electra caters to those seeking a sophisticated urban lifestyle in one of Dubai's most sought-after neighborhoods.

The project boasts a range of meticulously crafted luxury apartments designed to provide residents with the utmost comfort and style. From spacious one-bedroom units to expansive penthouses, Acube Electra shows a variety of layouts to suit different preferences and lifestyles.

projects.name: Gloas
description: Gloas by Acube brings a modern residential address to Dubai Islands, developed by Acube Real Estate Development. The eight-storey building is planned for buyers looking for a coastal lifestyle with easy access to beaches, marina facilities and the wider city. The residence is designed around premium living, with smart home technology, Italian kitchen cabinetry and high-end Bosch appliances adding comfort to everyday life.

The architecture combines contemporary design with practical living spaces. Apartments come with designer finishes, premium Roca sanitary ware and porcelain or ceramic tiling. Fully-furnished options are also available, giving buyers a ready-to-use home. Vastu-compliant planning is another distinctive feature of Acube’s residential approach, making the development appealing to buyers who value both traditional principles and modern design.

projects.name: Rigel
description: Rigel by Acube is a contemporary residential development in Me’Aisem First, Dubai Production City. The development includes a 12-storey residential building offering one and two bedroom apartments. The apartments are conceived for comfort and practicality. 1 bedroom homes are perfect for singles, couples and investors. The 2 bedroom apartments are suitable for families and buyers that need more space.

The development has facilities for fitness, leisure and relaxation. Residents have a swimming pool, gym and sports areas. More chances for social and recreational time in outdoor spaces. The project has useful features for the comfort of everyday life. They include underground parking, high speed elevators, central air conditioning and security systems. These features make every day of living easier and convenient.

projects.name: Vega Residence
description: Acube Developers' Vega Residence is the height of luxurious living in Dubai Sports City. This upscale residential development is the perfect option for modern urban living because it boasts state-of-the-art amenities, modern architecture, and a prime location.
Its location within Dubai Sports City enhances the accessibility to sporting facilities, educational institutions, healthcare centers, and retail outlets, ensuring a lifestyle of ease and comfort.

projects.name: Zeta
description: Zeta by Akyoub Real Estate Development presents an integrated concept of upscale urban living in the heart of Liwan, Dubai. The project is designed to meet the needs of residents seeking a balanced combination of comfort, elegance, and practicality, offering fully furnished residential apartments with contemporary designs reflected in every detail.

Zeta is located in Liwan, Dubai, one of the promising residential communities experiencing rapid urban growth. The area benefits from a developed network of major roads connecting it to Dubai’s economic and entertainment destinations, making it an appealing location for both family living and real estate investment.

Arthouse Hills is more than just a residential development—it's a curated lifestyle experience where every detail has been thoughtfully designed to elevate everyday living. From striking architectural elements to wellness-focused amenities, this project caters to collectors, creatives, and individuals who view their home as an extension of their identity and artistic sensibilities.

projects.name: AG Central

projects.name: AUM Residence

projects.name: Whitecliffs Residences

For those seeking convenience and peace of mind, the property offers a refined lifestyle with its world-class amenities, riverfront location, and elegant design. Whitecliffs Residences has options for everyone, whether you're searching for a secluded haven or a house that's suitable for a family.

projects.name: The Cliffs
description: The Cliffs is a premier luxury residential development by AGI Palace Group, located along the iconic Dubai Water Canal. The project offers a sophisticated blend of modern architecture, expansive living spaces, and exceptional amenities, providing a truly unparalleled lifestyle for residents.

Located in the heart of Dubai Waterfront, The Cliffs offers stunning views of the canal and the city skyline. It is just minutes away from key areas such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah, ensuring easy access to the best the city has to offer.

projects.name: Casa Aura Residence
description: Casa Aura Residence redefines contemporary living, offering an exquisite blend of sophistication, comfort, and urban connectivity. Casa Aura Residence is strategically positioned in Dubai South, an emerging hub for business, aviation, and residential growth. Its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, major highways, and Expo City Dubai ensures seamless connectivity while maintaining a tranquil neighborhood setting.

projects.name: La Vera Creek
description: La Vera Creek is a thoughtfully designed mid-rise residential development by Ahmadyar Developments, offering a genuine sense of community living in one of Dubai's most welcoming suburban neighborhoods — Nadd Al Hammar. The project brings together studios, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments in a setting that balances everyday convenience with a calm, green environment that feels distinctly livable.

Unlike developments that prioritize spectacle over substance, La Vera Creek is built around the simple idea that a home should feel comfortable, grounding, and well-connected. Clean architectural lines, generous interiors, and thoughtfully placed green spaces create a residential experience that genuinely supports day-to-day life — whether you're a young professional, a growing family, or an investor seeking a property with long-term appeal.

projects.name: Vestoria Bay
description: Set on a prime corner plot within Dubai Islands, Vestoria Bay introduces a coastal address shaped by calm surroundings and open water views. The development presents a carefully curated lifestyle where light, space, and setting come together naturally, offering residents a sense of ease from the moment they arrive.
Perfectly designed for everyday comfort, the project features a refined mix of homes that balance contemporary design with the relaxed rhythm of island living.

projects.name: Casa Ahs
description: Casa Ahs by AHS Properties offers an unmatched luxury experience along the iconic Dubai Water Canal in Jumeirah. This prestigious project redefines high-end living with its exclusive 3 to 6-bedroom villas, Sky Mansions, Sky Palaces, and Sky Villas. Combining strategic location, innovative design, and world-class amenities, Casa Ahs sets a new standard for opulent waterfront residences in Dubai.
Its prime location blends tranquility with urban connectivity, offering a seamless lifestyle.

projects.name: Grand Glow

projects.name: White Opals
description: White Opals by AIZN Developers represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential design in Dubai's prestigious Mohammed Bin Rashid City. This exceptional 6-storey development in District 11 offers a sophisticated blend of urban convenience and serene living, creating an unparalleled residential experience for discerning homeowners.

Strategically positioned in MBR City's District 11, White Opals enjoys one of Dubai's most coveted addresses. Mohammed Bin Rashid City represents Dubai's vision of sustainable urban development, offering residents access to world-class amenities while maintaining a peaceful, community-focused environment.

projects.name: Lumiere Heights
description: Lumiere Heights, developed by AJG Jaddaf Real Estate Development, is a modern residential tower in Dubai Culture Village, Al Jaddaf. Rising 10 stories, it blends contemporary design with cultural influences, offering premium living spaces with stunning views of Dubai Creek and the Wildlife Sanctuary.
Lumiere Heights offers modern residences with open-plan layouts, high-end finishes, and smart home technology, catering to various lifestyle needs.

projects.name: Rove Home
description: Located within the prestigious waterfront community of MBR City, Rove Home Meydan Horizon offers a premium residential retreat where modern urban design meets serene waterfront living. Developed by Al Ain Holding, this branded residential complex combines the signature hospitality style of Rove Hotels with the privacy and comfort of turnkey luxury apartments.

With prices starting from AED 1617777, this development presents a unique opportunity for homeowners and investors seeking fully furnished, move-in-ready apartments in Dubai’s thriving Meydan district.

projects.name: Bottega 33 Residences
description: Tucked within the growing neighborhood of Majan in Dubailand, Bottega 33 Residences brings together Italian design elegance and Dubai’s contemporary residential style. The project reflects a refined vision where thoughtful architecture, modern interiors, and everyday comfort come together in one distinctive address.

This development is the second project launched under the Bottega brand, created through a collaboration between Arete Developments and Al Andalusia Group. With delivery expected in December 2027, the project introduces a new residential option in one of Dubai’s rapidly expanding communities.

projects.name: Bottega Nove
description: Bottega Nove, developed by Al Andalusia Group, is a premium mid-rise residential address set within Majan, Dubailand. Rising across nine thoughtfully designed floors, the project blends modern architecture with sustainable principles, creating a polished urban lifestyle that feels both calm and contemporary.

At the heart of the design is a balance between clean aesthetics and everyday comfort, where light-filled interiors and refined finishes come together effortlessly. Every detail has been carefully considered to suit modern city life without feeling overstated.

projects.name: Nova Tower
description: Nova Tower stands as a testament to contemporary luxury living in the heart of Dubai Science Park, representing Al Ansari Properties' commitment to creating exceptional residential experiences. This sophisticated development seamlessly blends modern architectural excellence with thoughtful design, offering discerning residents a lifestyle characterized by comfort, elegance, and urban convenience.

The development embodies a perfect harmony between metropolitan sophistication and residential tranquility, creating a sanctuary where residents can enjoy the best of both worlds. With its strategic positioning and carefully curated amenities, Nova Tower is set to become one of Dubai's most sought-after residential addresses when it reaches completion in September 2026.

projects.name: Altissima
description: Altissima is the crowning achievement of Al Barari Dubai, the visionary developer behind the entire Al Barari community. This exclusive development offers only 23 standalone 7-bedroom villas, each meticulously crafted and spanning four luxurious floors. Surrounded by lush greenery, Altissima combines opulence, sustainability, and comfort, promising an unparalleled living experience.

Altissima is located in the prestigious, eco-conscious gated community of Al Barari, renowned as the region's first integrated luxury eco-friendly development. Residents can enjoy a sustainable lifestyle without compromising on luxury.

projects.name: The Cape
description: Nestled within Dubai's most coveted nature-rich enclave, The Cape by Al Barari represents the pinnacle of sustainable luxury living. This exceptional residential development offers an exclusive collection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and duplexes, masterfully designed to harmonize contemporary elegance with the tranquil beauty of Al Barari's lush landscapes.

Set for completion in December 2028, The Cape continues Al Barari's legendary tradition of transforming pristine desert into verdant sanctuaries, offering residents an unparalleled lifestyle where luxury seamlessly blends with nature's embrace.

projects.name: The Lofts Al Barari
description: The Lofts Al Barari, a shining example of upscale urban living tastefully merged with nature, is tucked away in the lush oasis of Al Barari, one of Dubai's most upscale and ecologically aware neighborhoods. Redefining luxury residential standards in the United Arab Emirates is the goal of this ambitious new project, created by the well-known Al Barari Development Company.

The Lofts Al Barari, which are part of the famed Seventh Heaven tower, are the culmination of years of creative design and environmentally conscious building processes, giving residents a one-of-a-kind opportunity to live at the pinnacle of luxury.

projects.name: Tessera
description: Tessera is a residential development that quietly redefines what modern urban living can feel like. Developed by Al Ghurair Development and designed by the renowned Portuguese architect Manuel Aires Mateus — marking his first residential project in the UAE — Tessera introduces a low-density building concept that delivers the privacy, space, and ease typically associated with townhouse communities.

Dubai South is one of the emirate's most strategically positioned and rapidly evolving urban destinations. Spanning 145 square kilometres, it was conceived as a self-contained city and is home to the Al Maktoum International Airport — set to become one of the world's largest aviation hubs.

projects.name: The Weave
description: The Weave by Al Ghurair brings a fresh architectural voice to Jumeirah Village Circle, blending regional craft traditions with modern residential design. This development translates the ancient art of palm weaving into an architectural statement, a building that feels culturally rooted and distinctly contemporary in equal measure. Prices start from AED 1,200,000, with handover scheduled for December 2028.

Set in Jumeirah Village Circle, The Weave sits within one of Dubai's most established mid-market residential communities. The neighbourhood is known for its calm atmosphere, circular masterplan, and practical access to key city districts.

projects.name: Habtoor Grand Residences
description: Habtoor Grand Residences is an elite residential complex seamlessly integrated within the renowned Al Habtoor Grand Resort Hotel JBR, nestled in the vibrant and sought-after district of Dubai Marina. Developed by Al Habtoor City Real Estate Development LLC, this luxurious project is poised to redefine waterfront living.

The development features a range of exquisitely designed residences, including apartments, townhouses, and penthouses, offering a plethora of options to suit different preferences and family sizes. Each unit is crafted to provide spacious living areas with stunning views of the sea and the surrounding landscape.

projects.name: The Residences Al Habtoor Grand
description: Standing proudly at 253 meters, The Residences Al Habtoor Grand rises over Dubai Marina with a presence that’s impossible to overlook. This 60-floor landmark delivers a refined coastal lifestyle within one of the city’s most sought-after waterfront districts.

The tower features 276 premium homes, including 2-bedroom apartments, spacious 4-bedroom penthouses, and a selection of exclusive townhouses. Each residence ranges from 188 to 740 square meters and comes fully finished with built-in furniture, premium appliances, and dedicated parking. Every home is designed for residents who value privacy, quality, and effortless comfort.

projects.name: Mak I'Sola Bella
description: Mak I'Sola Bella stands as a monument to elegance and modernism in Dubai's vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). projects.name: La Crystal

Developed by Al Nasser Properties LLC, this new project redefines luxury living with modern amenities and elegantly crafted living spaces. Comprising six floors of meticulously designed one- and two-bedroom apartments, each unit boasts high-quality finishes and state-of-the-art facilities.

Located in District 11, MBR City, one of Dubai’s most prestigious and well-planned neighborhoods, The Collection by Naser offers a tranquil yet connected lifestyle. Surrounded by lush greenery, scenic water bodies, and numerous civic amenities, this prime location combines natural beauty with urban convenience, providing residents a peaceful retreat while staying close to Dubai’s main attractions.

projects.name: Butterfly Towers

This vibrant neighborhood has transformed into a thriving community that seamlessly blends professional opportunities with residential comfort. The area's skyline is marked by contemporary architecture, luxury hotels, fine dining establishments, and premium retail outlets.

projects.name: The Chedi Private Residences

description: Zura Residences is a thoughtfully crafted residential development by Alyakka Developers, rising gracefully across Dubai South with a ground-plus-two podium configuration, eleven residential floors, and a rooftop level. The project comprises 321 carefully planned apartments available in studio, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom layouts, offering a diverse selection to meet the needs of individuals, couples, and growing families alike.

What sets Zura Residences apart is its considered approach to urban living each unit reflects a deep understanding of how modern homeowners actually live. The balance between generous proportions, refined finishes, and practical layouts creates homes that are as livable as they are visually compelling. This is not simply a place to reside; it is a community designed with intention, purpose, and a genuine appreciation for quality.

projects.name: Amaal 8
description: Amaal Emirates' Amaal 8 project, located in the dynamic heart of Dubai, is poised to reinvent modern living. This towering 55-story masterpiece promises panoramic vistas and a lifestyle that combines elegance and functionality. Amaal 8 was designed with today's discriminating urbanite in mind, and it features a beautiful blend of contemporary architecture, lush green surroundings, and a variety of modern facilities.

Amaal 8 is conveniently placed in Dubai's main central neighborhood, which is noted for its accessibility and connectivity. Residents will have convenient access to Dubai's corporate districts, world-class shopping complexes, and cultural attractions. This makes Amaal 8 more than just a place to live; it's a portal to everything Dubai has to offer. Amaal 8's 55-story building provides panoramic views of the cityscape, elevating everyday living.

projects.name: Mansory Residences
description: Mansory Residences, also known as Amaal 8 by Mansory, blends automotive excellence with premium urban living in Dubai’s vibrant Meydan Horizon district. This 48-storey tower transforms Mansory’s precision and design philosophy into residential architecture, offering a lifestyle where sophistication, performance, and elegance intersect.

The development presents a range of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, including duplexes and premium units, all meticulously designed to reflect Mansory’s signature attention to detail. With completion scheduled for December 2028, residents can enjoy homes that are as functional as they are striking.

projects.name: Amali Island
description: Amali Island is an extraordinary new development by the Amali company that is set to transform the standard of luxury living in the UAE. Located on The World Islands, this high-end community provides an exclusive lifestyle with private beach access and world-class amenities. The project is scheduled for completion in March 2027, promising residents a prestigious and peaceful environment.

Amali Island goes beyond traditional notions of opulence, providing an unparalleled blend of luxury and tranquillity. With its prime location, unique features, and world-class amenities, Amali's iconic project is poised to redefine upscale living in the UAE. Whether you're looking for a peaceful beachfront retreat or a thriving community hub, Amali Island has the ideal combination of luxury and convenience.

projects.name: Amorino Villas
description: Amorino Villas offers a rare opportunity to experience premium residential living on Amali Island, part of the prestigious World Islands. Designed to blend sophisticated architecture with modern comforts, this development presents an extraordinary sanctuary where privacy, elegance, and waterfront lifestyle converge.

Set for completion in March 2027, each villa embodies meticulous attention to detail, high-quality materials, and cutting-edge technology. Residents enjoy a harmonious combination of contemporary design and timeless elegance, making Amorino Villas one of Dubai's most coveted addresses.

projects.name: Avatea Villas
description: Located within the prestigious World Islands archipelago, Avatea Villas redefines premium residential living in Dubai. Developed by Amali Properties, this exclusive project on Amali Island offers a rare combination of architectural brilliance and serene island tranquility. With only 24 residences, homeowners enjoy unparalleled privacy without compromising access to Dubai’s dynamic city life.

The flagship villa spans an impressive 69,500 sq. ft. of plot area and 33,497 sq. ft. of built-up space, featuring seven bedrooms with sweeping views of Dubai’s iconic skyline. Every residence embodies sophistication and scale, providing a lifestyle that balances elegance with functionality.

projects.name: Zenith Residences
description: Zenith Residences by Amber Developments brings a fresh perspective to modern living in the evolving district of International City. Rising 18 stories above Al Warsan 4, this contemporary development blends smart design with comfortable everyday practicality, offering residents a well-balanced lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most diverse neighborhoods.

The project is composed of a basement, a ground floor, three podium levels, and fourteen residential floors. Every level is shaped to maximize natural light, enhance ventilation, and create a sense of privacy. With prices starting from AED 772,000, Zenith Residences offers an accessible entry into Dubai’s premium property market while maintaining a strong emphasis on quality and thoughtful planning.

projects.name: Living Legends Phase 4
description: Living Legends Phase 4 is a 16-storey residential tower in Dubai's thriving Dubailand district, developed by Amer Alghurair Development. This premium development features 206 thoughtfully designed units, ranging from studios to spacious 4-bedroom apartments, offering a lifestyle that balances contemporary sophistication with family-centered comfort.

Scheduled for completion in March 2027, units start from AED 850,066, making this an attractive choice for end-users seeking a family home as well as investors pursuing quality real estate in a growing community.

projects.name: Derby Heights
description: Derby Heights by AMIS Properties redefines premium urban living, offering a peaceful retreat within Dubai’s dynamic cityscape. Scheduled for completion in October 2027 with prices starting from AED 1.2 million, this development features a carefully curated collection of 1, 1.5, and 2-bedroom apartments designed for modern lifestyles.

Located in Dubai’s prestigious Meydan district, Derby Heights offers a unique blend of exclusivity and accessibility. Meydan is renowned for its green spaces, premium amenities, and proximity to major business districts, making it a highly desirable address.

projects.name: Fleur De Jardin Villas
description: Tucked within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Fleur De Jardin Villas by AMIS Properties presents a refined residential setting designed for families who appreciate privacy, space, and thoughtful architecture. Located in Wadi Al Safa 3, District 11, DubaiLand, the development offers a rare collection of just 25 villas, creating an intimate neighborhood where tranquility takes center stage.

The name “Fleur De Jardin,” meaning Garden Flower in French, reflects the project’s botanical inspiration. Landscaped gardens, themed parks, and greenery surround the residences, bringing a sense of calm that feels worlds away from the fast pace of the city.

projects.name: The Tides By Amis
description: Nestled in the prestigious Dubai Islands, The Tides By Amis represents a revolutionary approach to luxury coastal living. This exceptional residential development by Amis Properties seamlessly blends the tranquil essence of island life with the dynamic energy of Dubai's metropolitan landscape.

The development features an impressive collection of fully furnished 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, complemented by an exclusive selection of 4-bedroom townhouses. Each residence is meticulously crafted to embody the principles of open, calm living, with layouts designed to provide residents the freedom to create their perfect home environment.

projects.name: Woodland Crest
description: Amis Properties' upscale residential community Woodland Crest is well situated on Dubai's bustling Meydan Avenue. With only 50 premium apartments, it combines urban elegance with serene surroundings, offering residents a sophisticated lifestyle that emphasizes wellness, design, and smart living. Each apartment is thoughtfully crafted with modern finishes, smart technologies, and spacious layouts that reflect contemporary comfort.

Woodland Crest offers a limited collection of 1- and 2-bedroom freehold apartments. Each unit is designed for optimal comfort and smart functionality, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, open-plan layouts, and premium European finishes.

projects.name: Woodland Terraces
description: Woodland Terraces by AMIS Properties offers a premium residential lifestyle in Dubai's prestigious Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Combining contemporary architecture with thoughtful design, the development creates a serene and elegant community within Meydan, an area traditionally known for exclusive villas.

The project features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments starting from AED 1,248,302. Each residence includes open-plan kitchens, bright living areas, and private balconies. Completion is scheduled for March 2027, providing a unique opportunity for both investors and homebuyers.

projects.name: Amwaj Residence 3
description: Amwaj Residence 3 is a thoughtfully designed low-rise residential development by Amwaj Developments, rising five storeys within the vibrant Mohammed Bin Rashid City District 11 in Dubai. The building overlooks a serene lagoon, offering residents direct waterfront views combined with contemporary architecture and well-organized community living.

The development is built on the premise that modern living should feel balanced — where clean design meets natural surroundings, and privacy coexists with community. Each residence is finished to a high standard, incorporating spacious floor plans, premium materials, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood interiors with natural light while framing views of the lagoon and landscaped greenery beyond.

projects.name: Gate Eleven Residences
description: Set in the heart of District 11 in Meydan, Gate Eleven Residences brings together modern architectural elegance and a peaceful family environment. Positioned along Al Ain Road, the development features four neighboring buildings designed to capture expansive lagoon views while offering an atmosphere of refined privacy.

The project is under construction, with completion expected in March 2028. Homes start from AED 1,396,317, giving buyers access to thoughtfully planned 1 to 3-bedroom apartments tailored for different lifestyle needs.

projects.name: Kaia Residences
description: Nestled within the prestigious Dubai Islands, Kaia Residences by Amwaj Development represents the pinnacle of contemporary waterfront living. This exceptional residential development seamlessly blends modern architectural excellence with the natural beauty of island life, creating an unparalleled living experience that redefines luxury in Dubai's dynamic real estate landscape.

Kaia Residences offers an inspiring collection of meticulously designed homes, featuring 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive 4-bedroom duplexes. Each residence is thoughtfully crafted to maximize natural light, optimize space utilization, and provide residents with breathtaking sea views that serve as a daily reminder of the tranquil beauty surrounding this remarkable development.

projects.name: Sela Residence
description: Sela Residence is a thoughtfully conceived low-rise residential development by Amwaj Developments, rising gracefully along Meydan Avenue in one of Dubai's most sought-after districts. Designed for those who appreciate refined living without compromise, this project brings together elegant architecture, carefully considered layouts, and a full suite of premium amenities — all within one of the city's most dynamic and fast-growing neighbourhoods.

Every detail at Sela Residence reflects a genuine commitment to quality and comfort. Whether you are searching for a home that matches your lifestyle or looking for a smart addition to your investment portfolio, this development offers something rare in Dubai's crowded residential market: a sense of place, calm, and purpose.

projects.name: The Cube Residences
description: The Cube Residences is a seven-story architectural masterpiece nestled in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. This latest project designed by Amwaj Development and set to redefine luxury urban living is the result of a collaboration between the two renowned companies. Residences that combine sophisticated aesthetics and practical modernity are designed with meticulous care to ensure every aspect of the living experience is enhanced.

The Cube is located in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. This area is renowned for its lush surroundings and extensive water features. This prestigious neighborhood provides residents with unparalleled access to Dubai’s top attractions, busy business hubs and leisure facilities. Residents are at the intersection of luxury and convenience.

projects.name: Elle Residences
description: Elle Residences rises along Dubai Islands as a contemporary waterfront retreat shaped for those who value modern design and relaxed coastal charm. This premium development by Anax Developments blends fresh architectural expression with a setting that places the sea, the city, and everyday conveniences within easy reach.

The collection includes finely planned apartments and townhouses ranging from 1-bedroom homes to expansive 4-bedroom layouts. Every residence is designed with modern families and discerning investors in mind, offering starting prices from AED 2,151,777 and a completion date scheduled for December 2027.

projects.name: Kyomi Residence
description: Kyomi Residence, developed by Anax Developments, is a modern residential project in Dubai International City 2. Designed for contemporary urban living, the development offers studio and one-bedroom apartments with premium amenities and smart home features.

Kyomi Residence is a strong investment, offering a blend of luxury, sustainability, and convenience in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing districts. With modern designs, premium finishes, and high rental demand, it presents a prime opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.

projects.name: V-Suites
description: Situated in the heart of Dubai’s bustling Business Bay, V-Suites offers a refined urban lifestyle for those who value sophistication, comfort, and connectivity. Developed by Anax Developments, this off-plan residential project brings together smart design and premium aesthetics in a collection of studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments.

Every aspect of the tower reflects a commitment to elevated living, blending functional spaces with stylish finishes. Here, residents enjoy more than just a home—they experience a lifestyle designed around convenience, wellness, and urban elegance.

projects.name: Andi Aura
description: Andi Aura is a contemporary residential development by Andi Properties, thoughtfully designed for those who seek quality, comfort, and smart investment in one of Dubai's most promising growth corridors. Positioned within Dubai Silicon Oasis, this project brings together refined architecture, practical amenities, and a location that continues to attract both end-users and forward-thinking investors.

Dubai Silicon Oasis is no longer just a tech hub — it has evolved into a fully integrated urban community with residential appeal that is growing steadily year on year. Backed by significant government investment and ongoing infrastructure upgrades, the area offers a balanced lifestyle that combines the energy of a modern city with the ease of a well-planned community.

projects.name: Nest Residence
description: Nest Residence by ANDI Properties is a contemporary residential development in Dubai, designed to combine modern architecture, smart living and lifestyle-focused amenities. The project offers thoughtfully designed residences with efficient layouts, contemporary interiors and quality finishes, creating comfortable spaces for both end users and property investors.

projects.name: Wellington Ocean
description: ANK Developers' innovative Wellington Ocean project offers the ultimate in opulent island living on the esteemed Dubai Islands. This architectural wonder offers residents a sophisticated, comfortable, and exclusive living by fusing contemporary architecture with unmatched waterfront vistas.
Wellington Ocean is set to offer a variety of residences, including luxurious apartments, penthouses, and possibly townhouses.

projects.name: The Central Downtown
description: Nestled in the heart of Arjan, Dubai, The Central Downtown by Aqua Properties sets the standard for opulent living with its collection of luxury apartments. The complex is comprised of four distinctive towers A, B, C, and D spread across a central plot, creating an expansive living space that boasts both visibility and accessibility within the Arjan community.

The Central Downtown location at the junction of Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Umm Suqeim Street ensures seamless connectivity to major highways, putting key areas like Dubai Motor City, Dubai Sports City, and Jumeirah Village Circle within easy reach for residents.

projects.name: A99
description: A99 is the latest innovative project by Arabian Gulf Properties, set to redefine modern living in the vibrant city of Dubai. Located in the bustling area of Dubai Land, this under construction development promises a unique blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Expected to be completed by Q1 2026, A99 is designed to cater to families and professionals alike.

Dubai Land is one of Dubai's most sought after areas, known for its strategic location and excellent connectivity. Living in Dubai Land means you are close to major business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. The area offers easy access to major highways, making commuting hassle free. Whether you are heading to work, school, or a leisure destination, Dubai Land’s central location ensures everything is within reach.

projects.name: Edison House Phase 2 By Arabian Gulf
description: Edison House 2 by Arabian Gulf Properties is set to become a landmark in Dubailand, Dubai. This 12 storey luxury development offers an unparalleled lifestyle with a plethora of high end amenities. Perfectly blending sophistication and modernity, Edison House Phase 2 By Arabian Gulf caters to those seeking an elite address in Dubai.
Dubailand is one of Dubai’s most coveted areas, known for its excellent connectivity and vibrant community.

projects.name: Neo Place
description: Neo Place stands as a symbol of modern luxury and urban sophistication in the heart of Dubailand. Developed by the renowned Arabian Gulf Properties, this stunning 13-storey structure is designed to offer an unparalleled lifestyle experience, blending elegance with comfort.
Neo Place is scheduled for completion on February 1, 2028, offering residents a chance to move into their luxurious homes in the near future.

projects.name: Telal Al Salam 2
projects.developer: ARABIAN HILLS INVESTMENT AND REAL ESTATE DEVELOPMENT
description: Telal Al Salam 2 stands as a carefully crafted residential development in Dubai, offering families the opportunity to settle into spacious villas designed with contemporary living in mind. Brought to life by Arabian Hills, this community reflects a vision of balanced family life where privacy meets neighborly connection.

The architectural approach prioritizes open layouts that flow naturally from room to room, creating homes that feel both generous and intimate. Large windows invite natural light throughout the day, while outdoor areas extend the living space beyond interior walls.

projects.name: Akala Hotel & Residences
description: Akala Hotel & Residences by ARADA introduces a bold new chapter in luxury living in Dubai. Positioned in the prestigious Zaabeel 2 district, this development blends hotel-style amenities with upscale residential offerings. From contemporary architecture to integrated smart home features, Akala sets a new benchmark for design, comfort, and investment potential.
All units feature smart home systems, spacious bedrooms with en-suites, ample storage, and luxurious materials that reflect a refined living experience.

projects.name: Armani Beach Residences
description: Experience the ultimate in luxury living at Armani Beach Residences Palm Jumeirah, the latest masterpiece by Arada Developer. These exclusive class beach residences are one of a kind residential community that promises to offer a fusion of luxury and serenity unlike anywhere else in the world.

Designed by the legendary Tadao Ando, one of the most renowned architects from Japan, this stunning project features a perfect blend of traditional Japanese design principles and modern minimalist aesthetics. The project resonates visual and experiential continuity between the design and the seascape, resulting in contemporary buildings that harmonize perfectly with the surrounding natural environment.

projects.name: Inaura Hotels & Residences
description: Nestled in the heart of Downtown Dubai, Inaura Hotels & Residences represents the pinnacle of contemporary luxury living, masterfully crafted by renowned developer ARADA. This exceptional development redefines urban sophistication by seamlessly blending branded residences with premium hotel accommodations, creating an unparalleled lifestyle destination that caters to the most discerning residents and guests

Inaura stands as a testament to architectural excellence and thoughtful design, offering a sanctuary of calm luxury amidst the vibrant energy of Dubai's most prestigious district. With its completion scheduled for June 2030, this visionary project promises to deliver a new standard of refined living that harmoniously balances urban connectivity with tranquil retreat-style amenities.

projects.name: W Residences Dubai Harbour By Arada
description: W Residences Dubai Harbour By Arada is an elite luxury development by ARADA located near Dubai Harbour. This premium complex blends magnificence, comfort, and great connectivity to offer a lifestyle of unrivaled luxury and convenience.
Features include a modern design, wide balconies, and high-end finishing.

projects.name: Cresswell Views
description: Cresswell Views by Arady Properties offers a refined approach to contemporary residential living in Dubai South. This exceptional development features a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, designed to harmonize modern architectural elegance with the warmth of community living.

Starting at AED 894,000, with a flexible 40/60 payment plan requiring just 10% down, this freehold project makes premium homeownership accessible to both local and international buyers. Scheduled for completion in December 2026, Cresswell Views presents a rare opportunity for families, professionals, and investors seeking comfort, style, and long-term value.

projects.name: Aras Heights Phase 2 By Aras
description: An exciting new residential project by Aras Development. Located in the heart of Dubai Silicon Oasis, this upcoming development promises to offer luxury, comfort, and convenience. Whether you're looking for a studio, a one-bedroom, or a spacious three-bedroom apartment, Aras Heights II has something for everyone.

Aras Heights II by Aras Development is set to redefine luxury living in Dubai Silicon Oasis. With its prime location, diverse housing options, and top-notch amenities, this upcoming residential project is perfect for anyone looking to invest in a high-quality, modern lifestyle. Keep an eye on this space for more updates and be ready to make Aras Heights II your new home

projects.name: Jamal By Aras
description: Jamal By Aras is a refined residential development by Aras Group, located in one of Dubai's most strategically positioned and culturally rich districts — Al Jaddaf. Designed for those who seek a balance between contemporary comfort and vibrant urban living, Jamal offers a thoughtfully curated collection of apartments ranging from one to five bedrooms.

Al Jaddaf is no longer the city's best-kept secret. Stretching along the banks of Dubai Creek, this fast-evolving district has become one of the most sought-after addresses in the emirate. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai, combined with a quieter, more residential character, gives Al Jaddaf a rare dual identity — connected to the pulse of the city, yet removed enough to offer genuine peace of mind.

projects.name: Joud
description: Joud by Aras is an eight-storey residential building in Al Jaddaf, Dubai, by Aras Development, This boutique low-rise offers a private and peaceful living in a prime central location. It’s a fantastic entry point for first-time buyers and investors alike.

Al Jaddaf is a well-connected freehold community in Dubai, located right next to Dubai Creek. Dubai Healthcare City is next door and the Metro Green Line is nearby. Minutes away from Downtown Dubai and Business Bay, the whole city is within reach. Residents enjoy the buzz of urban Dubai at a relaxed, walkable pace.

projects.name: Urban Horizon
description: Urban Horizon rises confidently in the heart of Arjan, bringing together sleek architectural expression and a premium residential lifestyle. Created by Arete Developments, the project blends comfort, practicality, and sophistication, offering a setting where modern living unfolds naturally.

At the heart of the community, thoughtfully designed homes—ranging from studios to spacious 2-bedroom apartments—provide flexible layouts that feel tailored to everyday life. Every space is shaped to accommodate different lifestyle needs while keeping comfort, privacy, and convenience at the forefront.

projects.name: Arib Boutique
description: Arib Boutique by ARIB Developments introduces a new standard of elegant living in Dubai’s DubaiLand Residence Complex (DLRC). This boutique residential project is designed to offer a sophisticated lifestyle with a perfect blend of luxury, functionality, and community spirit.

Strategically situated within the emerging DubaiLand Residence Complex, Arib Boutique offers residents both tranquility and urban convenience. Its prime location ensures easy access to major highways, shopping centers, healthcare facilities, and educational institutions, while being surrounded by parks and green spaces.

projects.name: Arib Collection
description: Located in the heart of Dubai's sought-after residential district, Arib Collection by ARIB Developments offers a premium boutique lifestyle. This low-rise development features elegantly designed studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, combining sophistication with functionality.

Prices start from AED 671,000, with completion scheduled for December 2027. This under-construction development presents an excellent opportunity for investors and homebuyers in one of Dubai's fastest-growing neighborhoods.

projects.name: Wadi Villas
description: Nestled in the heart of Meydan's District 11, Wadi Villas offers its residents seclusion and tranquillity together with easy access to Dubai's main attractions. Thanks to its handy position, key roads including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain – Dubai Road are easily accessible.

Aesthetics and practical engineering come together to create a masterpiece in every Wadi Villas property. Spacious living areas, upscale finishes, and striking beauty are features that the residences are designed to provide. All of the villas have private pools and well-maintained gardens, offering a tranquil haven from the city life.

projects.name: Vibe by Arsenal East
description: Situated in the prestigious Jumeirah Garden City, Vibe by Arsenal East offers a fresh perspective on contemporary urban living. This mixed-use development combines premium apartments, lifestyle amenities, and community-focused design, making it a standout choice for modern Dubai residents.
Vibe embodies a vision of vibrant community living, where thoughtfully designed spaces meet sustainable practices, creating an environment that supports both comfort and modern urban convenience.

projects.name: Zephyra
description: Zephyra by Arsenal East is set to redefine modern elegance in Dubai, ushering in a new era of luxury living. This pioneering property, designed to provide an oasis of luxury and serenity, promises to envelop residents in a sense of calm and a yearning for absolute perfection.

Zephyra, located in the renowned Dubai Islands, boasts a prime position that offers a unique blend of urban convenience and natural beauty. This ideal location allows residents to access vibrant city life while remaining in a serene retreat away from the bustle.

projects.name: Zephyra Residences 2 by Arsenal East
description: After the remarkable reception of its first phase, Zephyra Residences 2 rises as the newest landmark on Dubai Islands—a project crafted with precision and imagination by Arsenal East. This second chapter elevates every aspect of modern living, introducing a refined collection of 1–3 bedroom apartments, townhouses, and penthouses designed to embody understated elegance.

With homes starting from AED 1,700,000 and handover expected in December 2027, the development offers an exceptional chance to own a residence within one of Dubai’s most promising waterfront destinations. Every layout has been shaped with purpose, ensuring the perfect blend of calming aesthetics, functional comfort, and contemporary luxury.

projects.name: Golf Terrace Residences
description: Golf Terrace Residences by Asak Real Estate Development presents a thoughtfully planned residential community in Dubai Production City, designed to offer a balanced lifestyle that blends comfort, accessibility, and modern living. The development reflects a clear focus on creating a calm residential environment within a well-connected urban setting, making it suitable for both end users and investors looking for long-term value.

The project features a selection of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each designed with practical layouts and contemporary finishes. Interiors are fully furnished and include white goods, allowing residents to move in with ease and enjoy a ready-to-live experience. Floor-to-ceiling windows and well-proportioned spaces enhance natural light and create a sense of openness throughout the units.

projects.name: Velu
description: Velu by ASAK is an off-plan freehold residence in Arjan, Dubai offering studios, 1 and 2 bedroom apartments by Asak Real Estate Development. It is for end-users and investors that want a modern address with a low entry ticket. You get a Title Deed with full ownership rights. International and NRI buyers are also most welcome.

Arjan is an easy and well connected place to live. The community is nestled between Al Barsha, Dubai Hills Estate and Dubai Production City. Nearby supermarkets, cafes, schools, clinics and green spaces make everyday errands easy. Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) will connect you to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai Marina within minutes.

projects.name: Ryze
description: Discover Ryze by AUM One, an exceptional nine-storey residential development that redefines contemporary living in Dubai's dynamic International City. This architectural masterpiece stands as a testament to modern design excellence, offering an unparalleled blend of luxury, comfort, and strategic positioning in the heart of Warsan Residential.

Starting from AED 550,000, Ryze offers exceptional value in today's competitive real estate market, with exclusive early-bird pricing available for forward-thinking buyers. The development's strategic launch timing, combined with its prime location and premium amenities, positions it as a standout investment opportunity in Dubai's ever-evolving skyline.

projects.name: Veda by Aum One
description: Located in the highly sought-after Jumeirah Village Circle, Veda by Aum One brings together modern design and elevated comfort. This premium development features thoughtfully designed 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, ideal for young professionals and growing families seeking a refined lifestyle in Dubai.

Construction is currently underway, with completion scheduled for Q2 2028. Starting from 1,074,555 AED, this freehold project offers a rare combination of affordability and premium quality, appealing to both homeowners and savvy investors.

projects.name: Aura Prestige
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai Silicon Oasis, Aura Prestige exemplifies contemporary urban living with a premium touch. Developed by Aura Infinite Real Estate Development, this residential project is designed to offer more than just a home—it delivers a complete lifestyle where modern comfort meets timeless elegance.

Every apartment is thoughtfully planned to optimize space, natural light, and functionality. From meticulously designed interiors to carefully curated amenities, Aura Prestige creates a harmonious environment where style and comfort coexist seamlessly.

projects.name: Trevino Residences
description: At the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, Trevino Residences offers a fresh take on urban living. This premium residential development, brought to life by Avelon Real Estate Development, combines modern design, thoughtfully curated interiors, and community-focused spaces, creating a lifestyle that blends sophistication with everyday convenience.

Scheduled for completion in June 2027, Trevino presents a boutique collection of apartments ranging from studios to 2-bedroom units. Starting from AED 785,000, the development offers flexible payment plans, including installments for qualified buyers, making premium living accessible without compromise.

projects.name: Avenew 888
description: At the heart of Dubai South, Avenew 888 emerges as a contemporary residential destination that blends modern design with community-focused living. This exceptional development by Avenew Properties offers a collection of thoughtfully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with duplex units, all crafted for residents seeking comfort, convenience, and style in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing districts.

The development combines architectural elegance with practical layouts, creating homes that are both functional and visually striking. Each unit has been designed to maximize space, natural light, and connectivity, providing residents with a lifestyle that’s as relaxing as it is sophisticated.

projects.name: Cheval Residences
description: Cheval Residences is a premium waterfront development by Avenew Development, rising at one of Dubai's most anticipated new addresses Dubai Islands. Designed for those who value both serenity and sophistication, this residential collection brings together thoughtfully crafted apartments with sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf and carefully curated green surroundings.

Positioned directly on Dubai Islands, Cheval Residences occupies a setting that is as rare as it is rewarding. Dubai Islands is a landmark destination emerging as one of the emirate's most sought-after coastal communities, spanning five distinct islands designed to blend resort-style living with urban convenience.

projects.name: Lia Residences
description: At the heart of Dubai Islands, Lia Residences by Avenew unfolds as a refined residential address created for those who value calm, clarity, and contemporary design. This boutique development brings modern architecture together with thoughtful spatial planning, shaping a setting that feels composed, private, and effortlessly elegant.

projects.name: Loom at AVENEW 888
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai South's dynamic landscape, Loom at AVENEW 888 by Avenew Properties represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential living. This exceptional development seamlessly weaves together modern architectural excellence with the comfort and convenience that today's discerning residents demand.

With its strategic positioning and thoughtful design philosophy, this remarkable project promises to deliver a balanced lifestyle where modern comforts harmoniously blend with leisure facilities, creating an environment that truly embodies the essence of luxury living in one of Dubai's most promising districts.

projects.name: Modo at Avenew 88
description: Modo at Avenew 88 offers a premium lifestyle in Dubai South (Dubai World Central), blending modern architecture with strategic urban planning. Developed by Avenew Properties, this community provides a serene escape while keeping residents connected to the city’s key destinations.

Designed for those who value both comfort and accessibility, the project features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, tailored to meet diverse lifestyle needs. Whether you’re a young professional, growing family, or savvy investor, Modo at Avenew 88 delivers exceptional value through its high-quality finishes, top-tier amenities, and strategic location.

projects.name: Rena
description: Rena is a luxurious waterfront residential development located on Dubai Islands, offering a blend of modern elegance and coastal living. The project is developed by Avenew Properties, promising an exclusive lifestyle with premium amenities and breathtaking views.

Rena is strategically located on Dubai Islands, offering stunning waterfront views, direct beach access, and excellent connectivity to key areas of Dubai, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and Dubai Marina.

projects.name: Shoaq Residences
description: Shoaq Residences by Avenew Properties redefines luxury island living in the heart of Dubai Islands. Positioned on the revitalized coastline of Deira, this waterfront project delivers a serene yet sophisticated lifestyle. With contemporary architecture, premium amenities, and a strong focus on community and sustainability, Shoaq Residences blends natural beauty with urban convenience.
Shoaq Residences places you at the heart of Dubai's evolving coastline, promising long-term value and lifestyle excellence.

projects.name: Silena

projects.name: Burj Azizi Tower

This prime location offers unparalleled connectivity to major landmarks across Dubai. With easy access to metro stations, residents benefit from smooth commutes, bringing the city’s attractions and conveniences close at hand.

Each apartment showcases captivating architectural details and refined interiors, complete with branded fittings and fixtures that elevate each living space. Residents can experience sophisticated city living on one of Dubai’s most desirable addresses.

projects.name: Creek Views 4
description: Set in the thriving Al Jaddaf district, Creek Views 4 introduces a refined residential address designed for those who value modern comfort and urban convenience. Developed by Azizi Developments, this elegant project brings together thoughtful architecture, well‑planned interiors, and a carefully curated selection of amenities.

projects.name: Azizi Milan 51
description: Milan by Azizi Developments is a visionary residential project set in Dubai’s dynamic City of Arabia. Designed to set new standards for luxury and smart urban living, Milan combines cutting-edge architecture, eco-conscious planning, and world-class amenities. With a strong focus on future-proof design, lifestyle convenience, and sustainable features, Milan is more than a home – it’s an elevated living experience.

Strategically located in the heart of the City of Arabia, Milan is poised to benefit from Dubai’s ambitious urban expansion. This district is set to become one of the city’s most innovative and sought-after areas, blending culture, commerce, and comfort seamlessly.

projects.name: Barari Parks
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubailand's prestigious Majan district, Barari Parks represents a revolutionary approach to luxury residential living. The development stands as a testament to innovative design philosophy, where modern construction techniques meet environmental consciousness. Residents will experience a lifestyle characterized by aesthetic openness and natural connection, creating a serene residential estate that offers respite from the bustling city while maintaining proximity to Dubai's key attractions and business districts.

projects.name: 311 Boulevard
description: 311 Boulevard by Bam Eskan Real Estate sets a new benchmark for luxury living in Jumeirah Village Circle. With its Italian-inspired design, premium amenities, and prime location, this development offers an unparalleled lifestyle for residents and investors alike.
With easy access to major highways, residents can effortlessly reach Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and Al Maktoum International Airport.

projects.name: X11 Residence
description: X11 Residence by BAMX Development represents a fresh approach to contemporary apartment living in Dubai South. The project delivers a refined collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences designed for those seeking quality, convenience, and long-term value in one of Dubai's most dynamic emerging districts.

The building's design emphasizes clarity and function. Large windows bring in natural light throughout the day, while spacious layouts ensure comfort across all unit types. Every apartment is finished to contemporary standards, featuring open living areas, neutral tones, and efficient use of space. The result is a home that feels both welcoming and practical, with interiors that adapt easily to personal style and daily routines.

projects.name: Livia Residence
description: Livia Residence by BARCO Properties sets a new standard for premium urban living in the heart of Dubai South. This thoughtfully designed G+6 development features 71 homes spread across eight floors, offering a balanced mix of studios and 2-bedroom apartments that seamlessly combine modern style with functional comfort.
Construction is underway, with delivery scheduled for April 2027, and prices start at AED 555,555, presenting an accessible entry point into Dubai’s premium residential market.

projects.name: Gate Royale Residences
description: Gate Royale Residences by Baron Development is an exclusive low-rise residential project in the prestigious Jebel Ali Village, Dubai. With only 60 luxury residences spread across 11 floors, it stands as a rare offering in Dubai’s fast-paced real estate scene. Combining contemporary architecture, boutique living, and future-forward sustainability, this community is designed for those seeking understated elegance, privacy, and lasting value.

The Gate Royale Residences are tucked away in the historic Jebel Ali Village's Al Furjan neighborhood. Residents enjoy a tranquil setting while maintaining easy access to Dubai's main commercial and recreational centers.

projects.name: Arancia Yards
description: Arancia Yards is a compelling residential development by Beyond, the design-led developer operating under the Omniyat Group. Marking Beyond's first presence in City of Arabia, this project brings the developer's refined approach to architecture and living quality into one of Dubailand's most established master communities.

The name Arancia draws from the warmth and vitality of the orange — a symbol of colour, energy, and the richness of a life well lived. That spirit runs through every element of the development, from the façade composition to the communal spaces, giving Arancia Yards a distinctive character within the broader City of Arabia landscape.

projects.name: Arancia Yards 2
description: Arancia Yards 2 by Beyond is a thoughtfully designed residential development situated in the City of Arabia, Dubailand — one of Dubai's most steadily evolving residential corridors. The project brings together contemporary apartment living, lush green surroundings, and a well-rounded set of community amenities, creating a place where residents can genuinely feel at home from day one.

Designed with a range of buyers in mind, from young professionals seeking their first home to growing families looking for space and comfort, Arancia Yards 2 offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments across a carefully planned community layout. The emphasis throughout the development is on livability — generous natural light, clean architectural lines, and a calm residential atmosphere that stands apart from Dubai's busier urban zones.

projects.name: Aria by Beyond
description: Nestled along the pristine shores of Dubai Maritime City, Aria by Beyond emerges as a beacon of sophisticated coastal living, harmoniously blending modern architecture with the tranquil allure of the sea. This premium seafront property development, crafted by the visionary developers at Beyond, sets a new standard for luxurious urban living in one of Dubai's most promising and rapidly evolving districts.
Aria by Beyond is not just a residential complex; it's a masterpiece of design and functionality that caters to the discerning tastes of both residents and investors.

projects.name: Hado by Beyond
description: Situated in the prestigious Dubai Islands, Hado by Beyond introduces a unique approach to luxury living inspired by Japanese principles. As the first signature launch in Siora, the flagship district of Dubai Islands, this exceptional development embraces the concept of Ikigai – the art of living with purpose, balance, and harmony.

Comprising three elegantly sculpted towers, Hado by Beyond offers a lifestyle where tranquility meets sophistication. Each tower is carefully oriented to capture optimal natural light and provide unobstructed waterfront views, allowing residents to enjoy a serene environment that blends mindful living with premium comfort.

projects.name: Hado by Beyond Phase 2
description: Hado by Beyond Phase 2 is a contemporary residential development located on Dubai Islands, offering a modern coastal living experience within one of Dubai’s emerging waterfront destinations. Developed by Beyond, the project continues the vision of the Hado community by combining thoughtful architecture, comfortable living spaces, and a selection of lifestyle facilities designed for everyday convenience.

The development reflects a balanced approach to urban living, where residents can enjoy a calm waterfront environment while staying connected to Dubai’s key destinations. Hado by Beyond Phase 2 focuses on creating a residential atmosphere that blends modern design with natural surroundings and practical amenities.

projects.name: Jumeirah Peninsula Gardens
description: Jumeirah Peninsula Gardens brings a fresh interpretation of modern waterfront living to Dubai Maritime City, blending contemporary architecture with the calmness of a coastal setting. Created by Beyond Developments, this exclusive address offers a refined selection of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments starting from AED 3 million, each thoughtfully crafted to capture sweeping views of the marina and the surrounding skyline.

Set for completion in March 2027, the development is designed for individuals and families who appreciate comfort, style, and a home that naturally aligns with the rhythm of Dubai’s lively urban environment. Every space reflects a careful balance of cutting-edge design and sustainability, creating a home that feels both sophisticated and grounded.

projects.name: Kalora
description: Kalora by Beyond redefines waterfront living in Dubai Maritime City, where contemporary design meets coastal tranquility. This G+3P+HC+45+1MECH+R tower rises as a striking vertical landmark, crafted to deliver an elevated residential experience that harmonizes architecture, nature, and community.

At the heart of Kalora's architectural identity lies its innovative double-layer façade system. The inner envelope features high-performance insulated panels combining glazed and opaque surfaces, while the outer layer showcases bronzed aluminium fins that provide solar shading and visual depth. This dual-skin approach delivers exceptional thermal performance while creating a sophisticated play of light and shadow across the building's exterior.

projects.name: Kamellia

projects.name: Kanyon by Beyond

projects.name: Melograno Yards

projects.name: Orise by Beyond

projects.name: Passo by Beyond

projects.name: Saria

projects.name: Mural By Beyond

projects.name: Orvessa Residences

projects.name: Altura Phase 2

projects.name: Buddha Bar Hotel and Floating Residences

projects.name: Amarae Residence
