Bayz 101 by Danube Properties is poised to redefine luxury living in Business Bay. With its unbeatable Bayz 101, breathtaking views, and diverse housing options, it promises an unrivaled lifestyle. Whether you want to invest or find your dream home, offers something for everyone. This under-construction marvel is an opportunity not to be missed.

projects.name: Bayz 102
description: Bayz 102, a landmark high-rise development by Danube Properties, redefines luxury living in Dubai. Nestled in the vibrant Business Bay district, this exceptional residential project offers a range of premium studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and a 4-bedroom penthouse.
Residential Zones: Featuring landscaped gardens, walking paths, and communal spaces

projects.name: Bluz Tower
description: Bluz Tower is a striking residential high-rise developed by Danube Properties, rising confidently along the coastline of Dubai Maritime City. With its azure-tinted glass façade, dynamic architectural lines, and sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf, this tower redefines what it means to live on the water's edge.

Dubai Maritime City is one of the emirate's most ambitious waterfront developments, positioned between Port Rashid and the historic Mina Rashid district. The area blends maritime heritage with contemporary urban planning, offering residents a rare combination of coastal calm and city accessibility.

projects.name: Breez by Danube
description: Breez by Danube is a 60-storey residential tower in Dubai Maritime City, currently the tallest residential building in this waterfront district. The development offers studios through to five-bedroom duplex villas, each designed to maximise natural light and ocean views. Handover is scheduled for March 2029, with prices starting from AED 1,300,000.
The location balances coastal calm with genuine urban connectivity, a combination that is difficult to find at this price point in Dubai.

projects.name: Danube Oasiz
description: This opulent 38-story residential complex offers a range of finely built apartments that are intended to accommodate different lifestyles and guarantee a peaceful living environment. It blends elegance, comfort, and innovation.

Danube Oasiz is a way of life rather than just a place to live. This property, which is situated in the center of Dubai Silicon Oasis, combines world-class amenities, a premium location, and innovative design. Danube Oasiz offers a living experience that meets and surpasses expectations, regardless of whether you're a young professional, a developing family, or someone looking for a tranquil haven in a bustling metropolis.

projects.name: Oasiz Phase 2 By Danube
description: Dubai offers two exceptional living experiences Palm Jumeirah and Danube Oasiz 2. Palm Jumeirah is a renowned man-made island known for its luxury and elegance, while Danube Oasiz 2 is a modern 38-story residential tower that combines contemporary design with functionality. Both developments
represent the pinnacle of modern living in Dubai offering unique lifestyles and top-notch amenities.

projects.name: Diamondz
description: Diamondz at JLT is Danube Properties' latest architectural marvel, establishing a new standard for luxury residential living in Dubai. This 62-story skyscraper features a variety of premium studios to 4-bedroom apartments, all precisely planned to provide tenants with an exceptional living experience. Each apartment is fully furnished and fitted with cutting-edge contemporary design and high-end specs.
Living in Diamondz offers various advantages, making it a perfect alternative for individuals seeking elegance and convenience.

projects.name: Elitz Phase 3 By Danube
description: Danube's Elitz Phase 3 By Danube is an architectural marvel poised to revolutionize luxury living in the rapidly developing Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) community of Dubai. Created by the esteemed Danube Properties, this project stands as the pinnacle of cutting-edge luxury and design, featuring a distinctive glass facade that promises to be a significant landmark in the area.

Elitz Phase 3 By Danube enjoys a strategic location near major thoroughfares such as Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Al Khail Road. This prime positioning enables residents to easily access a variety of amenities, including prestigious schools, retail malls, and tourist attractions. Living at Elitz Phase 3 By Danube means being at the center of everything Dubai has to offer.

projects.name: Fashionz By Danube
description: Fashionz by Danube is a standout addition to Dubai's real estate market, offering a unique blend of style, elegance, and modern living. Developed by the renowned Danube Properties, this iconic project, the first FashionTV-branded residence in Dubai, caters to those who embrace fashion, sophistication, and an elevated lifestyle.
Fashionz by Danube offers a range of thoughtfully designed apartments to cater to various needs and preferences.

projects.name: Greenz by Danube
description: Greenz by Danube is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Danube Properties, situated in the emerging community of Al Rowaiyah 1, Dubai. Offering a curated selection of four-bedroom townhouses and five-bedroom villas, the project is built around the idea that modern family living should be both comfortable and connected to nature.

The community combines generous living spaces, lush green surroundings, and a comprehensive range of amenities — creating an environment that serves families, professionals, and investors alike. Whether you are looking for a forever home or a high-potential off-plan investment in Dubai, Greenz by Danube delivers on both fronts with clarity and confidence.

projects.name: Oceanz By Danube
description: Experience the epitome of luxury living at Oceanz, a groundbreaking new project brought to you by the renowned developers, Danube Properties. Nestled at the heart of Dubai Maritime City, Oceanz stands tall as a 50storey residential marvel, showcasing the finest in modern architecture and design.

Oceanz residences are ingeniously designed to provide the utmost space and luxury. The interior design of each apartment is nothing short of outstanding, exuding a sense of opulence and comfort that transcends everyday living. From the spacious layout to the modern aesthetics, every detail in these homes is planned meticulously to ensure the highest quality of living.

projects.name: Oceanz Phase 2 By Danube
description: Welcome to Oceanz Phase 2 Danube, a magnificent architectural masterpiece nestled along the breathtaking coastline of Dubai Maritime City. This 50 story high rise development is a testament to luxurious living, offering a diverse range of housing options from opulent studios to one, two, and three bedroom apartments.

Oceanz Phase 2 Danube is a stunning achievement by the renowned Tonino Lamborghini Casa, featuring a sophisticated exterior that complements the interiors lavish finishing touches. It comprises twin towers, each meticulously designed to evoke the serenity of the sea and the brilliance of sunbeams. These two buildings are joined by two lobbies on the top floors, facilitating a seamless and elegant living experience for the residents.

projects.name: Oceanz Phase 3 By Danube
description: Discover an exclusive seaside paradise with Danube Oceanz Phase 3 , a new project development by renowned developer Danube Properties. Nestled in the heart of Dubai Maritime City, Oceanz Phase 3 offers a redefined waterfront living experience inspired by the sea.

This high rise architectural marvel stands as a beacon of luxury, combining architectural elegance with maritime charm. With its strategic location, it offers excellent capital appreciation for investors and seamless commuting with quick access to major expressways and upcoming Metro stations.

projects.name: Serenz
description: Rising majestically as a 50-storey architectural masterpiece, Serenz by Danube Properties represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential living in Dubai's prestigious Jumeirah Village Circle. This exceptional vertical community introduces a new standard of urban sophistication, seamlessly blending modern design principles with luxurious comfort.

The development embodies a vision where every detail has been meticulously crafted to enhance the resident experience, from the grand entrance to the thoughtfully designed living spaces that maximize natural light and optimize functionality. With completion scheduled for December 2029, Serenz promises to become an iconic addition to Dubai's ever-evolving skyline.

projects.name: Sparklz
description: Sparklz by Danube Properties is a new residential development in Al Furjan, Dubai, set to redefine luxurious urban living with contemporary design, exceptional amenities, and strategic location.
Sparklz is an ideal choice for anyone seeking modern living, high investment potential, and a vibrant community.

projects.name: Timez By Danube
description: Timez By Danube is a visionary residential project by Danube Properties, located in Dubai Silicon Oasis. This high-rise development offers a blend of luxury, innovation, and functionality, catering to a wide range of residents with studio to 3-bedroom apartments. Featuring premium amenities and smart home integration, Timez By Danube redefines modern urban living in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing communities.
Dubai Silicon Oasis is a thriving hub for tech businesses, offering residents a perfect blend of convenience and innovation.

projects.name: Dar Al Aiham One
description: In the heart of Dubai's evolving Al Warsan 4 district, Dar Al Aiham One emerges as a beacon of contemporary residential excellence, masterfully crafted by the visionary Dar Al Aiham Properties. This exceptional development represents more than just a collection of homes—it embodies a lifestyle philosophy where modern sophistication seamlessly blends with accessible luxury.

Dar Al Aiham One stands as a testament to intelligent urban planning, offering 71 meticulously designed units that cater to diverse lifestyle needs. From intimate studios perfect for young professionals to spacious three-bedroom apartments ideal for growing families, each residence is crafted with precision and care, ensuring that every square foot serves a purpose while maintaining an atmosphere of refined elegance.

projects.name: Sapphire 32 by Dar Alkarama
description: Sapphire 32 by Dar Alkarama is an exceptional project from the esteemed real estate developer Emaar Properties. Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), this masterpiece combines modern design with traditional charm, creating not just a housing development but a vibrant community that elevates the quality of life for its residents.

Strategically located in Damac Hills 2, Sapphire 32 offers convenient access to Dubai's key destinations, making it an ideal choice for both professionals and families. The project ensures residents can effortlessly navigate the city while enjoying the tranquility of their serene community.

projects.name: D Villas
description: Dar Global is developing a new, upscale residential community called D Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates.. This exclusive project promises to redefine luxury living in Dubai, offering a selection of opulent villas that provide breathtaking views of verdant golf courses. Nestled within one of Dubai's most coveted communities, this development is designed to cater to those seeking a blend of luxury and tranquility.

D Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates is set to be a landmark development, offering an unparalleled lifestyle experience in one of Dubai's most sought-after locales. With its luxurious villas, exceptional amenities, and prime location, it promises to be the ideal choice for discerning buyers seeking a sophisticated and serene lifestyle

projects.name: DG1 Living
description: nestled in the heart of Dubai's pulsating Business Bay. DG1 Living is an exceptional creation developed by the renowned Dar Al Arkan. This residential high-rise houses premium Studio, 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments offering mesmerizing Canal views.

Crafted meticulously with the highest standard of materials and imbued with innovative architecture, DG1 Living is a testament to aesthetic brilliance and engineering excellence. The building's exterior is a stunning work of art that magnetically attracts and invites discerning homeowners and investors. Imagine residing in a development that mirrors the epitome of modernity and exudes a unique charm and style.

projects.name: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
description: The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is an awe-inspiring 80-floor skyscraper strategically located on Sheikh Zayed Road, the city's main artery and home to some of its most prestigious addresses. This mixed-use development will house both the Trump International Hotel and a collection of ultra-luxurious residential units, offering residents and guests alike the opportunity to experience the pinnacle of Dubai living.
Situated on Sheikh Zayed Road, Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai benefits from one of the most sought-after addresses in the city.

projects.name: Darah Residence
description: Darah Residence is a thoughtfully crafted residential development by Darah South Real Estate Development, positioned in one of Dubai's most strategically significant growth corridors — Dubai South, also known as Dubai World Central. This development brings together considered architecture, practical living spaces, and a connected urban setting to offer residents a genuinely well-rounded lifestyle.

The development reflects a clear understanding of what modern residents need — spaces that work hard, designs that feel calm, and a location that opens doors. Far from simply offering square footage, Darah Residence is conceived as a living environment where functionality and quiet sophistication coexist naturally.

projects.name: Avana Residences
description: Located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, Avana Residences by Deca Real Estate Developments offers a premium residential lifestyle. Combining contemporary design with wellness-oriented amenities, this development creates a serene urban sanctuary. Its flowing architectural lines, soft-toned interiors, and thoughtfully planned layouts ensure a comfortable and sophisticated living environment.

The project features a selection of studios and 1–2 bedroom apartments. Prices start from AED 745,000, with flexible payment plans requiring only a 10% down payment, making it an accessible investment in Dubai's thriving property market.

projects.name: Route 66
description: Route 66 stands as a testament to modern residential excellence in Dubai's rapidly evolving landscape. This sophisticated five-storey development by Deerfields Development represents a harmonious blend of contemporary architecture and thoughtful urban planning, strategically positioned in the prestigious Jebel Ali Hills community of Saih Shuaib 1.

The development's name evokes a sense of journey and destination, perfectly capturing the essence of this residential landmark that serves as both a peaceful retreat and a gateway to Dubai's dynamic lifestyle. Expected to complete by December 2027, Route 66 is currently under construction with booking opportunities available, making it an ideal time for discerning investors and homebuyers to secure their place in this exceptional community.

projects.name: 06 Life Residences
description: 06 Life Residences is a modern residential development by Deniz Real Estate Development, thoughtfully crafted to meet the demands of today's urban lifestyle in one of Dubai's most dynamic and accessible communities. The project brings together practical design, quality finishes, and a curated set of lifestyle amenities, making it an appealing choice for first-time homeowners, growing families, and savvy investors alike.

Situated in Dubai International City, 06 Life Residences places residents at the heart of one of the emirate's most culturally rich and strategically positioned districts. International City is a well-established community known for its affordable luxury, diverse international character, and strong connectivity to the wider Dubai metropolitan area.

projects.name: 09 Life Residences
description: 09 Life Residences emerges as a beacon of modern sophistication in Dubai's dynamic real estate landscape, setting unprecedented standards for contemporary urban living within the prestigious Dubai Land Residence Complex. Developed by the renowned Deniz Development, this exceptional residential project represents a harmonious fusion of architectural excellence, functional design, and luxurious comfort.

The development's refined architectural vision transforms the concept of modern living, creating spaces that maximize natural light, optimize functionality, and enhance the overall quality of life for residents. Starting from AED 675,000, this remarkable project offers an accessible entry point into Dubai's luxury residential market while maintaining the highest standards of design and construction quality.

projects.name: Longford Residences
description: Longford Residences by Devan Development redefines modern urban living in Dubai International City. This thoughtfully planned G+P+4 development combines residential comfort with ground-floor retail and entertainment spaces, creating a cohesive community where residents can live, work, and relax all within a single environment.

The development features 264 meticulously designed apartments alongside 16 commercial units, offering a seamless blend of functionality and style. Its low-rise configuration fosters a neighborhood feel while maintaining the sophistication and amenities expected from premium Dubai real estate. Each home is designed with expansive layouts, high ceilings, and large windows, ensuring bright, airy interiors that embrace natural light.

projects.name: Ivy at Park Five
description: Nestled within the prestigious Dubai Production City, Ivy at Park Five by Deyaar Development represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential living. This exceptional development offers an exquisite collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with sophisticated duplex units, all designed to harmonize tranquility with modern luxury.

The development stands as a testament to architectural excellence, featuring clean lines, premium finishes, and expansive panoramic glazing that floods each residence with natural light. With a starting price of AED 685,000 and expected completion by December 2027, Ivy at Park Five presents an unparalleled opportunity for discerning buyers seeking a sophisticated lifestyle in one of Dubai's most promising communities.

projects.name: Alder at Park Five
description: Alder at Park Five brings a fresh perspective to modern living in Dubai Production City, offering a place where contemporary comfort blends naturally with relaxed community rhythms. Designed with intention and subtle elegance, the development features a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments shaped for residents who value balance, privacy, and a sense of belonging.

The neighborhood forms part of the larger Park Five master plan, a thoughtfully crafted community designed to harmonize urban convenience with serene, landscaped surroundings. Completion is expected in Q4 2027, making it an appealing opportunity for those seeking a refined home within one of Dubai’s well-established districts.

projects.name: DWTN Residences
description: Rising 445 meters above Dubai’s skyline, DWTN Residences by Deyaar sets a new benchmark for premium urban living. This architectural marvel spans 110 floors and offers an exclusive collection of 1- to 5-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and a Royal Palace, combining sophisticated design with exceptional lifestyle amenities.

With over 75,000 square feet of lifestyle-focused facilities, DWTN Residences creates a vertical community where urban convenience meets tranquil elegance, offering residents an extraordinary living environment above the heart of Dubai.

projects.name: Eleve by Deyaar
description: Eleve by Deyaar is a striking 38-story residential tower redefining what urban living looks like in one of Dubai's fastest-growing districts. Developed by Deyaar, a trusted name in UAE real estate, this high-rise offers thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments that balance elegant interiors with genuine functionality.

Positioned within the expansive Downtown Jebel Ali district — a mixed-use urban zone spanning 6.5 million square meters — Eleve places residents at the center of a community that is actively being shaped into one of Dubai's most forward-looking neighborhoods. The area features residential towers, commercial hubs, tree-lined plazas, and shaded pedestrian walkways that encourage a relaxed yet connected lifestyle.

projects.name: Elm at Park Five
description: At the heart of Dubai Production City (IMPZ), Elm at Park Five offers a fresh take on premium residential living, blending contemporary design with authentic Arabian influences. Developed by Deyaar Leasing, this five-building community introduces Towers A and B in its first phase, featuring a carefully curated collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments starting from AED 1,010,461.

Scheduled for completion in June 2027, Elm at Park Five goes beyond traditional living concepts, creating a harmonious environment where geometric façades meet biophilic design, fostering a community that celebrates both modernity and cultural heritage.

projects.name: Park Five By Deyaar
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai Production City, Park Five By Deyaar emerges as a groundbreaking residential development that promises to redefine urban living. This ambitious project by renowned developer Deyaar Leasing introduces a harmonious blend of luxury, nature, and cutting-edge technology, creating a tranquil haven amidst the bustling cityscape of Dubai.

With its ideal location inside Dubai Production City (previously known as IMPZ), Park Five By Deyaar provides unmatched access to important parts of Dubai. Major thoroughfares like Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road are only a short drive away, giving locals quick access to well-known landmarks, retail malls, food options, and basic amenities.

projects.name: Ember Park Five
description: Ember Park Five offers a harmonious fusion of contemporary design, first-rate amenities, and a community-focused lifestyle, catering to the various demands of young professionals, couples, and families. For individuals seeking a balanced, fashionable, and practical living space, this development is the ideal option.

In the center of Dubai Production City, Ember Park Five by Deyaar Leasing provides a contemporary and vibrant living environment. It is the best option for people looking for a well-rounded, connected lifestyle in one of Dubai's most sought-after areas because of its modern architecture, first-rate amenities, and lively sense of community.

projects.name: Mar Casa
description: Mar Casa is a majestic 52-floor residence in Dubai Maritime City embodying the fluidity of ocean waves in its exceptional design.

The 580 apartments, each meticulously crafted to enhance the panoramic ocean views, offer airy and well-balanced living spaces that delight the senses. This stunning development is not just a residence, but a landmark that stands as a testament to emotional luxury living in the birthplace of Dubai.

projects.name: Neem at Park Five
description: Neem at Park Five is a visionary residential development by Deyaar Leasing, redefining urban living in the heart of Dubai Production City. This nature-inspired community blends modern design with sustainable living, offering an unparalleled lifestyle for families and professionals.

Strategically located in Dubai Production City, Neem at Park Five ensures excellent connectivity to major highways, business hubs, schools, healthcare facilities, and entertainment destinations. Its prime position balances urban convenience with suburban tranquility.

projects.name: Helvetia Marine
description: At the heart of Dubai Islands, Helvetia Marine emerges as a striking waterfront address offering branded 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and 2-bedroom duplex with uninterrupted island views. This newly released residential development presents a refined approach to coastal living, where modern comfort meets thoughtful design in a setting shaped by sea, sky, and calm surroundings.

Rising gracefully above the shimmering waters, the façade is more than a structure—it’s a visual statement. Clean lines, glass, and steel come together to reflect the ever-changing tones of the sea and skyline, making every sunset a quiet spectacle from home. The design celebrates balance, blending urban convenience with the peaceful rhythm of marine life.

projects.name: Helvetia Residences Phase 2 By DHG
description: Helvetia Residences Phase 2 By DHG at JVC, a luxurious residential marvel by DHG Properties. Offering premium-designed studios, and 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments, this development redefines contemporary living with its blend of modern conveniences and serene village-like atmosphere.

Nestled within the prestigious Jumeirah Village Circle in Dubai, Helvetia Residences Phase 2 By DHG at JVC provides an unparalleled living experience. Surrounded by over 30 landscaped green spaces, residents enjoy easy access to popular malls, fitness centers, schools, and other attractions, making it an ideal location for luxury and sophistication seekers.

projects.name: Helvetia Verde
description: Nestled in the prestigious Meydan district of Dubai, Helvetia Verde sets a new standard for premium urban living. This exclusive development by DHG Properties offers just 108 meticulously designed apartments, including 1-, 2-, and 3.5-bedroom units, crafted to combine modern functionality with elegant style.

With prices starting from AED 1,580,000, Helvetia Verde provides not just a home, but a lifestyle that merges comfort, sophistication, and convenience. The limited number of units ensures an intimate community where residents enjoy privacy and exclusivity in one of Dubai's most sought-after neighborhoods.

projects.name: Luzora Residences
description: Luzora Residences is a luxury coastal development by DIA Development, located in Dubai Islands. Combining modern architectural design with stunning waterfront views, this project sets a new standard for sophisticated urban living. The residences offer an unparalleled lifestyle with world-class amenities and easy access to Dubai's top attractions, making it a prime location for discerning residents and investors.

Luzora Residences promises not just a home but a lifestyle that blends urban sophistication with coastal serenity. With its prime location, innovative design, and comprehensive amenities, it offers a unique opportunity for both residents and investors.

projects.name: DIFC Heights Tower
description: DIFC Heights Tower is a flagship residential project by DIFC, set within the heart of the Dubai International Financial Centre. This architectural marvel is positioned to redefine urban sophistication, combining panoramic city views, smart living, and exceptional connectivity.
Located in Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), DIFC Heights Tower offers residents unmatched access to a vibrant ecosystem of business, culture, and lifestyle.

projects.name: The Residences DIFC
description: The Residences DIFC represent a groundbreaking milestone in Dubai's luxury residential landscape, marking the inaugural residential chapter within the prestigious DIFC Zabeel District. This exceptional development comprises two architecturally striking towers with distinctive sculptural silhouettes that redefine contemporary urban living in the heart of Dubai's most dynamic business district.

Starting from AED 2.6 million, these meticulously designed residences offer a range of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and duplex units, each crafted to meet the highest standards of modern luxury living. With completion scheduled for December 2029, this development represents the perfect fusion of visionary architecture, premium amenities, and strategic location advantages.

projects.name: The Residences at District One
description: The Residences at District One, District One's cutting-edge and distinctive new project, is unveiled. The project, which is located in the centre of MBR City, offers a range of apartments with 1, 2, and 3 bedrooms, each with special features and conveniences. These apartments are spread across four to sixteen storeys of low- and mid-rise towers.

The Residences at District One are in an unbeatable location. It provides breathtaking all-around views of Meydan One, the Downtown Dubai Skyline, and the Crystal Lagoon. For those who enjoy the tranquillity of natural beauty combined with the excitement of the city, this is a great place to be.

projects.name: Lantana Hills
description: Lantana Hills is a thoughtfully designed residential community by Dubai Holding, offering a fresh take on modern family living within the energetic setting of Dubai Science Park. The development brings together 390 carefully planned homes, including 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses, each crafted to reflect a harmonious balance between comfort, functionality, and refined aesthetics.

Situated within Dubai Science Park, Lantana Hills enjoys a strategic address in a district that continues to attract leading innovators, researchers, and professionals. This thriving innovation hub provides residents with a dynamic living environment that balances the energy of a growing commercial corridor with the tranquility of a thoughtfully planned residential enclave.

projects.name: Asayel Avenue
description: Dubai Investment Properties presents Asayel Avenue, a contemporary residential development in the heart of Mirdif Hills. Offering a blend of luxurious amenities and thoughtfully designed apartments, this community redefines urban living in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods.
Each unit features modern kitchens, premium bathrooms, and private balconies or terraces.

projects.name: Vista Meydan
description: At the heart of Dubai’s dynamic Meydan district, Vista Meydan redefines modern urban living. This landmark residential tower by Dubai Investment Properties seamlessly blends premium apartments with flexible office spaces and curated retail options. With striking vertical lines, expansive glazing, and thoughtfully designed podium decks, the development offers residents a lifestyle enriched with lagoon views and resort-style amenities.

Featuring 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive penthouses, each unit is designed to maximize natural light, privacy, and functionality. With prices starting from AED 1,626,000 and completion set for December 2027, Vista Meydan offers a rare opportunity to combine serene living with unmatched urban convenience.

projects.name: La Tilia
description: La Tilia Villanova is the latest development by Dubai Properties, an impressive addition to the Villanova community in Dubailand. With its strategic location and a wealth of unique features, redefines townhouse living, blending elegance, comfort, and community.

La Tilia by Dubai Properties is more than a residential development; it’s a community crafted for those who value a premium lifestyle. With its prime location, thoughtfully designed homes, and an array of amenities, La Tilia promises comfort, convenience, and connection. Whether seeking a family home or a lucrative investment, La Tilia Villanova provides a unique opportunity to be part of a thriving community in Dubailand.

projects.name: La Tilia at Villanova 2
description: The remarkable residential complex La Tilia at Villanova Phase 2 is situated in the center of Dubailand, a vast suburban neighborhood that has grown to be a popular destination for families. This new phase, which was developed by Dubai Properties, promises to improve contemporary family life by combining comfort, convenience, and scenic beauty.

Strategic Connectivity: La Tilia offers easy access to main thoroughfares, such as Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, guaranteeing that you are constantly in contact with Dubai's main attractions.

projects.name: Beachfront Gate 3
description: Dubai South Properties introduces Beachfront Gate 3, a refined residential development set within the thriving Beachfront Gates community in Dubai South's Residential District. Offering a thoughtfully curated collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, this project brings together sophisticated design, sustainable construction, and a lifestyle that genuinely feels elevated without being overcomplicated.

Every apartment in Beachfront Gate 3 is crafted with intention — clean architectural lines, premium finishes, and an eco-conscious approach that makes day-to-day living both comfortable and responsible. Whether you're drawn by the waterfront views, the lush green landscapes, or simply the promise of a well-planned community, this development delivers on every front.

projects.name: Beachfront Gates By Dubai South
description: Beachfront Gates by Dubai South redefines luxury beachfront living in Expo City Dubai. This ultra-modern development offers a harmonious blend of urban convenience, coastal beauty, and world-class amenities, making it an unparalleled choice for residents and investors alike.
This strategic location ensures a tranquil beachfront lifestyle without compromising urban accessibility.

projects.name: Beachfront Gates Phase 2 By Dubai South
description: Dubai South Properties introduces Beachfront Gates Phase 2, a luxurious residential development in the heart of Expo City Dubai, offering a harmonious blend of modern beachfront living and sustainable design.
This prime location combines tranquility and accessibility, making it ideal for residents and investors alike.

projects.name: Hayat 6
description: Hayat 6 is a thoughtfully designed residential sub-community within the broader Hayat Dubai South district, offering 104 carefully curated residential units as part of one of Dubai's most ambitious master-planned developments. Developed by Dubai South Properties, this project forms an integral part of the larger Dubai South ecosystem — a 145-square-kilometre urban district engineered to support the city's aviation, logistics, and trade sectors…

What sets Hayat 6 apart is its measured scale. With just over a hundred units, the community strikes the right balance between intimacy and connectivity, fostering a genuine neighbourhood feel while avoiding the impersonal density that larger developments often carry.

projects.name: Hayat 7
description: Hayat 7 is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Dubai South, offering a refined collection of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments in one of Dubai's most strategically positioned communities. The project reflects a commitment to quality living — where clean architecture, practical layouts, and a carefully curated set of amenities come together to create a home that genuinely works for its residents.

Situated within Dubai South, also known as Dubai World Central, Hayat 7 places residents at the center of one of the UAE's most ambitious urban developments. Spanning over 145 square kilometers, Dubai South is a master-planned city designed to accommodate a thriving mix of residential, commercial, aviation, and logistics activity.

projects.name: Hayat by Dubai South
description: Hayat by Dubai South brings a new perspective to family-focused residential living, stretching across an impressive 10 million square feet in the prestigious Golf District. Designed by Dubai South Properties, the community features around 2,500 premium homes shaped around comfort, space, and modern functionality. Set for completion in Q2 2028, the development blends thoughtful design with a setting that continues to grow in desirability.

Its collection includes 3 to 5-bedroom townhouses, along with semi-detached and detached villas, mansions, apartments, and hotel apartments. The architecture follows a clean, minimalist approach that prioritizes privacy, flexible layouts, and modern interiors—ideal for families seeking a calm residential setting that still keeps them connected to the city’s energy.

projects.name: Hayat Residences Phase 2 by Dubai South
description: In one of Dubai's most vibrant and quickly changing neighborhoods, Dubai South Properties presents Hayat Residences Phase 2, a remarkable new development that perfectly embodies modern living. With its seamless fusion of contemporary design, eco-friendly elements, and unmatched amenities, this innovative project is poised to redefine residential standards in the emirate.

Hayat Residences Phase 2 is ideally situated in the center of Dubai South, formerly known as Dubai World Central, offering peace of mind and unmatched connectivity. The development is well-positioned to benefit from the area's expanding population and advancing infrastructure.

projects.name: Hayat Phase 3 By Dubai South
description: Hayat Phase 3 offers a premium residential experience in Dubai South, combining modern design with serene surroundings. This thoughtfully planned community features spacious 3 to 5-bedroom freehold townhouses, crafted for families seeking a balance between urban accessibility and peaceful suburban living.

Set for completion in Q2 2028, each townhouse is designed with intelligent layouts, high-quality finishes, and seamless integration with landscaped surroundings. Whether you’re a growing family or a professional looking to elevate your lifestyle, Hayat 3 provides a vibrant, family-focused community in one of Dubai’s most promising districts.

projects.name: Hayat Phase 4 By Dubai South
description: Hayat Phase 4 introduces a fresh residential concept within one of Dubai’s most promising districts. Developed by Dubai South Properties, the community brings 200 modern homes to a master development spread across 10 million square meters. The project features spacious 3, 4, and 5-bedroom townhouses designed to combine comfort, functionality, and sustainable principles within a premium setting.

Each home embraces open-plan layouts, private gardens, and adaptable spaces that grow with your lifestyle needs. Natural light, clean interiors, and balanced finishes come together to create homes that feel calm and inviting without sacrificing practicality.

projects.name: Hayat Phase 5 By Dubai South
description: At the heart of Dubai South, Hayat Phase 5 offers a premium collection of townhouses designed for families and professionals seeking the perfect blend of modern living and peaceful surroundings. The development comprises a refined collection of 45 apartments, offering one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and a single three-bedroom residence. Elemental 78 is not about excess; it is about permanence, clarity, and the quiet confidence of a well-designed space.

description: Ever Glory Developments' ground-breaking residential development Firoza is set to revolutionize luxury living on the Dubai Islands. Firoza is positioned to provide an unmatched lifestyle by fusing cutting-edge technology, luxurious finishing, and contemporary architecture.

Located in the heart of Dubai Islands, Firoza enjoys a prime position offering the perfect blend of tranquility and urban sophistication. Its proximity to the grand shopping mall, renowned cafes, hotels, and a range of outdoor leisure spots makes it a highly desirable location for both residents and investors. This strategic positioning also ensures superb accessibility to key transportation links, adding further value to its residential appeal.

projects.name: Arche Residences
description: Arche Residences is a contemporary residential development by Evera Real Estate in Dubai South, offering a focused collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments. The development combines modern architecture, practical layouts and resident-focused facilities within one of Dubai’s emerging residential districts.

The development is planned for handover in Q3 2028, with apartments starting from approximately AED 990,000 for one-bedroom residences and AED 1.4 million for two-bedroom residences. A 40/60 payment plan is available, subject to the applicable unit and purchase terms.

projects.name: Galleria Residences
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai South Residential District, Galleria Residences by Evera Real Estate offers a boutique approach to premium urban living. This G+4 development features just 64 carefully designed apartments, combining contemporary architecture with refined interiors. Starting from AED 709,277, it provides residents with a serene, family-oriented lifestyle in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing communities.

With bright, welcoming interiors and a modern façade, the development seamlessly blends elegant finishes with cutting-edge smart technology. Every apartment has been thoughtfully designed to transform everyday living into an elevated lifestyle, balancing functionality with sophisticated aesthetics.

projects.name: Merdan Residences
description: Merdan Residences is a contemporary residential tower developed by Evera Development, rising 21 storeys above the dynamic community of Dubai Sports City. Designed for a wide spectrum of residents — from young professionals and couples to growing families — the project brings together thoughtful architecture, practical living spaces, and a sought-after Dubai address at a competitive price point.

With 95 total units spread across studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, Merdan Residences strikes a balance between intimate community living and the conveniences of a well-equipped modern tower. Whether you're looking for a comfortable home or a promising investment, this development delivers on both fronts.

projects.name: Ghadeer at Expo Valley Views
description: Nestled within the prestigious Expo City Dubai, Ghadeer at Expo Valley Views represents a revolutionary approach to contemporary residential living. Developed by Expo City Dubai, this exceptional project seamlessly blends modern architectural excellence with the natural beauty of its surroundings, creating a harmonious living environment that caters to discerning families, professionals, and astute investors.

The development offers an impressive collection of thoughtfully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted to provide residents with an unparalleled lifestyle experience. With a starting price of AED 1,594,000 and flexible payment plans, Ghadeer presents an attractive early-entry opportunity in one of Dubai's most promising residential destinations, scheduled for completion in December 2029.

projects.name: Mahra
description: Mahra is a residential apartment community developed by Expo City Dubai, situated within the Expo Valley Views precinct of one of Dubai's most forward-thinking urban destinations. Designed for those who value clarity of space, connection to nature, and a well-considered lifestyle, Mahra offers 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments that balance contemporary design with everyday comfort.

Drawing on the legacy of Expo 2020, the development forms part of a larger master-planned smart city that continues to evolve as a vibrant hub for living, culture, and innovation. Mahra is not just a place to live — it is a carefully curated community built around green corridors, open skies, and a genuine sense of place.

projects.name: Roudah
description: Roudah is a thoughtfully conceived residential development by Expo City Dubai, set within the flourishing Expo Valley Views master community. Offering a curated selection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, Roudah is designed for residents who seek a lifestyle that balances contemporary comfort with an organic connection to green open spaces.

The development draws inspiration from the natural terrain around it, with architecture that respects its surroundings rather than competing with them. Earthy tones, considered material choices, and a layout that follows the land's natural contours give Roudah a character that feels rooted and enduring.

projects.name: Al Waha Residences
description: Al Waha Residences, developed by Expo Dubai Group, redefines luxury living in Expo City Dubai. This exclusive project integrates the legacy of Expo 2020 with modern urban design, offering a unique blend of sustainability and architectural brilliance.
Each unit features premium finishes, smart home integration, and spacious balconies with panoramic views.

projects.name: Al Waha Residences Phase 2 By Expo Dubai Group
description: Al Waha Residences Phase 2 is a luxurious residential project in Expo City Dubai, offering a sophisticated living experience. Designed with sustainability and innovation in mind, this development features 1 and 2-bedroom apartments and lofts, blending contemporary design with eco-friendly living in one of Dubai’s most visionary districts.

Al Waha Residences Phase 2 redefines luxury living with its sustainable design, world-class amenities, and prime location in Expo City Dubai. Combining smart home features with an eco-friendly lifestyle, this development offers an exceptional residential experience in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities.

projects.name: Dana Expo Valley Views

projects.name: Expo Valley Views

The community features 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom residences, thoughtfully designed to maximize space, natural light, and comfort. Each home reflects a commitment to environmental consciousness while providing residents with a sophisticated, modern living environment.

projects.name: Sidr Residences

Sidr Residences at Expo City Dubai is a community that fosters development, sustainability, and a high standard of living in addition to being a place to reside. For individuals looking for a well-rounded, contemporary, and progressive lifestyle, Sidr Residences provides the ideal setting with a range of housing options, cutting-edge amenities, and a prominent position in one of Dubai's most interesting districts.

projects.name: Sidr Residences Tower 2

projects.name: Sky Residences

projects.name: Treppan Tower

projects.name: Treppan Vision

Designed for those who want more than just a home, this development brings together residential comfort, professional workspaces, and ground-level retail — all within a single, thoughtfully planned structure.

Whether you are a first-time buyer, a growing family, or a seasoned investor looking to expand your portfolio in Dubai's real estate market, Treppan Vision presents a compelling opportunity to be part of a community that truly integrates how people live, work, and spend their daily lives.

projects.name: Vista Verde

projects.name: Flora Isle
description: Flora Isle, located on the stunning Dubai Islands, redefines luxury living with its harmonious blend of sophistication, serenity, and world-class amenities. Whether you're looking for a serene retreat, a family-friendly environment, or an investment opportunity, Flora Isle provides an unparalleled proposition.

projects.name: The Golf Residences

This prestigious 13-story building features a collection of exquisitely designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. Fortimo, renowned for its Swiss legacy of excellence in property development, brings its expertise and commitment to creating exceptional living spaces to Dubai.

The Golf Residences by Fortimo at Dubai Hills Estate sets a new standard for luxury living. With its prime location, exquisite design, and cutting-edge amenities, this development offers an unparalleled living experience. Whether you seek a spacious one-bedroom apartment or a luxurious three-bedroom home, The Golf Residences has something for everyone.

projects.name: Metropoint
description: Located in the heart of Downtown Jebel Ali, Metropoint by Forum Group sets a new standard for modern urban living. This mixed-use development seamlessly blends contemporary design, premium amenities, and strategic location to offer residents a truly exceptional lifestyle.

The project features thoughtfully designed residential units ranging from studios to 3-bedroom apartments, all crafted with premium finishes, intelligent layouts, and ample natural light. With prices starting from AED 527,250 and completion scheduled for December 2027, Metropoint offers an unmatched opportunity to secure a modern home in one of Dubai's fastest-growing districts.

projects.name: Regatta Residences
description: Regatta Residences is an upcoming residential development by Futura Edge in Dubai Islands, offering a collection of one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments. The project is planned around contemporary residential living, with thoughtfully designed spaces and a selection of facilities intended to support everyday comfort, recreation and relaxation.

projects.name: Elyra

The area features green spaces and pedestrian paths that provide residents with an open environment away from the city’s busy surroundings, while maintaining convenient access to essential facilities.

projects.name: California Residences
description: Rising in the heart of Dubailand, California Residences by GFH Real Estate sets a new standard for premium urban living. This thoughtfully planned development blends contemporary architecture with family-focused design, creating a sanctuary where modern comfort meets serene surroundings.

projects.name: Coventry Centro

The development pairs thoughtfully planned homes with premium office floors and lively retail areas, forming a self-contained community where daily needs are always within reach. A refined lobby welcomes residents and visitors, setting an immediate tone of quality and attention to detail.

projects.name: One Residence

With a starting price of AED 1.275 million, this freehold house is poised to redefine elegance and luxury in one of Dubai's most desirable locations.

projects.name: Courtyard One

Strategically positioned around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai, this master-planned district is designed to support a complete live-work-play environment.

projects.name: Golden Woods Albab Views

projects.name: Lateral One

With unit sizes ranging from efficient 440 square feet studios to expansive 2,750 square feet residences, Lateral One caters to diverse lifestyle requirements, from young professionals seeking their first home to growing families requiring spacious living…

description: Lumea Residence Dubai Islands embodies premium waterfront living, meticulously designed by Green Horizon Development to set new standards in Dubai’s real estate scene. This exceptional beachfront development features a curated collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each offering uninterrupted panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

Positioned against the backdrop of pristine waters and endless horizons, this development caters to homeowners and investors seeking premium waterfront properties. With its strategic location on Dubai Islands and thoughtful design approach, Lumea Residence balances seamless urban connectivity with tranquil coastal living.

projects.name: Luminous Coastal Living
description: Situated on the pristine Island A of Dubai Islands, Luminous Coastal Living by Green Horizon Development offers a rare blend of premium waterfront living and serene island charm. The low-density design ensures a peaceful and intimate environment, allowing residents to enjoy breathtaking sea views and a sense of exclusivity far removed from the city’s hustle and bustle.

projects.name: Meriden Beach
description: Set along the pristine coastline of Dubai Islands, Meriden Beach by Green Horizon Development offers an exceptional blend of island calm and Dubai’s urban energy. Its beachfront placement delivers direct access to soft sands and clear waters while maintaining smooth connectivity to prominent business and leisure destinations.

Meriden Beach features contemporary architecture enriched with tropical influences that celebrate its coastal surroundings. The design focuses on maximizing natural light, openness, and seamless transitions between indoor and outdoor spaces.

projects.name: Meriden Gate
description: Meriden Gate is a contemporary mixed-use residential development by Green Horizon Real Estate Development, located in Jebel Ali Industrial Second, one of Dubai's most strategically positioned districts. Designed to bring together the ease of modern living and the practicality of daily convenience, the project offers a curated selection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments above a vibrant ground-floor commercial space.

The interiors reflect a clear commitment to quality and thoughtful design. Italian porcelain flooring, quartz worktops, and custom feature walls create a refined atmosphere throughout each residence. Floor-to-ceiling windows invite generous natural light into every room, while fitted wardrobes, branded kitchen appliances, and integrated smart home technology ensure that daily life runs effortlessly.

projects.name: 77 Shades

projects.name: Joya Mimosa Residences
description: Introducing Joya Mimosa Residences, a luxurious 25-story residential skyscraper developed by Green Yard Properties. This stunning property offers modern and contemporary luxury apartments in the vibrant heart of Dubai Sports City, making it a beacon of beauty and grace in the skyline.

projects.name: Aris

Dubai South is one of the emirate's most ambitious master-planned communities, and for good reason. Covering a vast area around Al Maktoum International Airport, it has been designed from the ground up to support a full residential ecosystem — with schools, retail, parks, and employment hubs all woven into its fabric. projects.name: Enchante

projects.name: Sia

projects.name: Olaia Residences
description: Olaia Residences by Gulf House Real Estate is an ultra-luxury development redefining high-end living on Palm Jumeirah. Blending architectural excellence with modern sophistication, it offers an exclusive lifestyle with breathtaking views, premium amenities, and unparalleled comfort.
Spacious apartments with floor-to-ceiling windows, smart home technology, and high-end finishes, designed for the ultimate luxury living experience.

projects.name: Tonino Lamborghini Phase 2

projects.name: Veona

projects.name: One Beverly

projects.name: Eden Hills

projects.name: Peninsula Dubai Residences - Tower 1
