projects.name: Zyra Vista Residence
description: Zyra Vista Residence, a renowned residential property that raises the standard for urban luxury living, is proudly presented by Laraix Developers. Situated in the center of Al Warsan, this modern project combines lifestyle-focused amenities with contemporary architecture to appeal to affluent inhabitants looking for elegance, peace, and connectedness.

Zyra Vista Residence enjoys a strategic location in the burgeoning Al Warsan district, placing residents at the center of Dubai’s evolving infrastructure while maintaining a serene suburban environment.

projects.name: Lenjavi Diamond
description: Lenjawi Diamond is a thoughtfully designed residential development located in the heart of Al Warsan 4, Dubai. Comprising 92 residences across studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom configurations, the project sets a refined standard for contemporary urban living. Its exterior brings together glass facades, warm stone surfaces, and subtle gold detailing — a combination that feels both modern and welcoming.

From a sweeping double-height lobby to a rooftop infinity pool with open views of the Dubai skyline, Lenjawi Diamond offers residents an experience that goes beyond a standard apartment building. Every element has been designed to make daily life feel a little more considered.

projects.name: Green Wood Royal
description: Green Wood Royal by LEOS International sets a new benchmark for premium residential living in Umm Al Daman. This exclusive community blends contemporary architectural design with tranquil green spaces, offering families a perfect sanctuary without compromising on modern convenience or access to the city’s vibrant lifestyle.

Featuring 3 to 7-bedroom villas and townhouses, the development caters to those seeking spacious, elegant homes in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods. With completion scheduled for Q4 2028, buyers—both local and international—can secure freehold properties in a dynamic real estate market.

projects.name: Hadley Heights 2
description: Hadley Heights 2 represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential living in Dubai, masterfully crafted by the renowned LEOS International. This exceptional development offers 216 meticulously designed apartments alongside premium retail outlets, blending luxury, elegance, and functional design to meet the needs of modern families and professionals.

The development focuses on personalized living experiences, ensuring every resident enjoys the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and community. From the moment you step into this prestigious address, you’ll discover spaces where attention to detail meets innovative design, creating homes that are both sophisticated and inviting.

projects.name: Hadley Hills
description: Hadley Hills by Leos is a boutique residential project of 78 apartments in Warsan 4, Dubai, developed by Leos Developments. It offers 1, 2 and 3 bedroom homes.

The building is arranged around a landscaped podium. Apartments have a central courtyard with a swimming pool, a padel court and shaded seating, while the upper floors have rooftop gardens. Most homes open onto glass balconies. The light stone exterior gets warmth from timber-tone fins, and patterned screens cover the parking levels below.

projects.name: Kensington Gardens
description: Kensington Gardens is a distinguished residential communit, nestled in Greenwood – Dubai’s growing green oasis. This low-rise boutique community combines the elegance of British architecture and the serenity provided by expansive green landscapes. This new development is the perfect setting for families who want to live in luxury and tranquility.

Location Kensington Gardens is located just 16 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Residents can enjoy the best of both worlds: city proximity, and a peaceful retreat. The development is conveniently located near major highways including E311 & E611 and offers seamless connectivity to landmarks like Dubai Marina, Dubai International Airport, and Mall of the Emirates.

projects.name: Knightsbridge
description: Knightsbridge at Meydan District 11 stands as Dubai’s first climate-adaptive residential development by LEOS International. This groundbreaking project redefines opulence with a visionary approach to climate-adaptive design where luxury living meets environmental consciousness.

Knightsbridge is strategically situated in Meydan District 11, providing direct access to Dubai’s main highways, E66 and E311. This prime location ensures residents can easily connect to major hubs within the city while enjoying the tranquility of the suburban setting

projects.name: Knightsbridge Phase 2 By Leos
description: Knightsbridge 2 is a stunning new development by LEOS International, located in Dubai's renowned Meydan District 11. This exclusive property showcases luxury living with a perfect blend of contemporary architecture and opulent interiors. Designed to cater to a variety of tastes and preferences, Knightsbridge 2 is more than a residential community—it is a lifestyle statement.

Knightsbridge 2 is situated in one of Dubai's most sought-after neighborhoods, offering residents convenient access to the city's most iconic landmarks. Meydan, District 11, is celebrated for its world-class infrastructure, cutting-edge architecture, and seamless integration of modern technologies.

projects.name: Leos Royal
description: LEOS ROYAL introduces a new era of luxury living in Dubai’s emerging Umm Al Daman district. As the world’s first AI-powered residential community, this innovative development by LEOS International combines cutting-edge technology with serene design, creating a living environment where every detail works seamlessly to enhance comfort and wellbeing.

The community embraces the philosophy of reflection, where water, light, and space converge to create calming, restorative surroundings. Every element is intentionally crafted to support a balanced, intentional lifestyle in a city that never slows down.

projects.name: Weybridge Gardens Phase 2 By Leos
description: Weybridge Gardens 2 is LEOS Developments' brand-new residential development that sets a new standard for modern living. It is located in Dubai's bustling Dubailand district and combines contemporary design with timeless architecture. This community has a mix of studio, one- to three-bedroom apartments to suit a variety of lifestyles and preferences.

Weybridge Gardens 2 is strategically located off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, providing easy access to the entire city. Dubailand is known as the city's entertainment district, with a variety of services and amenities, including top medical and educational facilities.

projects.name: Weybridge Gardens Phase 4 By LEOS Properties
description: Weybridge Gardens Phase 4, located in Dubai's rapidly growing Dubailand district, sets a new standard in luxury living. Developed by LEOS International, this prestigious project combines modern urban design, comfort, and functionality, offering a unique living experience. This phase, the most ambitious of the Weybridge Gardens community, offers diverse apartment types to meet various lifestyle needs.
Each apartment type is designed with high-quality materials and finishes, including smart home technology and spacious layouts.

projects.name: Weybridge Gardens Phase 5 By Leos Developments
description: Weybridge Gardens Phase 5 by LEOS International is a distinguished residential development nestled in Dubai’s rapidly expanding Dubailand district. As the fifth phase of the acclaimed Weybridge Gardens series, this project elevates luxury living through its combination of sophisticated architecture, sustainable design, and an array of premium amenities.

Located strategically within the Dubai Land Residence Complex, Weybridge Gardens Phase 5 offers residents the best of both worlds — serene suburban tranquility and seamless connectivity to Dubai’s key hubs. Just 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai and close to major airports, highways, and public transport, it ensures easy access to the city’s commercial, entertainment, and educational centers.

projects.name: Lincoln Star Residence 2
description: Lincoln Star Residence 2 is a contemporary residential development by Lincoln Group, thoughtfully designed for those who seek refined urban living in one of Dubai's most promising districts. Rising across a basement, ground floor, four residential floors, and a rooftop, the building brings together clean architectural lines, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and a layout philosophy that prioritizes natural light, open space, and visual connection to the…

Situated within The Pulse community in Dubai South, Lincoln Star Residence 2 occupies a well-planned residential zone that has rapidly grown into one of the emirate's most sought-after addresses. The Pulse is a master-planned neighborhood designed around walkability, green spaces, and community living, offering residents a peaceful residential feel without sacrificing urban convenience.

projects.name: Lincoln Star Residence 3
description: Lincoln Star Residence 3 is the latest residential offering from Lincoln Group, a thoughtfully designed G+6 development situated in the fast-growing community of Dubai South. Comprising studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, this project brings together contemporary architecture and practical living spaces to create a home that genuinely works for its residents.

Dubai South, also known as Dubai World Central, is one of the emirate's most ambitious and strategically positioned urban districts. Designed as a city within a city, it spans over 145 square kilometres and encompasses residential, commercial, logistics, and aviation zones.

projects.name: Lincoln Star Residence 4
description: Lincoln Star Residence 4 is a contemporary residential development by Lincoln Star Real Estate Development, situated in the heart of Dubai South — one of Dubai's most strategically positioned and rapidly evolving districts. Designed to reflect the ambitions of modern urban living, this six-story building combines architectural clarity with thoughtfully crafted interiors to create a residence that feels as functional as it is refined.

Rising from a ground floor through five residential levels, the building presents a clean, geometric silhouette with panoramic glazing that frames views and floods interiors with natural light. Whether you are seeking a compact studio or a more spacious two-bedroom apartment, Lincoln Star Residence 4 offers a range of layouts designed to accommodate different lifestyles and needs — all delivered with a consistent attention to quality and comfort.

projects.name: Listone Residence
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai's vibrant International City, Listone Residence by Lion Stone Properties represents a perfect fusion of contemporary design, affordable luxury, and intelligent living solutions. This exceptional residential development offers discerning buyers an opportunity to experience elevated living without compromising on comfort or convenience.

The development features a thoughtfully curated selection of residential units, including stylish studios, elegant 1-bedroom apartments, and spacious 2-bedroom homes, each designed with practical layouts that maximize space utilization and enhance daily living experiences. Every unit comes fully furnished and equipped with cutting-edge smart home systems, ensuring residents enjoy modern convenience from day one.

projects.name: LIV Oceanside
description: LIV Oceanside stands as a symbol of premium waterfront living in Dubai, offering an extraordinary collection of residences that redefine coastal sophistication. Developed by LIV Developers, this exclusive project on Dubai Islands presents a unique opportunity to enjoy marina-side living with breathtaking sea views from every home.

The development features carefully crafted 1 to 4-bedroom residences, including signature duplexes and penthouses. Each home is designed to make the most of its waterfront position, allowing residents to enjoy tranquil waters, stunning sunrise and sunset views, and the iconic Dubai skyline—all from the comfort of their private terraces.

projects.name: LIV Maritime
description: LIV Maritime is an exclusive residential project in Dubai Maritime City by LIV Real Estate Development. It offers luxurious waterfront apartments paired with a sophisticated lifestyle. The residence offers a marina-inspired lifestyle with a focus on comfort and elegance. Its contemporary finishes, high-end amenities, and unparalleled location make it the ideal home for anyone looking to live an upscale waterfront lifestyle.

Nestled in Dubai Maritime City is LIV Maritime, a development that benefits from a prestigious waterfront living and rich maritime heritage. The development is located between Port Rashid, Dubai’s central business area, and the Sheikh Zayed Road. It offers easy access to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and major routes like Sheikh Zayed Road.

projects.name: La Boutique
description: La Boutique, the latest addition to LMD's Boutique series, redefines urban luxury in Dubai’s Al Jaddaf district. Tailored for both seasoned investors and residents seeking a modern, efficient lifestyle, La Boutique combines quality and innovation, creating a vibrant and cohesive community.
La Boutique balances home comforts with upscale amenities for a dynamic urban lifestyle.

projects.name: Taiyo Residences
description: Developed by the esteemed LMD, this residential marvel is set to redefine luxury living in one of Dubai's most strategic locations. With its name derived from the Japanese word "Taiyō" meaning "Sun," Taiyo Residences is poised to illuminate the lives of its residents with its thoughtful design, prime location, and unparalleled amenities.
Taiyo Residences is strategically located in the flourishing Wasl Gate community, offering residents unmatched access to Dubai’s major destinations while maintaining a tranquil lifestyle.

projects.name: Aeternitas
description: Aeternitas London Gate, a new landmark in Dubai Marina set to redefine luxury living. Developed by {dev}, this project is poised to become the tallest residential clock tower in the world. Aeternitas seamlessly blends sophistication, class, and lifestyle, offering an unparalleled living experience.

Aeternitas London Gate promises to set a new standard for luxury living in Dubai Marina. As the tallest residential clock tower in the world, this iconic development by {dev} blends sophistication with exceptional amenities, offering an unparalleled lifestyle. With a prime location boasting breathtaking views, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious address, residents will enjoy both tranquility and convenience.

projects.name: Franck Muller Vanguard
description: Franck Muller Vanguard, developed by London Gate Real Estate Development, is an ambitious residential project set to redefine luxury living in Dubai Marina. This magnificent 38-story residential building melds the precision of Swiss watchmaking with contemporary architectural elegance.

Vanguard Tower Dubai is set to become a landmark in Dubai Marina offering unparalleled luxury and convenience. With its prime location, unique architectural features, and high-end amenities, Vanguard Tower Dubai promises to deliver a superior living experience. Whether you're seeking a primary residence or an investment opportunity, it is poised to meet and exceed your expectations.

projects.name: Franck Muller Yachting
description: At the heart of Dubai Maritime City, Franck Muller Yachting delivers a unique blend of Swiss craftsmanship and premium waterfront living. Developed by London Gate, this iconic residential tower brings the artistry and precision of the legendary Franck Muller brand to life in a collection of exclusive apartments designed for those who value style, comfort, and sophistication.

Rising gracefully along the coast, the development translates the meticulous detail of fine watchmaking into architectural brilliance, creating a lifestyle that celebrates both elegance and function. This is more than a residence—it’s a statement for individuals who appreciate the finer aspects of luxury living.

projects.name: Lilian Residences
description: Located in the heart of Dubai South, Lilian Residences offers a premium residential lifestyle that blends contemporary design with functional comfort. This low-rise development by London Gate Real Estate features 66 carefully crafted units, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. With its G+1P+6F+Roof configuration, the project is set to redefine modern living when it completes in April 2028.

Designed to meet the needs of diverse lifestyles, Lilian Residences appeals to ambitious professionals seeking a stylish first home as well as growing families looking for spacious, modern accommodations. Each residence balances elegant design with practicality, creating a space where comfort and sophistication naturally coexist.

projects.name: Mi Casa
description: Mi Casa is a residential development by London Gate, located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. The project offers studios, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments designed for both end-users and investors. Units start from AED 750,000, with completion expected in December 2027.

Mi Casa sits within JVC, one of Dubai's most consistently popular mid-market residential communities. The neighbourhood is pedestrian-friendly, well-maintained, and home to a growing mix of cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, and retail outlets. Several quality schools and nurseries operate within and around JVC, making it a practical choice for families.

projects.name: Grosvenor House
description: Drosvenor House by Lotus Living Properties introduces a contemporary residential development in Dubai South, Dubai, designed to bring together modern architecture, practical layouts and comfortable everyday living. Rising across a ground floor and four upper floors, the development comprises 51 apartments, creating a relatively intimate residential setting.

Located in Dubai South, Grosvenor House benefits from its position within a district planned around residential communities, commercial activity and major transportation infrastructure. Dubai South continues to attract attention from homebuyers and property investors interested in the expansion of southern Dubai.

projects.name: Santorini Residences by Loutraki
description: Santorini Residences by Loutraki is a new residential property in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Dubai. Loutraki Real Estate LLC developed this off-plan project, which features a mix of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments built for elegance and peace.
Easy Access to Major Roads: Close to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) for easy commuting.

projects.name: La Vue Residence
description: La Vue Residence, developed by Maaia Developers, is a luxury residential project in Dubai’s prestigious Nad Al Sheba Gardens. Combining sophisticated design with modern living, it offers elegant apartments that blend comfort, style, and smart home technology. This development caters to professionals, families, and investors seeking upscale urban living in a tranquil environment with easy access to Dubai’s key hubs.

Situated in the serene Nad Al Sheba Gardens community, La Vue Residence benefits from lush green spaces and a peaceful ambiance. Its strategic location offers quick connectivity to Sheikh Mohammad Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road, linking residents to major business districts, top schools, healthcare facilities, and popular shopping destinations.

projects.name: Aizel Tower
description: Aizel Tower rises in the heart of International City, offering a calm and thoughtfully designed place to call home. The 6-storey development reflects a blend of modern structure and timeless elegance, creating an environment where residents can unwind, work, and live with ease.

At the heart of the design is a focus on openness and clarity. Wide windows welcome natural light, while practical layouts ensure every corner of the home serves a purpose. From the inviting lobby to the peaceful rooftop terraces, the tower encourages a calm rhythm of life within a bustling city.

projects.name: MAAK Residence
description: MAAK Residence embodies modern urban sophistication, perfectly positioned in the heart of Dubai South. This premium development offers a curated collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments designed for residents who value comfort, style, and thoughtful living. Every detail is carefully crafted to transform daily life into an elevated lifestyle experience.

From the moment you step inside, MAAK Residence welcomes you with naturally lit spaces and sweeping views of Dubai’s dynamic skyline. The development is more than a residence—it’s a destination that turns ordinary moments into extraordinary ones.

projects.name: Azurline Residences
description: At the heart of Dubai's vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Azurline Residences by MAAS Developers presents a new standard of premium urban living. Inspired by the fluidity of water and the natural beauty of Dubai, this development combines contemporary design with serene residential tranquility, offering an elevated lifestyle within reach of the city's dynamic energy.

The collection includes thoughtfully designed studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. Each residence is a sanctuary of comfort and style, where curved architectural lines, earthy tones, and natural light come together to create an inviting, sophisticated environment.

projects.name: Mada’in Tower
description: Mada'in Properties introduces Mada'in Tower, a new landmark in Dubai Marina that will redefine luxury living. This architectural marvel will be one of the area's tallest residential towers, featuring a variety of exclusive 1 and 2 bedroom apartments, 3 and 4 bedroom duplexes, and 5 bedroom mansions. Mada'in Tower, with its strategic location and breathtaking views, exemplifies sophisticated urban living.

Mada'in Tower, developed by Mada'in Properties, is expected to be a crown jewel in the Dubai Marina skyline. It provides a one-of-a-kind living environment by combining luxury, convenience, and breathtaking views. Whether you want a cozy one-bedroom apartment or a luxurious five-bedroom mansion, Mada'in Tower has something for you.

projects.name: Eiwan Heights
description: Eiwan Heights is a prestigious residential development located in the heart of Meydan Horizon, Dubai, developed by MAG Property Development. The project offers luxurious living spaces, modern architecture, and a comprehensive array of amenities, setting a new standard for high-end living in Dubai.
Eiwan Heights offers a blend of luxury, convenience, and sustainability, making it a strong investment and ideal home for anyone seeking modern urban living in Dubai.

projects.name: MAG D11
description: MAG D11, developed by the renowned MAG Property Development, is a modern residential masterpiece located in Dubai's dynamic Meydan district. The development stands as a beacon of contemporary living, offering luxury and comfort while being strategically positioned for seamless access to key destinations in the city.
Residents can enjoy both the tranquility of suburban living and the convenience of being near Dubai's vibrant business districts and entertainment hubs.

projects.name: Mag 330
description: MAG 330 is a spectacular new property created by MAG Property Development that offers a unique living experience in the heart of the City of Arabia, Dubailand. MAG 330's 23-story residential tower offers magnificent studios, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments built to meet the different demands of its occupants. The complex is distinguished by its high-quality designs, creative functioning, and variety of world-class facilities.
This strategic location guarantees that homeowners may live a balanced lifestyle, with all required amenities and entertainment opportunities right outside their door.

projects.name: Mag Keturah Reserve
description: In the prestigious MBR City District 7, MAG Property presents Keturah Reserve, a remarkable new development that harmoniously blends contemporary architecture with organic features. This premium selection of residential villa plots is designed to foster a peaceful living environment, promoting well-being and a close connection with nature.

Keturah Reserve is strategically located in Mohammed Bin Rashid City District 7, offering residents easy access to many of Dubai's most popular landmarks and tourist destinations. This unique positioning allows residents to enjoy a tranquil, natural setting while being close to the vibrant city life.

projects.name: MBL Signature
description: MBL Signature by MAG Property Development introduces a new era of luxury living in the prestigious Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT). This cutting-edge residential development blends modern architecture, prime location, and state-of-the-art amenities to deliver an unparalleled lifestyle experience in Dubai's thriving urban landscape.
Surrounded by retail shops, educational institutions, and a vibrant culinary scene, this development ensures a seamless balance of work, leisure, and relaxation.

projects.name: Tori by IGO
description: This premium community redefines upscale family living with its contemporary architectural design, spacious layouts, and thoughtfully curated amenities. As a prestigious addition to Dubai’s dynamic property market, Tori by IGO offers a private and tranquil environment for families seeking comfort, elegance, and connectivity in one of the city’s fastest-growing residential districts.

Located within Al Furjan, Tori by IGO enjoys a strategic position that provides residents with seamless access to Dubai’s main business hubs, leisure destinations, and transport links. Al Furjan is known for its established infrastructure, vibrant community feel, and increasing demand among families and professionals.

projects.name: Flow Residences
description: On the A-Island of the Dubai Islands, Flow Residences by Main Realty is a boutique coastal development that provides a luxurious lifestyle characterized by elegance, tranquility, and contemporary refinement. This limited-edition neighborhood, which consists of just 50 distinctive villas spread across six stories, combines Dubai's upscale sensibilities with Miami-inspired design.

Perfectly situated on A-Island within the ambitious Dubai Islands masterplan, Flow Residences offers more than just beautiful sea views. This premium location delivers unparalleled convenience and access, blending nature and city life in one dynamic coastal setting.

projects.name: Primero Residences
description: Welcome to Primero Residences, Main Realty's exquisite residential development that brings Miami-inspired luxury to Al Furjan in Dubai. This is more than just a place to live; it's a place to grow. Primero Residences, with its mix of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments and spacious three-bedroom duplexes, establishes a new standard for upscale living in one of Dubai's most vibrant neighborhoods.

Discovery Gardens, Garden View Villas, and Al Furjan are all connected by a 40-kilometer cycle track. This ensures that residents have plenty of opportunities for recreation, exercise, and social interaction.

projects.name: Amara
description: Amara, developed by Majid Al Futtaim, offers an unparalleled lifestyle thanks to its prominent position, unique design, and abundance of amenities. Whether you value peace and quiet, modern conveniences, or a blend of both, Amara is the ideal place to call home.

Amara is a premium housing development located in Dubai's elite Tilal Al Ghaf neighborhood. This prestigious residential community aims to provide a magnificent lifestyle, surrounded by nature and modern amenities.

projects.name: Arista
description: Arista at Ghaf Woods is a pioneering venture into Dubai's real estate market, spearheaded by Majid Al Futtaim, a developer known for innovative and sustainable projects. Arista, located in the center of the exclusive Ghaf Woods development, provides premium apartments that combine the peacefulness of nature with the elegance of urban sophistication.

Majid Al Futtaim's Arista at Ghaf Woods is more than just a residential development; it represents sustainable luxury living. Arista's unique woodland living concept, outstanding location benefits, and community-oriented architecture create a beautiful blend of nature and modernity.

projects.name: Bo Monde
description: Bo Monde is an exclusive collection of 13 opulent mansions developed by Majid Al Futtaim, located in the prestigious Tilal Al Ghaf community. Designed to offer a luxurious living experience, these mansions combine architectural excellence with an idyllic setting, making them an ideal choice for the most discerning buyers.

Bo Monde offers a unique opportunity to own a luxury mansion in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities. With its unmatched design, prime location, and exclusive amenities, it is the ultimate living experience for those seeking privacy, comfort, and a lavish lifestyle.

projects.name: Capria East
description: Capria East, developed by Majid Al Futtaim, is a groundbreaking eco-luxury residential project in Ghaf Woods, Dubailand. This sustainable community blends modern design with nature, offering an exclusive lifestyle surrounded by lush greenery.
Located in Dubailand’s Ghaf Woods, Capria East provides a peaceful retreat with easy access to major landmarks, urban conveniences, and future infrastructure enhancements.

projects.name: Capria West
description: Capria West at Ghaf Woods is a visionary residential project by Majid Al Futtaim, blending modern luxury with nature’s tranquility. Located in Dubai Land, this second phase of the Ghaf Woods development offers sustainable, nature-inspired living within a thriving urban setting.

Capria West at Ghaf Woods redefines urban living with sustainability, architectural excellence, and a vibrant community-focused lifestyle. Perfect for those seeking an exclusive residence that harmonizes modern luxury with nature’s serenity.

projects.name: Cilia At Ghaf Woods
description: Cilia at Ghaf Woods is the latest residential venture by Majid Al Futtaim, setting a new benchmark in Dubai's real estate market. This pioneering project introduces the concept of "forest living" to Dubailand, offering a serene and nature-infused lifestyle for prospective homeowners.

Cilia at Ghaf Woods is more than just a residential project; it is a lifestyle choice that offers a unique blend of nature and modernity. With its prime location, diverse housing options, and a plethora of amenities, it stands out as an ideal choice for families and individuals seeking a harmonious living environment.

projects.name: Distrikt at Ghaf Woods
description: Distrikt at Ghaf Woods is a pioneering residential project by Majid Al Futtaim, seamlessly blending the serenity of nature with the sophistication of modern urban living. Situated in the heart of the Ghaf Woods community, this development embraces biophilic design and eco-conscious living, offering an elevated lifestyle within Dubai’s most visionary green enclave.

Strategically positioned in Dubai Land, Distrikt at Ghaf Woods offers residents exceptional connectivity while maintaining a peaceful forest-inspired retreat. The development ensures seamless access to vital parts of the city through key road networks.

projects.name: Lacina By Majid Al Futtaim
description: Majid Al Futtaim proudly presents Lacina, a luxurious new development that seamlessly blends contemporary living with the tranquility of nature. Located within the scenic Ghaf Woods, Lacina offers a distinctive lifestyle that harmonizes modern conveniences with the serene beauty of its forest-like surroundings.

Situated at the east end of the Ghaf Woods community, Lacina enjoys an enviable position with easy access to key areas of Dubai. Positioned between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street, Lacina ensures that residents have quick and efficient access to Dubai's vibrant attractions, shopping hubs, business centers, and leisure spots.

projects.name: Plagette 32 at Tilal Al Ghaf
description: Majid Al Futtaim, a household name in the UAE real estate industry, has announced its newest project: Plagette 32, an exclusive residential neighbourhood nestled in the heart of Tilal Al Ghaf. This unique neighbourhood showcases a combination of 28 townhome style Club Villas and four bungalow style Water Bungalows, forming an idyllic oasis of calm and luxury.

Situated in the tranquil and up and coming area of Tilal Al Ghaf, Plagette 32 offers the perfect balance between city life and serene living. Residents will enjoy the convenience of being close to the city while benefiting from a truly holistic living experience that combines luxury, leisure, and nature.

projects.name: Serenity Mansions
description: Serenity Mansions at Tilal Al Ghaf is the latest luxury development from Majid Al Futtaim, showcasing an exclusive collection of 5,6 and 7 bedrooms mansions that define opulence and sophistication. With three distinctive design styles—Luna, Ayla, and Ara—crafted by internationally renowned architects, Serenity Mansions offers residents an unparalleled experience of luxury, tranquility, and connectivity in Dubai.

Serenity Mansions is more than a residence; it’s a lifestyle offering unmatched luxury and peace at the heart of Tilal Al Ghaf. With its prime location, sophisticated design, and array of amenities, this development by Majid Al Futtaim is set to be one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential destinations. Embrace a life of luxury, exclusivity, and tranquility at Serenity Mansions.

projects.name: Serra at Ghaf Woods
description: Serra at Ghaf Woods by Majid Al Futtaim brings an oasis of luxury and tranquility to Dubai. Located in the master-planned Ghaf Woods community, this exclusive apartment complex offers one, two, and three-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, modern amenities, and premium finishes for an elevated living experience.
This prime location offers both convenience and a vibrant community lifestyle, perfect for those looking to balance peaceful living with city accessibility.

projects.name: Arlington Park
description: Developed by the esteemed Majid Developments, this residential enclave is set to redefine luxury living in Dubai, offering a harmonious lifestyle that caters to the discerning tastes of today's urban dwellers.

Arlington Park is more than just a residential development; it's a lifestyle destination that promises to elevate the everyday experiences of its residents. With its thoughtful design, prime location, and array of world-class amenities, Arlington Park stands as a testament to Majid Developments' commitment to creating spaces that inspire, nurture, and enrich lives.

projects.name: Arlington Park Phase 2
description: Arlington Park Phase 2 is a residential development by Majid Developments that brings together thoughtful design, practical living spaces, and a genuine sense of community in one of Dubai's most accessible districts. Set within Dubai Land Residence Complex, this project is tailored for those who want the comfort of a quiet, well-managed home without sacrificing proximity to the city's most important destinations.

Whether you are a first-time buyer, a growing family, or an investor looking for strong rental demand, Arlington Park Phase 2 offers a compelling mix of affordability, quality, and location that is difficult to find elsewhere in Dubai.

projects.name: Jura Terraces
description: Jura Terraces is a distinctive residential development by Majid Developments, drawing its identity from the natural grandeur of the Jura Mountains — their sweeping plateaus, layered terrain, and quiet, commanding presence. This is a place where architecture and landscape work in conversation, giving residents a living environment that feels grounded yet elevated, calm yet alive with character.

From the moment you arrive, the design language speaks clearly: soft curves, natural materials, generous light, and spaces that invite you to slow down. Every detail has been considered with daily life in mind — not just the grand moments, but the quiet mornings, the evening walks, and the sense of coming home to somewhere that genuinely feels like yours.

projects.name: Saddlewood Park
description: Nestled in the prestigious Nad Al Sheba 1 district, Saddlewood Park represents the pinnacle of luxury residential living in Dubai. This exclusive boutique development by MAK Developers offers a rare collection of just 61 meticulously crafted apartments and penthouses, each designed to embody the perfect fusion of equestrian elegance and contemporary sophistication.

The Elite's Collection features thoughtfully designed 1 to 4-bedroom residences that cater to discerning homeowners seeking privacy, comfort, and prestige. Set for completion in September 2027, this low-rise community promises to redefine luxury living through its innovative blend of wellness-focused amenities, AI-powered smart home technology, and breathtaking design elements that pay homage to Dubai's rich equestrian heritage.

projects.name: Manam Pearl
description: Situated in the heart of Dubai’s prestigious Al Furjan district, Manam Pearl embodies modern residential sophistication, offering a premium lifestyle for families and investors alike. Developed by Manam Real Estate Development, this project combines contemporary architecture with thoughtful urban planning to create a refined community where comfort, style, and convenience meet.

projects.name: Arka Enclave Residences

description: Aurum is a rare expression of refined urban living - intelligently positioned, and quietly distinguished. This is a residence for those who choose proximity with privacy, and value with permanence.

Aurum offers rare access without compromise. It’s Dubai at your doorstep, but not at your window. Only moments from Sheikh Zayed Road, and within a 10-minute radius of Dubai’s finest Hospitals, universities, innovation districts, beaches, and three major malls – all within 10 minutes. Yet from within, there is only sheer bliss. That is the true luxury.

projects.name: Park Boulevard
description: Meteora Developers' Park Boulevard in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a landmark property that epitomises Dubai's luxurious lifestyle. This meticulously constructed complex offers a selection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, all designed to the highest standards of grandeur and comfort. Park Boulevard redefines sophisticated urban living with premium finishes, high ceilings, and complementary parking.
Park Boulevard is strategically located within the thriving JVC community, ensuring easy access to the city's major attractions.

projects.name: Viani by Meteora
description: Viani by Meteora brings a fresh sense of city comfort to Dubai’s Liwan district, offering a contemporary lifestyle shaped around smart design, convenience, and community warmth. Rising gracefully within Dubai Land, the development blends modern architecture with a calm residential setting, creating homes that feel open, practical, and naturally inviting.
With its collection of , 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom 3-bedroom apartments, the tower caters to residents who want efficient layouts, premium finishes, and city views woven into their daily routine.

projects.name: Vita Grande
description: Vita Grande standing tall at 250 feet is an epitome of elevated privileges. This 19 storey marvel developed by Meteora Developers is set to redefine the skyline of Jumeirah Village Circle Dubai. Vita Grande isn't merely a residential building but a vibrant community that tells of an epic triad of stories those of its predecessors The East Crest and 7 Park Central, and its own.

Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, Vita Grande enjoys a prime location. Its residents will experience the best of Dubai, with a plethora of dining, shopping and entertainment options at their doorstep. The project is strategically located to provide easy access to major highways making commuting in and around the city a breeze.

projects.name: Vivanti Residences
description: Vivanti Residences by Meteora Developers redefines urban luxury in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), blending biophilic design, smart home technology, and sustainability. With a striking façade integrating green elements, this high-rise development offers a sophisticated lifestyle with modern conveniences. The expected delivery date is Sep 1, 2028.

Vivanti Residences embodies a future-forward lifestyle, combining luxury, sustainability, and cutting-edge technology. Offering a unique living experience in JVC, it is an exceptional opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.

projects.name: Leven Residences
description: Metrical Real Estate Development proudly presents Leven Residences, an exciting new residential project that promises to redefine modern living in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Dubai. This ambitious development combines sleek architectural design, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location to create a truly exceptional living experience for its residents.

Metrical Real Estate Development's dedication to quality and innovation in the Dubai real estate market is demonstrated by Leven Residences. An easily identifiable landmark in the JVT skyline, this multi-story structure boasts a distinctive facade that combines earthy tones with contemporary styling.

projects.name: SVN Residences
description: SVN Residences by Metrical is a contemporary residential development in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, offering a collection of stylish studios and one-bedroom apartments designed for modern urban living. The 19-storey tower combines elegant architecture with practical layouts, creating homes that prioritize comfort, natural light, and everyday functionality.

Designed with clean architectural lines, premium materials, and spacious interiors, SVN Residences delivers a refined residential experience that balances privacy with convenience. Its location within JVC allows residents to enjoy a peaceful neighborhood while remaining close to Dubai's major business, retail, and entertainment destinations.

projects.name: The Vyne Residence
description: Welcome to The Vyne Residences, a stunning new project by Metrical Real Estate Development. This premier 23 storey residential building is poised to redefine modern and luxurious living in the lively community of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Dubai. With meticulously designed apartments, state of the art amenities, and strategic location, The Vyne Residences promises an unparalleled lifestyle experience.

Situated in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle, The Vyne Residences offers residents prime connectivity and easy access to major highways, making travel across Dubai seamless. JVT is renowned for its balanced mix of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, providing a harmonious environment for its residents. The strategic location means that residents are never far from the city's key attractions, business hubs, and entertainment venues.

projects.name: Allegro Park
description: Located within the prestigious Dubai Islands, Allegro Park offers a premium residential sanctuary combining modern sophistication with the tranquility of waterfront living. Developed by Mill Hill Riviera Development, this community presents an exquisite collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and penthouses, each thoughtfully designed to balance comfort, elegance, and serenity.

With prices starting from AED 2000000, this freehold development provides a rare opportunity for homeowners and investors to claim a prestigious address in one of Dubai's most sought-after destinations.

projects.name: Mira villas
description: Mira Villas at Meydan, Mira Development's magnificent development located just a few kilometers from the renowned Burj Khalifa. This spectacular new property provides the ideal balance of luxury, comfort, and convenience, as well as breathtaking views of Dubai's skyline. Mira Villas aims to provide outstanding value, whether you're looking for a dream home or an incredible investment opportunity.
Mira Villas provides a variety of home alternatives to meet various requirements. The project is mostly made up of big 5-bedroom villas that have been built to provide optimum comfort and elegance.

projects.name: Richmond District
description: Richmond District is a landmark residential project by Mira Developments that redefines what urban living looks like in Dubai. Located in the heart of Al Furjan, this development brings together five residential buildings and a dedicated office tower, all connected through a shared podium featuring retail outlets, wellness spaces, and premium leisure facilities.

Al Furjan has steadily grown into one of Dubai's most desirable residential communities, and Richmond District sits comfortably at its centre. The neighbourhood strikes a balance that is increasingly rare in a city that moves as fast as Dubai it feels genuinely liveable while remaining fully connected to the broader metropolitan fabric.

projects.name: Trussardi Residences
description: Mira Developments proudly presents Trussardi Residences, a new project that embodies luxury living. This 11-story tower, located in Dubai's vibrant Al Furjan neighbourhood, combines classical Italian aesthetics with a modern flair. The Trussardi brand adds an exclusive touch by providing fully furnished interiors featuring pieces from the prestigious Trussardi Casa collection.

Trussardi Residences, located in Al Furjan, has a prime location that provides residents with the best of both worlds: proximity to the bustling city life and serene surroundings. The Discovery Gardens metro station is nearby, providing convenient access to the rest of Dubai.

projects.name: Trussardi Residences Phase 2 By Mira Developments
description: Mira Developments proudly presents Trussardi Residences Phase 2, an exquisite addition to Dubai’s luxury real estate landscape. Following the success of its predecessor, this second phase redefines branded residences, blending Italian sophistication with contemporary Dubai living. Located in Al Furjan, this architectural masterpiece sets a new benchmark for upscale urban living.

Trussardi Residences Phase 2 is an icon of luxury living, combining sophisticated Italian craftsmanship with Dubai’s vibrant real estate landscape. Set in the thriving Al Furjan district, this development offers unmatched elegance, seamless connectivity, and premium amenities. As demand for branded residences continues to rise, Trussardi Residences Phase 2 stands as a prime investment opportunity and an extraordinary place to call home.

projects.name: Numa Reserve
description: Set in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Numa Reserve brings together refined architecture and a peaceful residential setting. Positioned within the distinguished District 11, the community is shaped for residents who value privacy, comfort, and direct access to Dubai’s key destinations.

Numa Reserve sits in a location that strikes a balance between calm residential living and proximity to Dubai’s major hubs. Just minutes from the city’s business, cultural, and entertainment centers, the community benefits from smooth mobility and strong infrastructural links.

projects.name: Numa Villas
description: Situated in the prestigious Meydan area of Dubai, Numa Villas offers a rare opportunity to experience premium living in one of the city’s most dynamic neighborhoods. Developed by Mirfa IBC Developers, this exclusive collection of just 35 standalone villas combines architectural brilliance, private comfort, and exceptional amenities, making it a standout in Dubai’s luxury property market.
Designed for those with discerning tastes, each villa blends privacy, functionality, and premium design to create a serene retreat in the heart of Meydan.

projects.name: Stories
description: Stories by Mirfa IBC Developers is a thoughtfully crafted residential development located in Dubai South, one of the emirate's most strategically positioned and rapidly growing communities. Offering studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments across six elegantly designed floors, Stories presents 100 carefully planned homes that blend comfort, natural light, and contemporary aesthetics into a seamless living experience.

Every residence within Stories is designed around the philosophy that a home should feel expansive, warm, and effortlessly livable. Open-plan layouts allow natural light to flow freely through each unit, creating bright and airy interiors that feel larger than their dimensions suggest. Premium quality materials, neutral tones, and textured finishes come together to deliver a refined atmosphere that suits both singles and growing families.

projects.name: 27 East End Garden Residences
description: 27 East End Garden Residences, developed by Mirha Homes Real Estate Development, is a new residential project in International City Phase 3, Dubai. With its modern 7-storey design and lush surroundings, it offers luxurious living spaces and exceptional amenities, redefining urban living in one of Dubai's fastest-growing neighborhoods.

Located in the vibrant International City Phase 3, the development offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s key landmarks, including Dragon Mart, Dubai International Airport, and Downtown Dubai, all within short driving distances.

projects.name: Wael Residences
description: MMM Developments presents Wael Residences, a new residential development at Dubai Islands, offering waterfront residences with outstanding features & facilities. This development blends the best possible setting for family-friendly living with the best possible luxury in one of Dubai’s most ambitious coastal destinations.

The architecture of the development features an eye-catching design with glass facade and provides generous outdoor spaces. A wide area within the development provides sufficient spaces for amenities, social gatherings and recreational activities.

projects.name: Vio Residences
description: At the heart of Dubai International City, Vio Residences introduces a refined take on contemporary urban living. Developed by Modelux Real Estate Development, the project focuses on smart design, visual simplicity, and attainable pricing. With completion scheduled for December 2026, it reflects a thoughtful balance between comfort, practicality, and long-term value.

Perfectly designed for individuals, couples, and families, these homes combine modern interiors with efficient layouts. The established neighborhood setting also adds appeal for investors seeking consistent rental demand within Dubai’s evolving property market.

projects.name: Symbolic Zen Residences
description: Rooted in the philosophy of balance, mindfulness, and tranquility, this mixed-use residential tower fuses contemporary design with zen principles to create a serene sanctuary within the city. The project features a basement, retail and communal ground floor, two podiums, 16 residential levels, and a leisure-focused rooftop.
Nestled in the evolving Al Furjan district, Symbolic Zen Residences benefits from a strategic and accessible location that perfectly balances connectivity and calm.

projects.name: Interstellar Tower
description: Interstellar Tower at Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is a premium class development where urban living meets elegance, by Mr. Eight Development with exclusive 2 and 3-bedroom suites in Dubai. Rising 29 storey high, this exceptional development redefines luxury with 236 meticulously designed residences with unmatched comfort.

projects.name: Le Chateau Piétrus
description: Le Chateau Piétrus by Mr Eight Development is a boutique waterfront residential project located at Dubai Islands, offering an exclusive collection of premium residences designed for modern coastal living. The development features a limited number of elegantly crafted homes with spacious layouts, sophisticated interiors, and panoramic marina views.

Combining contemporary architecture with exceptional attention to detail, Le Chateau Piétrus creates a refined residential environment for homeowners seeking a prestigious waterfront address. With its prime marina-front setting and premium residential offering, the development appeals to both end-users and investors looking for long-term value in one of Dubai's emerging coastal destinations.

projects.name: The WOW Tower
description: Standing tall within Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), The WOW Tower introduces a bold new residential landmark. Its striking design instantly catches the eye, giving the building a presence that stands apart from surrounding developments

This high-rise project combines contemporary architecture with carefully designed homes that prioritize comfort and practicality. As the tallest structure in the DLRC area, the tower offers sweeping views across the surrounding community and beyond.

projects.name: Villa del Arte
description: Villa del Arte on Dubai Islands, developed by Mr. Eight Development, sets a new benchmark for premium waterfront living. This 11-storey residential tower blends contemporary architecture with artistic sophistication through a collaboration with British design icon Tom Dixon.

Featuring 64 meticulously designed units, including 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, Villa del Arte combines aesthetic elegance with functional comfort. With completion scheduled for December 2027 and starting prices from AED 1800000, it offers a rare opportunity to own a piece of Dubai’s most coveted waterfront real estate.

projects.name: Villa Del Brunello
description: Villa Del Brunello redefines premium waterfront living on Dubai Islands. Developed by Mr Eight Development, this exceptional project blends contemporary design with the serene beauty of the Arabian Gulf, offering homes that balance sophistication, comfort, and location advantages.

Featuring 2 to 4-bedroom apartments and duplexes, each residence is meticulously designed to maximize natural light, space, and functionality. With prices starting at AED 5,100,000 and completion scheduled for December 2027, Villa Del Brunello presents a rare opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.

projects.name: Villa del DIVOS
description: Villa del DIVOS at Dubai Islands is the new pristine residential development by Mr. Eight Development lined with premium selection of waterfront villas. This exceptional development harmonizes coastal serenity with urban sophistication, offering residents a unique beachfront lifestyle. With stunning sea views and a perfect blend of relaxation and excitement, it is an invitation to experience the best of coastal living.

projects.name: Villa Del Garda
description: Villa Del Garda by Mr. Eight Development represents the pinnacle of luxury waterfront living, offering an exclusive first-row serviced boutique residence that captures breathtaking panoramic views of the Marina and the Arabian Gulf.

Set against the stunning backdrop of Dubai Islands, Villa Del Garda creates an atmosphere of effortless luxury from the moment residents arrive. Each residence is meticulously designed to maximize the serene coastal experience, with direct sea views that transform daily living into a continuous retreat.

projects.name: Villa del Gavi
description: Villa del Gavi is a landmark coastal development by Mr Eight Development, perfectly positioned along the tranquil shores of Dubai Islands, formerly known as Deira Islands. This luxurious residential destination redefines seaside elegance, offering an exclusive blend of waterfront serenity and cosmopolitan access.

Strategically located in the heart of Dubai Islands, Villa del Gavi enjoys unmatched access and natural beauty. This premier address not only captures panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline but also places residents within reach of the city's top destinations.

projects.name: Sea Legend One
description: Sea Legend One is a 15-story residential tower developed by MVS Real Estate Development, redefining waterfront living in one of Dubai's most coveted locations, within the Nakheel master-planned community in Dubai Islands. This project blends urban sophistication with serene coastal charm.

Sea Legend One promises an unparalleled living experience in a stunning waterfront location, offering a luxurious lifestyle with world-class amenities, making it a prime investment for those seeking the best of Dubai living.

projects.name: Avenue Residence Phase 7 By Nabni
description: Avenue Residence 7 by NABNI REAL ESTATE DEVELOPMENT L.L.C is the latest addition to Al Furjan a thriving community in Dubai known for its blend of residential convenience and luxury living. Offering a range of contemporary apartments and world-class amenities Avenue Residence Phase 7 By Nabni redefines modern urban living with its elegant design and prime location.

Avenue Residence Phase 7 By Nabni is located in the highly sought-after Al Furjan district offering a blend of convenience and tranquility. Residents enjoy proximity to major highways and easy access to public transport.

projects.name: Avenue Residence 8
description: Avenue Residence 8 by NABNI Real Estate Development is a landmark residential project in Al Furjan, Dubai, redefining urban luxury with contemporary design and premium amenities. Strategically located, it offers a sophisticated lifestyle for discerning residents and investors.

Avenue Residence 8 offers a variety of apartments designed for spacious and modern living. Options may include 1-3 bedroom units with high-quality finishes, private balconies, and luxurious interiors.

projects.name: Bay Estate
description: Bay Estate by Nakheel Properties represents the most exclusive chapter yet in the ongoing transformation of Dubai Islands. Launching as the first residential community on Island E — the most prestigious and ultra-low-density island in the entire masterplan — Bay Estate sets a compelling new standard for coastal living in Dubai.

Offering a refined collection of 3 to 7-bedroom townhouses and villas, Bay Estate introduces the Bay Villas series to a stretch of coastline that has been deliberately kept low in density to preserve its sense of calm and exclusivity. Whether you are seeking a stylish townhouse or a grand beachfront estate, every home here is designed around the idea that luxury should feel effortless — not performative.

projects.name: Bay Estate Agora
description: Bay Estate Agora is a carefully crafted residential development by Nakheel Properties, offering a refined collection of townhouses and villas set within the prestigious Bay Estate community on Dubai Islands. Designed for those who value both comfort and connection to the water, this development brings together thoughtful architecture, generous living spaces, and a vibrant island atmosphere in one of Dubai's most exciting coastal destinations.

Positioned on Dubai Islands — a transformative waterfront destination off the Deira coastline — Bay Estate Agora places residents at the heart of one of the emirate's most ambitious urban expansions. The Bay Estate cluster within Dubai Islands has been designed as an exclusive residential enclave where the sea is always within reach.

projects.name: Bay Estate Cala
description: Bay Estate Cala is a distinguished residential development by Nakheel Properties, offering a curated collection of townhouses and villas set along the pristine waterfront of Dubai Islands. Conceived for those who seek privacy without sacrificing vibrancy, this community blends resort-inspired living with the energy of one of Dubai's most exciting new destinations.

Positioned within the Bay Estate precinct of Dubai Islands, Bay Estate Cala occupies one of the most desirable addresses in the emirate. Dubai Islands is a master-planned archipelago off the coast of Deira, transforming into a destination that combines beachfront living, leisure, and culture.

projects.name: Bay Estate Verda
description: Bay Estate Verda is a carefully crafted residential development by Nakheel Properties, situated along the pristine coastline of Dubai Islands. Conceived as a low-density beachfront community, this project brings together a refined selection of townhouses and villas designed to offer a genuine resort-style living experience without compromising on the comforts and privacy of a private home.

Positioned on Dubai Islands — one of Dubai's most ambitious coastal destinations — Bay Estate Verda places residents at the heart of an emerging waterfront hub. The development sits within the Bay Estate precinct, an address that brings together natural beauty and urban convenience in equal measure.

projects.name: Bay Grove
description: Bay Grove by Nakheel stands as a testament to luxurious living, nestled within a dynamic residential ecosystem. This exciting new development offers an inviting blend of comfort, convenience, and community, designed to cater to diverse lifestyles. With its four interconnected buildings set atop a lush green podium, Bay Grove provides a harmonious blend of nature and architecture, ideal for families and individuals alike.

Bay Grove boasts a prime location in one of Dubai's most desirable neighborhoods. This setting offers easy access to major highways, upscale shopping destinations, and cultural landmarks, making it a perfect choice for those seeking both tranquility and connectivity. Residents can relish vibrant city life while enjoying the serene comfort of their private retreats.

projects.name: Bay Grove Residences Phase 3
description: Nakheel introduces Bay Grove Residences Phase 3, an exclusive coastal development on Dubai Islands. This waterfront masterpiece features three mid-rise towers with 241 elegantly designed residences, offering unparalleled views of the Arabian Gulf and a serene island lifestyle.
Located on Island B of Dubai Islands, ensuring privacy and connectivity.

projects.name: Bay Grove Residences Phase 2 By Nakheel
description: Nakheel, one of Dubai's most renowned and visionary developers, is proud to unveil the highly anticipated second phase of Bay Grove Residences, a stunning new residential development set within the prestigious Dubai Islands community.

Bay Grove Residences Phase 2 enjoys a prime location within Dubai Islands, formerly known as Deira Islands. It offers residents the perfect balance between island serenity and urban connectivity, situated off the coast of Deira. Key location highlights include easy access to mainland Dubai, proximity to Dubai International Airport, and closeness to established neighborhoods like Deira and Bur Dubai.

projects.name: Bay Grove Residences Phase 4 By Nakheel
description: Bay Grove Residences Phase 4 marks the final and most distinguished chapter of Nakheel’s vision for a premium waterfront community on Dubai Islands. As the concluding release in this sought-after collection, it offers 257 carefully designed residences within a gated neighborhood shaped for resort-inspired living.

Situated on the pristine Marina Island, the development features an impressive selection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and signature penthouses, each oriented to capture sweeping views of Dubai’s remarkable shoreline. With completion set for September 2028 and starting prices beginning at AED 2,000,000, this final phase presents a rare chance to own one of Dubai’s most desirable waterfront properties.

projects.name: Bay Villas By Nakheel
description: Bay Villas by Nakheel is a luxurious waterfront development located on Dubai Islands. This project redefines coastal living with opulent homes, world-class amenities, and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. Offering a unique blend of contemporary design and serene island living, Bay Villas is an exclusive address for those seeking a luxurious lifestyle in Dubai.

Bay Villas is strategically located on Dubai Islands, formerly Deira Islands. Residents enjoy a peaceful island retreat with easy access to major highways, Dubai International Airport, business districts, and entertainment hubs.

projects.name: Bay Villas Phase 3 By Nakheel
description: Bay Villas Phase 3 is an amazing new property by Nakheel located on the gorgeous Dubai Islands. This development has a variety of magnificent townhomes, semi-detached residences, gardens, and oceanfront villas. This community, located on Island B, provides an elite lifestyle with a wealth of services and attractions nearby.
Swimmable beaches and waterfront parks: spacious green spaces; walking trails and marinas

projects.name: Beach Residences Dubai Islands
description: Beach Residences Dubai Islands is Nakheel's latest luxury residential offering, bringing a new standard of coastal living to one of Dubai's most sought-after addresses. Developed in partnership with the acclaimed hospitality brand Rixos, this exceptional project blends hotel-grade service with the comfort and privacy of a permanent residence — a rare combination that defines a truly elevated way of living.

Featuring a curated collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, Beach Residences Dubai Islands is designed for those who value refined aesthetics, sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf, and a lifestyle that feels like a permanent holiday. Every detail, from the architecture to the interiors, reflects a commitment to quality that sets this development apart from anything else on the market.

projects.name: Como Residences
description: The real estate industry in the UAE offers exciting new prospects. Enter the opulent Como Residences universe. It is a beautiful development by the renowned Nakheel developer and the jewel in the Palm Jumeirah's crown. Experience luxurious living and a wealth of amenities that satisfy all of your needs.

Modern living is redefined at Como Residences. Both the interior and exterior have been painstakingly created, fusing aesthetics with usefulness. Your perspective on productivity and relaxation will alter if you live in this development. Discover a variety of entertainment alternatives while admiring the exquisite architecture and decor that add to the charm of your house.

projects.name: Crystal Springs Villa
description: Crystal Springs Villa is a distinguished residential offering by Nakheel Properties, set along the pristine shores of Palm Jebel Ali in Dubai. Designed for those who seek a refined coastal lifestyle without compromise, this collection of 5-bedroom villas combines architectural elegance with the rare privilege of beachfront living.

Palm Jebel Ali occupies a remarkable stretch of Dubai's southwestern coastline, offering a sense of exclusivity that is increasingly rare in a city defined by ambition. Once considered a quiet satellite district — sometimes referred to as Mina Jebel Ali — the area has steadily evolved into one of Dubai's most strategically significant and desirable addresses.

projects.name: District One West By Nakheel
description: District One West, a sparkling gem in the glittering crown of Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, calls out to the discerning homebuyer seeking more than just a residence. This is a place to live, grow, and thrive. Developed by Nakheel, the well-respected UAE property giant, District One West is an attractive proposition for those who demand an elevated

Strategically situated in the key Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, District One West offers unparalleled access to the heartbeat of the UAE. This exquisite development is designed with an eye towards luxury and comfort, offering a range of residential options that cater to diverse lifestyle needs.

projects.name: District One West Phase 2 By Nakheel
description: District One West Phase 2 in Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), Dubai, offers an exclusive opportunity for those seeking a blend of luxury living and natural tranquility. Developed by Nakheel, this prestigious residential project provides an idyllic setting for both families and professionals, combining modern city living with serene surroundings.
District One West Phase 2 in MBR City, Dubai offers luxury living in a prime location.

projects.name: Ibis at Jumeirah Village Circle
description: Located in the vibrant District 11 of Jumeirah Village Circle, Ibis by Nakheel introduces a new standard for contemporary urban living. This 16-storey development offers a carefully curated collection of studio to 2-bedroom apartments, blending modern design with practical comfort and premium finishes.

Set for completion in December 2027, Ibis is more than just a residential building—it’s a lifestyle destination designed to provide residents with a harmonious balance of community, convenience, and contemporary elegance. Prices start from AED 600,000, offering exceptional value for both homebuyers and investors seeking quality in a thriving Dubai neighborhood.

projects.name: Naya Phase 2 By Nakheel
description: Welcome to Naya Phase 2, the latest prestigious residential development by Nakheel, located in the heart of District One (D1) in Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), Dubai. This second phase of Nakheel’s visionary project offers a remarkable blend of luxury and nature, presenting a unique lifestyle proposition for discerning homeowners.

A haven of luxury and peace in the center of Dubai is Naya Phase 2 by Nakheel. It promises a lifestyle unlike any other because of its prime location, superb design, and extensive amenities. For those seeking a calm haven or a bustling city apartment, Naya Phase 2 provides the ideal combination of both. Discover the pinnacle of contemporary luxury living in Dubai and embrace endless living options in a setting that is naturally enriched.

projects.name: Naya Phase 3 By Nakheel
description: Naya Phase 3 By Nakheel by Nakheel Properties is a high-end residential project in Mohammed Bin Rashid City's exclusive District One. This development promises to be a new landmark in Dubai, providing residents with a mix of luxury and convenience. The strategic location offers easy access to major transportation routes and well-known landmarks, making it an excellent choice for those looking for an upscale lifestyle in the heart of the city.

Naya Phase 3 By Nakheel is located on the edge of the world's largest artificial lagoon, with stunning views of both the Dubai skyline and the Crystal Lagoon. The development features modern interiors with high-end kitchen appliances, ensuring a harmonious blend of elegance and functionality.

projects.name: Naya at District One By Nakheel
description: Imagine waking up every morning to the serene view of a glistening lagoon, your apartment nestled amidst lush greenery, and a world of premium amenities at your doorstep. Welcome to Naya at District One, a unique residential development pioneered by the renowned Meydan Group LCC. Set in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai, Naya promises an unparalleled living experience in a community that sets new standards for luxury and comfort.

Naya's exceptional location in District One (D1) provides seamless access to Dubai's major highways, ensuring that the city's most vibrant attractions are never more than a short drive away. From world renowned shopping precincts and gourmet dining experiences to top tier educational and medical institutions, all the conveniences of modern life are within easy reach.

projects.name: Villa Ocean Whisper
description: Nakheel's Villa Ocean Whisper establishes a new standard for opulent living in Dubai. This unique collection of six-bedroom villas offers a unique chance to live in luxury while nestled along the immaculate Palm Jebel Ali beaches. Each house is a masterpiece created by SAOTA's innovative architects, who are renowned for their skillful fusion of modern design with organic elements.

Villa Ocean Whisper by Nakheel is a haven that redefines what luxury living can be, not just a place to call home. For individuals who demand the best, it provides an outstanding lifestyle with its stunning design, unmatched location, and top-notch amenities.

projects.name: Palm Beach Towers 3
description: Palm Beach Towers 3 stands as a testament to architectural excellence and luxurious living on Dubai's world-renowned Palm Jumeirah. Developed by the prestigious Nakheel, this exceptional residential development offers an unparalleled lifestyle experience that seamlessly blends modern sophistication with the tranquil beauty of waterfront living.

This remarkable development represents more than just a residential address; it embodies a lifestyle choice that prioritizes comfort, elegance, and connectivity. With its strategic positioning and thoughtful design, Palm Beach Towers 3 offers residents the rare opportunity to experience the best of both worlds – the serenity of island living and the vibrancy of Dubai's dynamic urban landscape.

projects.name: Palm Central Private Residences
description: Palm Central Private Residences offers a premium lifestyle on Dubai's Palm Jebel Ali, where the calm of the sea meets modern living. Developed by Nakheel Properties, this beachfront community provides a serene escape surrounded by expansive waters and endless horizons.

Spanning three elegant buildings, the residences feature 1 to 5-bedroom units, each carefully oriented to capture uninterrupted island views. With prices starting from AED 2.5 million and an expected completion in August 2029, buyers can benefit from flexible installment plans while securing a slice of Dubai’s coastal charm.

projects.name: Palm Central Private Residences Frond M
description: Palm Central Private Residences Frond M stands proudly on one of Dubai's most distinguished waterfront addresses, offering a refined model of private coastal living. The project features a curated collection of residential units designed to strike a precise balance between architectural aesthetics and practical functionality, set within an environment that gives residents panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and a tranquil atmosphere away from…

The project is located at the heart of Palm Jebel Ali, the massive coastal development that added dozens of kilometers of private beaches to Dubai's map. This area is distinguished by its unique palm-shaped layout extending into the Arabian Gulf, giving residents rare privacy and water views from multiple angles.

projects.name: Palm Central Private Residences Phase 2
description: Palm Central Private Residences Phase 2 is a premium waterfront development by Nakheel Properties, rising on the iconic Palm Jebel Ali in Dubai. This carefully considered project brings together spacious apartments and generously proportioned townhouses in a setting where coastal living meets refined residential design.

Each residence is semi-furnished and designed around open-plan living, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and natural materials that bring warmth and texture to contemporary spaces. Balconies extend the living areas outward toward sea views, while kitchens and interiors reflect a commitment to both function and aesthetic.

projects.name: Palm Central Residences Frond N
description: Palm Central Residences Frond N is a distinguished waterfront address positioned at the iconic Palm Jebel Ali in Dubai. Developed by the renowned Nakheel Properties, this exclusive collection of contemporary apartments and townhouses is designed to deliver a resort-caliber lifestyle within a private, island setting.

The development reflects a refined vision of modern living — one that balances architectural elegance with the serenity of waterfront surroundings. Whether you are looking for a sophisticated urban retreat or a long-term family home, Palm Central Residences Frond N offers a compelling blend of comfort, privacy, and prestige in one of Dubai's most celebrated destinations.

projects.name: Palm Jebel Ali Frond B
description: Palm Jebel Ali Frond B by Nakheel Properties is the pinnacle of opulent living in Dubai, situated atop the magnificent Palm Jebel Ali. Beautiful three-story villas in this brand-new residential complex provide a first-rate lifestyle experience that is unmatched.
