description: Savannah, the latest luxurious paradise in Town Square Dubai, is proudly introduced by Nshama. This exquisite development includes a cutting-edge collection of premium one- to three-bedroom apartments and duplexes. Savannah was meticulously planned to provide incredible opportunities for living, relaxation, health, and exploration in a nature-inspired idyllic setting.

Savannah, located in the heart of Town Square Dubai, offers an ideal combination of modern living and natural beauty. This vibrant community is enriched with green spaces, jogging trails, bike lanes, cafes, and retail stores. The lively ambiance ensures that all of your needs are met within the community, promoting vitality and hospitality throughout.

projects.name: The Baltimore
description: Nshama's upscale new apartment complex, The Baltimore, is situated in the bustling Town Square neighborhood of Dubai. For families and workers looking for a vibrant yet calm setting, The Baltimore offers the right fusion of contemporary urban living with natural quiet. This guide walks you through the main attributes, benefits of the location, facilities, and interesting lifestyle options that this prestigious property has to offer.
Residents at The Baltimore will have access to a wide range of common facilities and services as part of the broader Town Square Dubai development.

projects.name: Sukoon by Nuri
description: Sukoon by Nuri redefines contemporary urban living in the heart of Dubai’s prestigious Nad Al Sheba community along Meydan Avenue. This premium collection offers thoughtfully designed 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments and penthouses, perfectly suited for professionals, families, and investors seeking a serene yet connected lifestyle.

The name “Sukoon,” meaning peace and tranquility in Arabic, reflects the calm environment residents can enjoy while remaining minutes away from Dubai’s bustling city life. With completion scheduled for December 2026, this under-construction development has already captured attention for its exceptional design, amenities, and strategic location.

projects.name: Calla Isle
description: Calla Isle is a refined residential development by NYX Properties, rising gracefully along the shores of Dubai Islands. This 11-storey mid-rise tower brings together the quiet rhythm of coastal living and the sophistication of contemporary design, creating a home environment that feels both elevated and genuinely livable.

Dubai Islands occupies a distinctive position along Dubai's northern coastline, offering a rare combination of natural beauty and urban proximity. The development sits within a master-planned island destination designed to blend resort-inspired surroundings with a fully connected residential experience.

projects.name: Xenia Residences
description: Located in Dubai’s Jumeirah Village Circle, Xenia Residences is a low-rise modern development by Nyx Properties offering 76 studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. Completion is planned for December 2026. The project combines modern architecture with landscaped surroundings, creating a calm retreat while staying connected to Dubai’s lively urban network.
JVC is a well-developed community balancing suburban calm with city access, making it popular with residents and investors.

projects.name: Essenlife
description: Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Dubai, Essenlife is a premium residential development that perfectly blends modern design, convenience, and comfort. This pre-launch project by Object 1 CONTEMPORARY DEVELOPMENT promises a sophisticated urban lifestyle with thoughtfully crafted apartments and cutting-edge amenities.
With its prime location and exceptional facilities, Essenlife is poised to set a new standard for contemporary city living in Dubai.

projects.name: IR1DIAN Park
description: IR1DIAN Park is a contemporary residential development by Object 1 Contemporary Development, situated in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. This five-story low-rise project offers an elegant blend of modern architecture, nature-inspired design, and high-end living, redefining urban lifestyle standards.

IR1DIAN Park offers an exceptional living experience, combining architectural brilliance with a prime location and world-class amenities. Designed for modern urbanites, this project ensures a luxurious, well-connected, and future-ready lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most vibrant communities.

projects.name: Tetris Tower
description: Tetris Tower is a groundbreaking residential development in Dubai's Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Inspired by the iconic Tetris game, it showcases a bold geometric design that redefines luxury living. Developed by Object 1 CONTEMPORARY DEVELOPMENT, it offers modern amenities, prime location advantages, and sustainable living features.

Tetris Tower boasts state-of-the-art facilities, including a fitness center, infinity pool, rooftop terrace, children's play areas, and co-working spaces. Additional highlights: landscaped gardens, cinema room, and smart home technology.

projects.name: V1stara House
description: V1STARA House, located in the dynamic and rapidly growing community of Al Furjan, provides residents with the ideal balance of city convenience and suburban tranquility. Al Furjan is known for its outstanding connectivity and proximity to Dubai's key landmarks, making it a perfect destination for families, professionals, and investors.

V1STARA House is a 14-story beacon of modern architecture, designed to provide privileged living. Each apartment showcases elegant design and utility, ensuring that occupants enjoy a high standard of living.

projects.name: V1VID Residence
description: Raises the bar for urban living in Dubai's extremely desirable Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) neighborhood. This opulent complex epitomizes premium living, with a selection of lavish studios, and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments built to combine beauty and functionality, creating a tranquil ambiance right in the middle of the bustling metropolis.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle, V1VID Residence by Object 1 CONTEMPORARY DEVELOPMENT provides a one-of-a-kind blend of luxury, convenience, and sustainability. With its thoughtfully designed apartments, world-class amenities, and low pricing, it is expected to be a standout development in Dubai's property market, responding to the different needs of modern urban living.

projects.name: Verdan1a 1
description: Object 1's innovative residential complex, Verdan1a 1, is situated in the Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC). This project offers a smooth fusion of contemporary urban living, luxury, and environmentally responsible design, all while keeping in mind cutting-edge architecture and sustainability.

Verdan1a 1 presents a strong investment opportunity with its prime location, sustainable design, and luxurious lifestyle amenities. Whether for end-use or investment, it offers long-term value and a premium living experience in the heart of Dubai Land Residence Complex.

projects.name: 1WOOD Residence Phase 2 By Object 1
description: This mixed-use development combines nature-inspired design, smart technology, and sustainable living to create a balanced urban lifestyle. With a harmonious blend of residential and commercial units, it caters to professionals, families, and businesses looking for a convenient yet serene environment. The project embodies innovation and quality, providing a space where residents can live, work, and relax within a thriving community.

Situated at the epicenter of JVC, 1WOOD Residence Phase 2 boasts excellent connectivity to major Dubai destinations. Key highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road are easily reachable, enhancing mobility. The community benefits from proximity to international schools, healthcare facilities, retail centers, and recreational parks, making it an ideal location for families and professionals seeking a balanced lifestyle.

projects.name: Alta View Skyhomes
description: Alta View Skyhomes by Object 1 offers a premium residential experience in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), District 10. This modern development features an exclusive collection of studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments, blending contemporary design with comfort and convenience.

With starting prices from AED 748,000 and flexible payment plans, Alta View Skyhomes makes premium living accessible without compromising on quality or style. Expected for completion by December 2028, each residence delivers thoughtfully designed spaces that elevate everyday living.

projects.name: Aurel1A Residence
description: At the heart of Dubai Sports City, Aurel1A Residence enjoys a location that blends the calm of a suburban neighborhood with the energy of a world-renowned sports hub. The community stretches across 50 million square feet, offering a mix of athletic venues, residential districts, and daily conveniences within minutes of home.
This strategic positioning makes the community a smart choice for families, young professionals, and sports enthusiasts who want an address that balances comfort with convenience.

projects.name: ELAR1S Axis
description: Positioned in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle, ELAR1S Axis steps forward as a distinctive mixed-use destination designed for those who appreciate contemporary living with a refined edge. This thoughtfully crafted development introduces a fresh architectural vision—one that blends clarity, fluidity, and modern movement into every corner of the building.

Its form carries a sense of energy and openness, creating spaces that feel light, purposeful, and connected. From the exterior’s dynamic expression to the interiors shaped with clean lines and generous natural light, ELAR1S Axis brings a new kind of residential experience to the JVT community.

projects.name: ELAR1S Sky
description: ELAR1S Sky stands as a contemporary landmark in Jumeirah Village Triangle, bringing a fresh perspective to premium urban living. Developed by Object 1, the project combines modern architecture with carefully curated comforts to create a home that feels both stylish and practical.

Set within one of Dubai’s lively and fast-growing communities, the development features a selection of studios and spacious 1 and 2-bedroom apartments designed to suit the city’s diverse residents. Starting at AED 767,000 and scheduled for completion in December 2028, ELAR1S Sky offers an appealing opportunity for homeowners and investors looking to secure a place in a steadily appreciating district.

projects.name: Elaris Rise
description: Situated in the heart of Dubai’s sought-after Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Elaris Rise combines modern urban design with family-friendly community living. This striking new development by Object 1 Development offers an exclusive collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully crafted to meet the needs of both residents and investors.

With completion anticipated in Q3 2028, this freehold project promises to elevate Dubai’s residential standards. Each apartment is designed to maximize space and comfort, featuring sleek contemporary layouts that balance functionality with modern aesthetics.

projects.name: Evergr1n House 3
description: Set within the well-connected Jumeirah Garden City in Al Satwa, Evergr1n House 3 brings a fresh take on modern urban homes. Developed by Object 1, the project introduces a curated mix of studios along with 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, each designed to feel comfortable, bright, and thoughtfully arranged.

At the heart of the development is a focus on practical layouts and refined detailing, giving residents homes that make everyday life smoother and more enjoyable. Whether it’s a compact studio or a larger two-bedroom home, every unit has been shaped to maximize space while maintaining a premium finish throughout.

projects.name: IR1DIAN Park Phase 2 By object 1
description: IR1DIAN Park Phase 2 emerges as a stunning new residential development by renowned developer Object 1. This eagerly anticipated second phase builds upon the success of the original IR1DIAN Park, offering an elevated living experience inspired by the mesmerizing beauty of iridescence.
Providing residents with the perfect balance of urban convenience and tranquil surroundings.

projects.name: Lum1nar Tower 2
description: Set in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Lum1nar Tower 2 offers a calm residential setting with smooth access to Dubai’s key destinations. The community is known for its family-friendly character, green spaces, and practical amenities.
This location blends comfort and connectivity, offering easy travel to major business districts, entertainment hotspots, and lifestyle venues.

projects.name: Lum1nar Tower 3
description: Lum1nar Tower 3 is perfectly situated in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), one of Dubai’s most desirable residential districts. This location combines the tranquility of a community-focused neighborhood with seamless access to the city’s key business and leisure hubs, offering residents a premium lifestyle in a secure and welcoming environment.

Lum1nar Tower 3 rises elegantly with 25 residential floors, featuring a façade of shimmering matte glass panels that reflect Dubai’s sunlight throughout the day. Its modern design emphasizes geometric precision, clean lines, and sustainable materials, creating a striking architectural presence while promoting environmental responsibility.

projects.name: OR1ON SKY
description: OR1ON SKY is a contemporary residential development by Object 1, rising above Jumeirah Village Circle with a design philosophy rooted in precision, comfort, and thoughtful living. This project brings together refined architecture and carefully curated amenities to create a residential experience that goes beyond the ordinary.

Situated in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, OR1ON SKY occupies one of Dubai's most sought-after residential addresses. JVC is a fully master-planned community that has matured significantly over the past decade, offering a rare combination of urban accessibility and a genuine neighbourhood atmosphere.

projects.name: S1LVA Park Living
description: S1LVA Park Living, developed by Object 1 Development, is a visionary residential project located in the heart of Dubai’s Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT). This low-rise complex offers a unique blend of urban sophistication and natural tranquility, designed to create a peaceful woodland retreat within the city.

Residents enjoy proximity to key Dubai attractions, including Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, along with nearby quality educational institutions and mosques. The community offers a family-friendly environment with tree-lined walking paths and parks, providing a serene yet well-connected suburban lifestyle.

projects.name: Silviana Park Living
description: At the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle, Silviana Park Living offers a calm residential setting shaped by nature-inspired design and contemporary architecture. Developed by Object 1 Development, this community takes its name from “Silva,” meaning forest, reflecting a focus on greenery, openness, and a slower urban rhythm.

Perfectly designed for those who value comfort without disconnection, the development blends peaceful surroundings with everyday city convenience. Homes are planned to feel welcoming, practical, and thoughtfully connected to their environment.

projects.name: Sky Level 1
description: Sky Level 1 is a 42-storey mixed-use residential tower developed by Object One Real Estate Development, rising prominently within Jumeirah Village Circle — one of Dubai's most dynamic and fast-growing urban communities. Designed to meet the demands of modern city living, the project brings together thoughtfully planned apartment layouts, curated amenities, and a location that connects residents to everything Dubai has to offer.

Jumeirah Village Circle, widely known as JVC, has established itself as one of Dubai's most active residential destinations — and for good reason. The community offers a genuine village-like feel within a modern metropolitan setting, lined with green pathways, open spaces, and a growing mix of retail and dining options.

projects.name: V1stara House Phase 2 By Object 1
description: V1stara House Phase 2 by Object 1 is a daring new chapter in urban living, tucked away in the center of Dubai's vibrant Al Furjan neighborhood. Building on Phase 1's success, this residential building redefines comfort and convenience for a wide, international audience by combining world-class amenities, modern design, and a prime location.
This prime location not only enhances daily convenience but also boosts rental yield potential and long-term investment value.

projects.name: VERDAN1A Phase 3 By Object 1
description: VERDAN1A Phase 3 offers a new standard of premium residential living in Dubai Land, where modern design meets environmental mindfulness. Developed by Object 1, this exceptional community blends contemporary sophistication with natural serenity, creating homes that nurture both lifestyle and well-being.

More than a residence, VERDAN1A Phase 3 embodies a lifestyle rooted in sustainability, wellness, and mindful living. Its name, inspired by “verde,” meaning green, reflects a commitment to spaces that encourage vitality, renewal, and a genuine connection with nature. Residents enjoy a tranquil retreat while remaining seamlessly connected to Dubai’s dynamic landscape.

projects.name: VERDAN1A Phase 4
description: VERDANIA Phase 4 by Object 1 redefines modern urban living in Dubai. Located within the fast-growing Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), this freehold residential development merges contemporary architecture with eco-conscious design and community-focused planning. Crafted with sustainability, technology, and lifestyle at its core, VERDANIA Phase 4 appeals to homeowners and investors alike.
VERDANIA Phase 4 enjoys a strategic setting within the Dubai Land Residence Complex, offering residents the perfect blend of suburban peace and city access.

projects.name: VERDAN1A Phase 2 By Object 1
description: VERDAN1A Phase 2 by Object 1 is a modern residential development in Dubailand Residence Complex (DLRC), Dubai. Designed to set new standards in urban living, it offers a balance of luxury, convenience, and sustainability.

VERDAN1A Phase 2 offers a strong investment with a prime location, modern amenities, and a sustainable design. Its flexible 60/40 payment plan makes it an attractive option for both investors and homeowners.

projects.name: Verde Level 1
description: Verde Level 1 is a residential tower developed by Object One Real Estate Development, rising across 24 floors above two basement parking levels within the Wadi Al Safa 5 area of Dubai Land Residence Complex. The project integrates residential living with retail and community-focused spaces, creating a self-contained urban environment that meets the practical and lifestyle needs of modern residents.

Designed with contemporary architectural standards and thoughtful planning, Verde Level 1 appeals to a wide spectrum of residents — from working professionals and couples to small families and long-term investors. The tower delivers a living experience grounded in comfort, convenience, and community.

projects.name: Waterside Residences
description: Waterside Residences is a distinctive new development by Object 1 Contemporary Development, positioned within the sought-after Meydan Horizon community in Dubai. This off-plan project brings together thoughtfully designed luxury waterfront apartments with a living experience that goes well beyond four walls.

Every element of this development reflects a clear intention: to create homes that feel as good as they look. The master plan draws a natural balance between the energy of the city and the calm of open, green surroundings giving residents the rare ability to enjoy both without compromise.

projects.name: Valores Residences
description: Valores Residences is located in the bustling Al Furjan district of Dubai's Jebel Ali District. This area is known for its modern amenities and cultural richness and it provides easy access to main roadways making it a great location for contemporary life.

Ocean Pearl Property Development's Values Residences will transform Dubai's modern lifestyle. With its prominent location in Al Furjan, cleverly designed areas, and first-rate amenities it provides a refined living for modern families and individuals. The variety of housing options and flexible payment plans make it an appealing choice for anyone wishing to invest in a nice house in Dubai.

projects.name: Marriott Westin
description: Marriott Westin by Octa is a branded wellness project in Dubai Creek Gardens, Dubai Creek with waterfront apartments managed by Marriott International in Dubai. This tower forms part of Global Partners' second flagship real estate fund. The fund runs under an agreement with Marriott International, and Octa Properties leads sales and marketing. The project is one of two branded towers in the community. A Renaissance-branded tower is beside it.

projects.name: Octa Isle Interiors
description: Nestled in the prestigious Dubai Islands, Octa Isle Interiors by Missoni brings together Italian design excellence and contemporary urban sophistication. This exclusive 16-storey tower by OCTA Properties showcases signature interiors from the iconic Missoni design house, reflecting decades of Italian craftsmanship and style. Every residence here is more than a home—it’s a statement of refined lifestyle.

The development offers 2 to 5-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to meet the needs of modern families while delivering unmatched comfort. With starting prices from AED 2,370,888, these residences combine exceptional quality with compelling value in Dubai’s competitive luxury property market.

projects.name: Aristo
description: Aristo by OKSA Developer introduces a refined approach to contemporary living in Dubai South, featuring a well-designed G+4 residential building that houses 66 carefully planned units. This development combines functional architecture with modern aesthetics, creating homes that cater to the needs of today's discerning residents.

Each residence at Aristo benefits from thoughtful layout design that maximizes natural light and space efficiency. The apartments feature equipped kitchens, contemporary finishes, and practical floor plans that accommodate various lifestyle needs. From compact studios perfect for young professionals to spacious two-bedroom units ideal for families, Aristo offers flexibility and quality at competitive price points starting from 689,000 AED.

projects.name: The Eighty Three
description: The Eighty Three is a thoughtfully conceived residential development by OKSA Developer, rising in one of Dubai's most strategically positioned and rapidly evolving districts — Dubai South. Designed for those who seek comfort, style, and long-term value, this development brings together refined architecture, resort-inspired amenities, and a vibrant community atmosphere in a location primed for growth.

Whether you're a first-time buyer, a growing family, or a seasoned investor, The Eighty Three offers a compelling proposition: contemporary living spaces with genuine lifestyle appeal, set within a master-planned environment that continues to attract global attention. From studios to spacious two-bedroom duplexes, the project caters to a range of needs without compromising on quality or character.

projects.name: Anwa Phase 2 By Omniyat Group
description: Anwa 2 by the esteemed Omniyat Group redefines luxury living in Dubai. This architectural marvel, located on the shores of Dubai Maritime City, offers a distinguished lifestyle with studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Anwa 2 presents a world of opulence, with breathtaking, uninterrupted views over the Arabian Gulf that create a serene yet majestic living experience.

Anwa 2’s central location places residents at the heart of Dubai’s dynamic hub. It offers a seamless connection to vibrant destinations, with close proximity to Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, and the dining and entertainment scene at Jumeirah Beach Residence, all while providing a tranquil waterfront retreat from the city’s hustle.

projects.name: Anwa Aria
description: The UAE's luxury real estate market welcomes Anwa Aria by Omniyat, a landmark project that seamlessly blends city life with serene seaside living.

Anwa Aria by Omniyat offers a distinctive urban seafront lifestyle in Dubai Maritime City, ideal for those seeking luxury, comfort, and an unparalleled connection to Dubai’s vibrant city and coastline.

projects.name: Ela By Omniyat
description: Ela by Omniyat is a remarkable multi-building development encompassing Tower 1, Tower 2, and Tower 3. This extraordinary project by the Omniyat Group offers luxurious residences with state-of-the-art amenities and breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea. Located on the picturesque waterfront of Palm Jumeirah, Ela enjoys an enviable position providing easy access to major roads and proximity to key landmarks.
Living on Palm Jumeirah offers residents a beautiful beachfront lifestyle, combining luxury and tranquility.

projects.name: Luna Sky Palace
description: Luna Sky Palace at Orla by Omniyat is a celestial-inspired residential marvel that redefines opulent living. Developed by the prestigious Omniyat Group, this project blends futuristic architecture with timeless elegance, offering a sanctuary of sophistication and serenity. Luna Sky Palace stands as a beacon of innovation, incorporating sustainability, exclusivity, and holistic luxury in one of the world’s most iconic addresses.

projects.name: Marasi Bay Island
description: Marasi Bay Island by OMNIYAT is the latest addition to Dubai’s luxury waterfront developments, elevating the city’s lifestyle offerings with world-class amenities, waterfront leisure, and sophisticated living experiences. The project transforms Marasi Bay Island in Business Bay into a premier residential and lifestyle destination, combining high-end residences with exclusive leisure and wellness facilities.

Marasi Bay Island occupies a prestigious waterfront position in Business Bay, one of Dubai’s most dynamic districts. This reclaimed island enjoys unobstructed views of the bay, providing residents with an exclusive sense of privacy while remaining within the city’s central hub.

projects.name: Omniyat Bespoke
description: Omniyat Bespoke is an exclusive luxury development on Palm Jumeirah, redefining personalized living. Developed by Omniyat Group, this visionary project offers fully customizable residences, allowing homeowners to design every aspect of their dream home. With a focus on bespoke craftsmanship, world-class design collaborations, and cutting-edge smart home technology, Omniyat Bespoke sets a new standard in high-end real estate.
Omniyat Bespoke offers tailor-made residences with full customization, allowing buyers to craft their ideal living space from materials and design to technological features.

projects.name: Orla by Omniyat
description: The newest residential development project by renowned developer Omniyat Group, Orla by Omniyat, redefines the notion of exquisite waterfront living. This project, located in the prime location of Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, offers a unique lifestyle experience with a plethora of facilities and gorgeous living spaces. Orla by Omniyat, set to be finished in Q4-2026, is the pinnacle of ultra-luxury living.

Palm Jumeirah is a highly sought-after region in Dubai, noted for its luxury lifestyle and breathtaking vistas. Living in Orla by Omniyat means having immediate access to a plethora of facilities and leisure and recreation activities right outside your door.

projects.name: Orla Infinity
description: Discover Orla Infinity, the latest architectural marvel crafted by the esteemed developers, OMNIYAT. Promising an unparalleled living experience, Orla Infinity seamlessly merges serene tranquility with the lavishness of resort-style living.
Presently in the construction phase, Orla Infinity anticipates its completion and delivery in Q4 2027.

projects.name: The Alba Residences Dorchester Collection
description: The Alba Residences Dorchester Collection by the Omniyat Group is Dubai's latest luxury property, showcasing unrivaled attention to detail. Located on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, this exceptional mixed-use complex offers a unique living experience marked by architectural brilliance, lavish design, and world-class service. With panoramic views of Dubai's most famous landmarks, this property exemplifies modern luxury living.

Each residence features a dual-aspect layout to maximize views of the lush landscapes and pristine beaches. These apartments combine cutting-edge architecture with a strong connection to nature, creating a serene yet vibrant environment.

projects.name: Vela Dorchester Collection
description: Vela Dorchester Collection stands as a testament to luxury, innovation, and architectural prowess. Developed by the esteemed Omniyat Group, this legendary project offers an unparalleled living experience, presenting a luxurious range of 3 to 5-bedroom penthouses, sky palaces, and marina residences.

Nestled in Business Bay, one of Dubai's most prestigious locations, Vela Dorchester Collection offers residents the perfect blend of urban excitement and serene waterfront living. The development’s strategic position provides convenient access to the bustling Marasi Promenade, while its proximity to the iconic Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai offers breathtaking views and unparalleled connectivity.

projects.name: Vela Viento
description: Vela Viento, a luxurious residential development by Omniyat, is an exquisite blend of sophistication, comfort and style. Nestled in the thriving heart of Dubai's Business Bay, this new luxury complex comprises two majestic towers, embodying the spirit of modern Dubai and offering a distinctive lifestyle to its residents.

Located on the serene shores of Marasi Bay, Vela Viento is at the epicentre of Dubai's pulsating business life. The towers overlook a picturesque marina and promenade, adding to the allure of this high end development. Residents will be a mere 10 minute drive away from iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall, making Vela Viento a prime choice for urban dwellers seeking convenience and luxury.

projects.name: Do Hotels & Residences
description: Do Hotels & Residences on Dubai Islands brings an entirely new vision to premium waterfront living. Created by One Development in collaboration with global music icon Amr Diab, the project introduces the world’s first AI-integrated, music-inspired hotel and residential concept. The collection includes studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed to elevate everyday comfort with creative expression and smart technology.

At the heart of the development is a seamless blend of music, contemporary design, and cutting-edge systems. Every corner has been shaped to reflect artistic inspiration and modern ease, giving residents a lifestyle that celebrates rhythm, ambience, and innovation.

projects.name: izzzi.life Lime
description: izzzi.life Lime is a thoughtfully designed co-living hotel development by Orange Group, bringing a fresh and energetic concept to Dubai's Al Satwa district. Comprising 218 fully serviced apartments, this vibrant project bridges the gap between hotel comfort and residential living — offering a community-driven environment where every detail has been crafted to support a modern, connected lifestyle.

Whether you're a young professional seeking a stimulating home base, a digital nomad looking for a smart and stylish space, or an investor tapping into Dubai's booming short-term rental market, izzzi.life Lime delivers a distinct experience that goes well beyond the ordinary. With its signature WOW-Lime design philosophy and dedicated on-site management by the experienced izzzi team, this is more than a residence — it's a way of life.

projects.name: Soma Residence
description: Soma Residence is an eight-storey residential development by Origami Developer, rising thoughtfully along the emerging coastal landscape of Dubai Islands in the Deira district. Rather than competing with the towering skyline that defines much of Dubai, Soma Residence takes a different approach one that prioritizes intimacy, openness, and a genuine connection to the waterfront setting that surrounds it.

Every residence within the building has been designed with purpose. Floor plans are efficient without feeling compact, and interior finishes reflect a minimalist sensibility that lets quality speak for itself. Large windows draw in natural light, while thoughtfully positioned layouts create a seamless flow between indoor spaces and outdoor views.

projects.name: Cubital Heights Phase 2
description: Cubital Heights Phase 2 by Ozean Real Estate Development is a 17-storey residential tower redefining modern urban living in Al Furjan. Designed with German-inspired architecture, this premium development blends luxury, convenience, and high-quality craftsmanship. With its prime location, excellent connectivity, and world-class amenities, it presents an exceptional lifestyle and investment opportunity.

projects.name: Ozean Heights

This 13-story building will offer a blend of luxury living and modern design, featuring 150 units in total. With its prime location, exceptional facilities, and sustainability focus, Ozean Heights is set to become a landmark in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods.
Nearby, residents can also enjoy attractions like Dubai Internet City, Mall of the Emirates, and various dining, retail, and educational establishments.

projects.name: Amazonia
description: Amazonia Residence, developed by Palladium Development, is a luxurious residential project in Al Jaddaf, Dubai. Designed to integrate nature with modern urban living, the project features a nature-inspired architectural concept, resort-style amenities, and seamless connectivity to key areas in Dubai.

Amazonia Residence is a landmark development blending nature, luxury, and urban accessibility. With sustainable features, a prime location, and strong investment potential, it stands out as an ideal choice for homeowners and investors seeking long-term value in Dubai.

projects.name: Coralis Residences
description: Nestled in the prestigious Meydan district of Dubai, Coralis Residences by Palladium Development represents a revolutionary approach to luxury residential living. This extraordinary development transcends conventional architecture, drawing inspiration from the intricate beauty of living coral to create a structure that breathes with organic elegance.

The development's coral-inspired design philosophy creates a visual masterpiece that captures the eye while providing a serene sanctuary for its residents. With its graceful curves and organic geometry, Coralis Residences establishes a new benchmark for architectural excellence in Dubai's ever-evolving skyline.

projects.name: Magnolia
description: Nestled in the prestigious Dubai Internet City, Magnolia by Palladium Development represents the pinnacle of boutique residential living in one of Dubai's most dynamic neighborhoods. This exceptional low-rise development embodies a refined balance of calm sophistication and contemporary vision, creating an atmosphere where elegance feels effortless and luxury becomes a way of life.

With its architectural silhouette defined by clean lines, warm tones, and a serene aesthetic inspired by the graceful magnolia flower, this remarkable project offers an exclusive collection of studios and 1-bedroom apartments. Starting from AED 1,250,000, Magnolia presents an unparalleled opportunity to own a piece of Dubai's most coveted real estate, with completion scheduled for September 2028.

projects.name: The Royal Yacht
description: The Royal Yacht by Palladium Development represents a revolutionary approach to luxury residential living in Dubai, where the timeless elegance of a modern superyacht meets the sophistication of contemporary urban architecture.

Designed as a stunning architectural masterpiece, The Royal Yacht offers spacious studio apartments that embody the essence of five-star yacht living. Each residence is meticulously crafted to provide an open, bright, and luxurious environment that captures the unique maritime-inspired character while delivering uncompromising comfort and clarity.

projects.name: East Residence 2 At Serenia District
description: East Residence 2 at Serenia District by Palma Development is a thoughtfully designed residential tower offering premium apartments in the heart of Jumeirah Islands, Dubai. The development combines contemporary architecture, spacious layouts, and breathtaking panoramic views, delivering a lifestyle of comfort, exclusivity, and serenity.

Nestled in the tranquil eastern section of Serenia District, East Residence 2 enjoys a central position within Jumeirah Islands, surrounded by landscaped lakes and private waterways. The tower is set back from all peripheral roads, ensuring a quiet and peaceful living environment. Residents can enjoy 360-degree panoramic vistas of serene lakes, lush greenery, and the iconic Dubai skyline.

projects.name: East Residence 3 At Serenia District
description: East Residence 3 brings together the best of lakeside serenity and urban convenience in one distinctive address. Located along the vibrant edge of Serenia District in Jumeirah Islands, this carefully crafted residential tower offers a lifestyle that balances calm waterfront views with the energy of nearby JLT.

Positioned within Jumeirah Islands, East Residence 3 occupies a prime spot in the Serenia District's eastern zone. The community is known for its mature landscaping, well-maintained roads, and family-friendly atmosphere. Surrounded by calm waterways and green spaces, the location offers a peaceful residential environment while remaining well connected to the rest of Dubai.

projects.name: East Residence 4 At Serenia District
description: East Residence 4 at Serenia District presents a contemporary residential offering within one of Dubai's most thoughtfully planned waterfront environments. Developed by Palma Development, this tower reflects a clear vision of measured design and practical elegance, offering apartments that balance spaciousness with function.

Serenia District occupies a distinctive position within Jumeirah Islands, a master-planned community recognized for its organized layout and residential character. The eastern edge of this district offers residents direct views over the community's centerpiece lake, while maintaining proximity to tree-lined pathways and open green zones.

projects.name: East Residence 5 At Serenia District
description: East Residence 5 is the latest addition to the Serenia District, an emerging address within the verdant landscape of Jumeirah Islands in Dubai. Developed by Palma Development, this off-plan residential project brings together thoughtfully designed apartments and penthouses in a community that places wellness, space, and connection to nature at the forefront of everyday life.

The development draws from a philosophy of purposeful living — where generous layouts meet considered design, and where the surrounding greenery becomes an extension of the home itself. Whether you're looking for a primary residence or a sound investment in one of Dubai's most established residential enclaves, East Residence 5 presents a compelling opportunity.

projects.name: East Residence 6 At Serenia District
description: East Residence 6 is an off-plan residential development by Palma Development, located within the prestigious Serenia District in Jumeirah Islands, Dubai. Designed for those who value both comfort and considered design, this project brings together thoughtfully planned residences, lush surroundings, and a rich array of community amenities.

Jumeirah Islands has long been one of Dubai's most distinctive residential communities, known for its tranquil atmosphere, interconnected lakes, and lush landscaping that sets it apart from the city's more urban developments. Serenia District – East sits within this established community, offering residents the rare advantage of privacy and serenity without sacrificing proximity to the wider city.

projects.name: Serenia District East Residences
description: Nestled within the prestigious Jumeirah Islands community, Serenia District East Residences represents the pinnacle of luxury living in Dubai. Developed by the renowned Palma Development, this extraordinary high-rise tower offers an exclusive collection of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and sophisticated penthouses, each designed to provide residents with an unparalleled lifestyle experience.

This remarkable development transcends traditional residential concepts, creating an immersive sanctuary where modern luxury seamlessly blends with the serene ambiance of one of Dubai's most coveted neighborhoods. The tower embodies a poetic rhythm of life, where every element has been carefully orchestrated to provide residents with a tranquil retreat that floats harmoniously between water and sky.

projects.name: The West Residence at Serenia District
description: The West Residence at Serenia District, developed by Palma Holding, is a luxury 46-story tower in Jumeirah Islands, Dubai. As part of the Serenia District masterplan, it features Japanese-inspired architecture, 419 residences, and access to the prestigious Serenia Signature Clubhouse. Offering holistic living, it combines tranquility, modernity, and luxury, making it a premier residential destination in Dubai.
Each unit features floor-to-ceiling windows, smart home integration, and high-quality finishes, ensuring a luxurious and comfortable living experience.

projects.name: Maison Elysee By Pantheon Development
description: Maison Elysee, an iconic residential development nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) in Dubai. Engineered by the renowned Pantheon Development, this project holds the promise of a luxurious and vibrant lifestyle, surrounded by an array of amenities and services.

Strategically located in JVC, Maison Elysee presents an advantageous position for residents. The community park, supermarket, hotels, the Circle Mall, international schools, a mosque, and retail & dining hubs are all within the vicinity, ensuring a convenient and elevated lifestyle.

projects.name: Maison Elysee 2
description: Maison Elysee 2 is the modern residential epitome by Pantheon Development in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai with studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments. With its sleek architecture and contemporary design, this development redefines luxury living, offering a harmonious blend of sophistication and comfort.

Step into the tranquil interiors and feel your worries melt away. From the moment you enter, you're greeted with open, airy spaces that serve as a canvas for your personal style. Whether it's unwinding in the spacious living areas or enjoying the views from your private balcony, every corner exudes elegance and refinement.

projects.name: Maison Elysee Phase 3 By Pantheon
description: Maison Elysee III, the latest luxurious residential project by Pantheon Development. Nestled in the vibrant heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, this development epitomizes upscale living with a perfect blend of modern architectural design and premium facilities. Maison Elysee III offers a variety of carefully designed studio, 1, and 2 bedroom apartments that cater to the needs of discerning residents seeking affordable luxury.

Maison Elysee III by Pantheon Development is more than just a residential project; it is a lifestyle choice. Offering a perfect blend of modern design, premium facilities, and a prime location in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), this development is designed to cater to the needs of those seeking affordable luxury living.

projects.name: Omya Residences
description: Omya Residences is a modern 15-storey residential tower by Pantheon Development, located in the heart of Dubai's evolving Wasl Gate community. The project offers a seamless blend of comfort, style, and convenience, making it ideal for professionals, couples, and small families seeking contemporary urban living.

Designed to maximize space, natural light, and functionality, Omya Residences features thoughtfully planned studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. Each home combines modern aesthetics with practical living solutions for everyday comfort.

projects.name: Pantheon 2.0
description: Designed with modern aesthetics, thoughtful layouts, and a commitment to excellence, Pantheon 2.0 offers a blend of sophistication, comfort, and smart investment potential. This under-construction community is poised to attract discerning homeowners and investors looking for value and long-term appreciation in a well-connected and maturing neighborhood.

Set in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle, Pantheon 2.0 enjoys a strategic location that provides residents with tranquility and seamless access to Dubai's top destinations. This family-friendly neighborhood is rapidly gaining recognition for its quality lifestyle and growth prospects.

projects.name: VOXA by Pantheon
description: Developed by the reputable Pantheon Development, this mid-rise masterpiece is located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), one of Dubai's fastest-growing residential communities. VOXA is more than just a collection of apartments—it’s a thoughtfully designed lifestyle community that caters to young professionals, families, and savvy investors alike.
This combination of connectivity and tranquility makes VOXA’s address highly desirable for residents and investors alike.

projects.name: Park Residency
description: Park Residency by Park Group is a thoughtfully conceived residential development that brings together contemporary design, purposeful architecture, and a curated lifestyle in one of Dubai's steadily growing districts. Positioned in Al Warsan 4, the project is designed for those who appreciate the balance between calm, comfortable living and easy access to the city's essential corridors.

Al Warsan 4 has evolved into a sought-after residential pocket within Dubai, offering residents a quieter pace of life without sacrificing proximity to the city's key destinations. The neighborhood is well-served by established infrastructure, with schools, healthcare facilities, supermarkets, and everyday services within comfortable reach.

projects.name: Stax Tower
description: Stax Tower by Pasha One Development introduces a fresh perspective on modern urban living in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). This premium development offers a curated selection of studio, 1-, and 2-bedroom apartments designed to blend functionality with sophisticated style. Perfectly suited for families, young professionals, and investors, Stax Tower presents an exceptional opportunity to experience Dubai living at its finest.

The project reflects a thoughtful approach to contemporary life, balancing practicality with design elegance. Every apartment is crafted to feel spacious, welcoming, and adaptable to evolving lifestyle needs.

projects.name: Peace Avenue
description: Peace Avenue by Peace Homes Development is an 18-storey mixed-use residential tower in Downtown Jebel Ali, Dubai. The development offers 266 apartments across standard and duplex configurations, all delivered semi-furnished. For buyers seeking a competitively priced entry into a well-connected Dubai district, Peace Avenue presents a practical and carefully considered option.

The Dubai Metro serves the broader Jebel Ali area, and bus networks connect residents to the wider city. Abu Dhabi is also accessible via Sheikh Zayed Road, making this location practical for cross-emirate commuters.

projects.name: Peace Lagoons
description: Peace Lagoons by Peace Homes Group offers the pinnacle of luxury living. This exceptional residential development is located in the prestigious Dubailand Residence Complex (DLRC). The project features a variety of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, all with an innovative twist. The 17-story façade redefines Dubai's modern living standards.

Peace Lagoons by Peace Homes Group provides an unparalleled living experience in Dubai. This residential development, with its prime location in Dubailand Residence Complex and world-class amenities, promises luxury, comfort, and convenience. Peace Lagoons has something for everyone, including young professionals, couples, and small families.

projects.name: Peace Lagoons Phase 2 by Peace Homes Group
description: Nestled within the vibrant Dubai Land Residence Complex, Peace Lagoons Phase 2 by Peace Homes Group emerges as a beacon of luxury and innovation in Dubai's ever-evolving real estate landscape. This is an ambitious project that takes the vision of Peace Homes Group for unparalleled living experiences a notch higher, following on the heels of the resounding success in Phase 1.

The strategic location of Peace Lagoons Phase 2 within Dubai Land Residence Complex gives the ideal balance between serenity and urban connectivity for its residents. Such a prime location means that its residents are not far away from the main attractions and necessities of Dubai.

projects.name: Sky Harmony
description: Sky Harmony is a 17-storey residential tower developed by Peace Homes Group in Jumeirah Village Circle, one of Dubai's most sought-after and fastest-growing residential communities. With 197 thoughtfully designed homes, the project brings together clean architectural lines, practical layouts, and a living environment that prioritizes comfort without compromise.

Every detail within Sky Harmony has been approached with purpose. From the way natural light flows through each unit to the functional layout of communal areas, the design choices reflect a deep understanding of how people actually live. Whether you are a young professional, a growing family, or a long-term investor, Sky Harmony offers a living experience that aligns with your goals and supports your everyday lifestyle.

projects.name: Sky Line
description: At the heart of Dubai Land, Sky Line by Peace Homes Group rises as a symbol of premium modern living. Designed to seamlessly blend wellness, leisure, and urban connectivity, this mixed-use development offers residents an exceptional lifestyle within the prestigious Dubai Land Residential Complex (DLRC).

More than a residential tower, Sky Line is a resort-style sanctuary featuring studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. Every unit is meticulously crafted with spacious layouts, private jacuzzis, floor-to-ceiling windows, and premium finishes, creating a home that’s both elegant and practical.

projects.name: Sky Living
description: Sky Living is Peace Homes Development's most recent masterpiece, located in Dubai's renowned Jumeirah Village Circle. This magnificent residential complex is intended to provide the pinnacle of luxury and comfort, with a selection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, as well as two and three-bedroom duplexes. Each device is precisely built to strike a balance between modern refinement and functionality.

Peace Homes Development's Sky Living at Jumeirah Village Circle is the peak of luxury residential living in Dubai. This building provides a unique living experience, thanks to its great location, innovative design, and a plethora of world-class amenities. Sky Living provides something for everyone, whether you want a peaceful retreat to unwind in or a bustling community to be a part of.

projects.name: Solena Orchard Place
projects.developer: PEAK SUMMIT REAL ESTATE DEVELOPMENT L.L.C
description: Solena Orchard Place marks the final phase of Dubai’s largest European-inspired residential community, bringing sophisticated living to the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Developed by Peak Summit Real Estate Development L.L.C, this exceptional project features two elegant towers, D and E, rising above a G + 4 podium with 25 and 31 residential floors respectively.

With over 400 meticulously designed homes, the development offers a refined mix of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, alongside 2 commercial units. Construction commenced in summer, with completion scheduled for Q2 2028, and prices starting from AED 734,000. This phase offers a rare opportunity to own a residence in JVC’s most prestigious European-inspired community.

projects.name: The Orchard Place- Towers D&E
projects.developer: PEAK SUMMIT REAL ESTATE DEVELOPMENT L.L.C
description: The Orchard Place – Towers D&E is an exceptional residential development in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, brought to life by Peak Summit Real Estate Development L.L.C. This premium project offers a diverse collection of studios, 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments, alongside penthouses, lofts, and duplexes.

Located in Jumeirah Village Circle, The Orchard Place Towers D&E is strategically placed in a thriving residential community that combines convenience with a serene urban environment. The neighborhood offers a balance of green open spaces, landscaped parks, and modern infrastructure, making it an ideal location for families, young professionals, and investors seeking both lifestyle and value.

projects.name: Bond Enclave
description: Bond Enclave, developed by Pearlshire Real Estate, offers an exceptional living experience in Dubai's thriving Arjan district. This luxurious residential community combines cutting-edge design with high-end amenities, providing an ideal destination for those seeking a sophisticated and contemporary lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
Located in the vibrant Arjan district, Bond Enclave provides easy access to major areas in Dubai. Its strategic position offers a perfect balance between connectivity and suburban tranquility.

projects.name: Bond Living
description: Situated in the thriving Dubai Land district, Bond Living by Pearlshire Developments sets a new benchmark for premium residential living. This boutique project offers a refined collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each carefully designed to combine contemporary comfort with timeless elegance.

Bond Living is designed to feel both intuitive and welcoming. Every detail, from the layouts to the finishes, has been thoughtfully considered to enhance daily life, while the limited number of residences ensures a private, close-knit community atmosphere.

projects.name: Amaya Residences
description: Amaya Residences by Amaya Properties is a contemporary residential development in Al Furjan, Dubai, designed to redefine urban living through a seamless blend of comfort, design, and convenience. Strategically situated in one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods, the project caters to diverse lifestyle needs—from young professionals to families—through modern architecture, sustainable features, and spacious unit layouts.

Amaya Residences is located in the heart of Al Furjan, offering residents unmatched accessibility and a vibrant neighborhood ambiance. This prime address ensures ease of travel across Dubai while maintaining the tranquility of suburban life.

projects.name: Oceara Park View Residences
description: Oceara Park View Residences is a premium residential development brought to life by PPS Properties on the sought-after Dubai Islands. Designed for those who value refined living with a sense of calm and community, this thoughtfully planned building rises across a ground floor, a podium level, ten residential floors, and a rooftop that offers curated amenity spaces with sweeping views.

With a collection of 63 carefully designed units, Oceara Park View Residences caters to a range of lifestyles — from compact and efficient to spacious and family-oriented. The development strikes a balance between architectural intention and everyday comfort, making it a compelling choice for both residents and investors looking at Dubai's expanding waterfront corridor.

projects.name: South Lofts
description: South Lofts at Dubai South is a thoughtfully designed nine-storey residential development by Premier Choice International, offering a curated collection of loft-style residences that balance modern aesthetics with everyday comfort. The building's contemporary facade draws on clean architectural lines and an open, airy sensibility that speaks to those who appreciate design with purpose.

Every element of the project, from the generous glazing that floods interiors with natural light to the open-plan layouts that adapt to individual lifestyles, reflects a commitment to creating homes that feel as good as they look. South Lofts is not simply a place to live — it's a carefully considered environment where architecture, comfort, and convenience come together.

projects.name: South Lofts 2
description: South Lofts 2 is a contemporary eight-storey residential development by Premier Choice International, located in the heart of Dubai South — one of the emirate's most strategically positioned and fastest-growing urban districts.

Built within Saih Shuaib 2, Dubai Industrial City, this project is particularly well-suited for professionals working across the broader Dubai South ecosystem — from logistics and aviation to trade and commerce. The development reflects a practical yet refined approach to urban residential design, offering a secure, well-equipped community for those who want modern amenities close to their workplace without sacrificing comfort or lifestyle.

projects.name: Legado
description: Legado at JVC by Prescott Real Estate Development is set to redefine luxury living in Dubai. This new premium residential building boasts 32 floors and is strategically located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). The development promises a contemporary lifestyle that marries quality with utility. With luxurious apartments and modern facilities, Legado aims to cater to a diverse array of tastes and preferences.
One of Dubai's most sought-after residential developments is Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Because of Legado's excellent location within JVC, it is near important sites, which adds to its allure.

projects.name: The Caden
description: The Caden at Meydan Horizon redefines contemporary premium living in Dubai’s esteemed Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Developed by Prescott Real Estate Development, this exceptional residential project combines cutting-edge smart-home technology, sophisticated design, and stunning lagoon views to create a serene yet connected lifestyle.

Offering a curated collection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, elegant duplexes, and striking penthouses, The Caden balances the lively energy of Dubai with the tranquility of waterfront living. Each residence is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort, natural light, and connectivity, giving residents an elevated lifestyle that blends luxury with practicality.

projects.name: Verano By Prescott
description: Verano By Prescott is a contemporary development in the heart of Dubai Studio City, blending affordability with luxury. Designed by Prescott Real Estate Development, this project offers a unique lifestyle destination that caters to the aspirations of modern urbanites.

Located in the vibrant Dubai Studio City, Verano is strategically positioned in a hub of media, entertainment, and creative industries. It offers seamless access to key Dubai districts while providing a peaceful retreat for its residents.

projects.name: Coastal Haven
description: Coastal Haven at Dubai Islands by Prestige Harbour Development redefines waterfront luxury with a seamless fusion of nature and modern design. Offering resort-style living with stunning Arabian Gulf views, this exclusive development provides a serene retreat with world-class amenities, creating a sophisticated island lifestyle.
Elegant apartments designed for families and professionals, featuring nature-inspired interiors, coastal luxury, and seamless integration with sustainable living.

projects.name: Luxury Canal Residences
description: Luxury Canal Residences is an upcoming waterfront gem by Prestige Harbour Real Estate, located in the heart of the iconic Dubai Islands. Blending architectural brilliance with serene canal-front living, the project introduces a modern and luxurious residential concept that redefines sophistication.

Situated in the Dubai Islands (previously the Deira Islands), Luxury Canal Residences is a well-chosen location that strikes a mix between connectivity and tranquility. In addition to providing picturesque views of the lake, this gorgeous location puts people in close proximity to the city's commercial, cultural, and recreational centers.

projects.name: Berkeley Square
description: Berkeley Square blends the charm of classic British architecture with the clean, contemporary character of Dubai, creating an exceptional residential setting in the middle of Jumeirah Village Circle. Developed by Prestige One Developments, this G+5 building with two basement levels has been thoughtfully shaped to bring London’s refined style into a modern Dubai community.

Homes start from AED 690,000 and include studios, along with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom layouts. Each residence is crafted to feel bright, calm, and comfortably functional. Completion is planned for March 2028, with bookings now open and flexible installment options available.

projects.name: Fauchon Residences
description: Fauchon Residences is a refined luxury development by Prestige One Developments, bringing Parisian elegance to the heart of Dubai's most connected urban district. Located in Jumeirah Garden City, Al Satwa, this boutique collection of just 48 exclusive residences offers studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments starting from AED 1,380,000.

With its limited inventory and high-end positioning, Fauchon Residences appeals equally to end-users seeking a permanent address in central Dubai and investors looking for strong rental yields in one of the city's most in-demand neighborhoods. The development's Parisian-inspired identity, curated amenities, and flexible payment structure make it one of the standout off-plan launches in Dubai this year.

projects.name: Harbour by Prestige One
description: Harbour by Prestige One is a luxurious waterfront residential development in Dubai, designed to offer the finest coastal living experience. Located in Dubai Islands, Deira, this project combines modern urban living with serene waterfront views. With its exceptional design and premium offerings, it promises a lifestyle of elegance and comfort.

Situated in Dubai Islands, Deira, Harbour offers residents easy access to major highways, Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and shopping centers like Deira City Centre and Dubai Festival City Mall.

projects.name: Prestige One Residences
description: Prestige One Residences at Maritime City redefines premium coastal living in Dubai, offering a collection of 1 to 5-bedroom apartments and penthouses ranging from 825 to 7,500 square feet. Developed by Prestige One Developments, this landmark waterfront community combines Prestige One’s signature hospitality standards with modern residential design, delivering an exceptional lifestyle experience for discerning residents and investors.

Each residence is thoughtfully designed to maximize space, natural light, and breathtaking waterfront views, providing a seamless blend of elegance, comfort, and functionality. Residents can enjoy panoramic vistas of Dubai’s pristine coastline and the marina, creating a tranquil yet vibrant living environment.

projects.name: Parkway by Prestige One
description: Prestige One Developments' Parkway is poised to become a landmark in Dubai's famous Meydan sector. This luxury residential development provides inhabitants with an enviable lifestyle of ease, sophistication, and modernity.

Parkway, located in the heart of Meydan, offers exceptional connectivity to popular destinations including the Meydan Racecourse, Downtown Dubai, and the Dubai International Financial Centre. This strategic position allows for easy access to the city's economic and entertainment hubs.

projects.name: Prestige Gardens
description: Prestige Gardens is a contemporary residential development by Prestige One Developments, rising eleven storeys in the heart of Jumeirah Garden City, Al Satwa, Dubai. Designed with a clear philosophy of balance — between vibrant city life and genuine everyday comfort — this building offers a thoughtfully curated living experience for those who want more from their home than four walls and a view.

Al Satwa has long been one of Dubai's most character-rich districts — a neighbourhood with genuine energy, a strong sense of community, and growing appeal among those who appreciate authentic urban living. Within this area, Jumeirah Garden City has emerged as a focused residential destination, offering a quieter pocket of well-planned streets while remaining closely connected to some of Dubai's most prominent landmarks.

projects.name: Sanctuary by Prestige One
description: Nestled in the prestigious Meydan Horizon district, Sanctuary by Prestige One represents a paradigm shift in luxury residential living within Dubai's dynamic real estate landscape. This exceptional development seamlessly blends contemporary architectural excellence with serene living environments, creating an unparalleled residential experience that caters to the most discerning homeowners and investors.

Sanctuary stands as a testament to thoughtful urban planning, where every element has been meticulously crafted to provide residents with a harmonious balance between modern city conveniences and peaceful retreat-style living. With its strategic positioning and innovative design philosophy, this development offers an exclusive opportunity to experience Dubai's luxury lifestyle while maintaining a sense of tranquil sanctuary away from the…

projects.name: Seaside By Prestige One
description: Prestige One Developments presents Seaside By Prestige One, an exquisite collection of one, two, and three-bedroom luxury apartments on the prestigious Dubai Island. This new project provides an unrivaled combination of opulence, convenience, and tranquillity. Seaside By Prestige One, with its captivating ocean views and thriving neighborhood, offers a sophisticated lifestyle at highly attractive prices.

Dubai Island is known for its exclusive settings and prime real estate. Seaside By Prestige One takes full advantage of this location, offering residents easy access to pristine beaches and a serene environment. The development is well-connected to major roads, ensuring seamless travel to other parts of Dubai.

projects.name: The Boulevard
description: The Boulevard is a prestigious residential project by Prestige One Developments, situated in the heart of the Dubai Land Residence Complex. With modern design, strategic location, and luxurious amenities, this development offers a truly exceptional living experience in Dubai.
Health and wellness: Fitness center, temperature-controlled swimming pool, yoga spaces, and spa.

projects.name: The Place by Prestige One
description: The Place by Prestige One Developments is the newest residential masterpiece in Dubai Sports City. This new complex, with its painstakingly built restricted apartments, embodies luxury living. The Place was designed to provide an unrivaled lifestyle with access to every desired amenity, making it a perfect choice for discriminating individuals.

Dubai Sports City is already recognized as a bustling hub of activity, and The Place is in a prime location inside this dynamic area. The Place's strategic location enables convenient access to key highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. This makes everyday travels to key business hubs more comfortable and convenient.

projects.name: The Place Phase 2 by Prestige One
description: Located in the heart of Dubai Sports City, The Place Phase 2 by Prestige One Developments offers a premium residential lifestyle that combines contemporary design with practical comfort. This thoughtfully crafted development features studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed to create a sense of sophistication and ease.

The development continues the success of its first phase, blending stylish interiors with functional spaces. Every apartment is designed to maximize light and comfort, ensuring a serene and welcoming home for residents.

projects.name: The Waterway
description: The Waterway at Meydan Horizon by Prestige One Developments is more than just a place to live; it's a way of life that is luxurious, convenient, and sophisticated. With its prime location, world-class amenities, and meticulously designed residences, it provides an unrivaled living experience in the heart of Dubai.

projects.name: Sunvale
description: At the heart of Al Furjan, Sunvale by PRYSM Development emerges as a refined residential address shaped for modern city life. Overlooking the greenery of Jebel Ali Village, this thoughtfully planned development introduces a new level of premium living, where design, comfort, and functionality come together naturally.

The project offers a limited collection of 1, 2, 2.5, 3, and 3.5-bedroom apartments, each carefully planned to suit different lifestyles. With completion scheduled for May 2028 and prices starting from AED 1,090,000, Sunvale presents a compelling option for both end users and investors looking for long-term value in a growing community.

projects.name: Bliss Tower
description: Bliss Tower by Pure Bliss Development is a new pinnacle of luxury living in Dubailand. This 15-storey residential tower seamlessly blends contemporary aesthetics with functional elegance, redefining modern urban living. Strategically located in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing districts, Bliss Tower offers residents an exceptional lifestyle enriched with world-class amenities and outstanding connectivity.
Bliss Tower enjoys a prime location in Dubailand, providing residents with both urban convenience and suburban tranquility.

projects.name: PG Maison
description: PG Maison, developed by Pure Gold Real Estate Development, is an exclusive residential project ideally situated on Al Asayel Street in the vibrant Al Furjan area. This prime location offers residents the perfect blend of tranquility and accessibility, with convenient connections to key destinations like Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR).

Pure Gold Real Estate Development's PG Maison is an elite residential property located on Al Asayel Street in the lively Al Furjan area. This strategic location strikes the perfect balance of exclusivity and ease, making it an excellent choice for modern living.

projects.name: Purvanchal Triana Residences
description: Nestled in the prestigious Jumeirah Garden City, Purvanchal Triana Residences emerges as a masterpiece of contemporary architecture and refined living. This exceptional residential development by Purvanchal Developers redefines luxury living in Dubai, offering an unparalleled blend of modern sophistication, privacy, and comfort.

Starting from AED 946,000, this remarkable development offers flexible apartment configurations ranging from studios to spacious 3-bedroom units, ensuring options for every lifestyle preference. With construction currently underway and expected completion by March 2027, early investors and homebuyers have the opportunity to secure their place in this architectural gem through convenient installment plans.

projects.name: Sunbliss Residence
description: Sunbliss Residence sets a new benchmark for luxury living in Al Furjan, Dubai. Developed by Purvanchal Real Estate Developers, this project blends modern elegance with exceptional amenities, redefining residential excellence in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods.
With close proximity to Al Furjan Metro Station and major highways, commuting is effortless.

projects.name: Arisha Terraces
description: Arisha Terraces, a gorgeous new residential neighborhood tucked away in the center of Dubai Studio City, is proudly presented by QUBE Development. The 419 well-designed apartments in this contemporary housing complex combine flair and functionality to provide the perfect living environment.

A range of unit sizes are available at Arisha Terraces to accommodate different lifestyle requirements. Every property, from roomy family apartments to compact studios, is designed to offer a cozy and practical living environment.

projects.name: Elire
description: QUBE Development's remarkable new residential tower, Elire, is located in the center of Dubai's Business Bay. Within Dubai's most vibrant business and leisure sector, Elire delivers a comfortable, convenient, and elegant lifestyle that pushes the limits of luxury living. This property raises the bar for sophistication and urban connectedness with its state-of-the-art architecture, smart living features, and unparalleled facilities.
Elire balances the energy of city life with tranquility, offering green landscaped areas for quiet retreats just steps away from the vibrant heart of the city.

projects.name: Eywa The Tree of Life
description: EYWA The Tree of Life is not simply a residential address — it is a considered philosophy of living, brought to life through architecture, nature, and intention. Developed by R.Evolution, this boutique collection of 50 residences and 2 penthouses rises above Business Bay as one of Dubai's most distinctive and exclusive offerings.

Recognized among the Luxury Lifestyle Awards TOP 100 Luxury Residences of the World for 2025, and developed by a company honoured as "Luxury Boutique Developer of the Year" at the Pillars of Real Estate Awards 2025, EYWA carries a weight of credibility that goes beyond marketing language.

projects.name: Eywa Way of Water
description: Eywa Way of Water by R. Evolution introduces a distinctive approach to luxury living, where design, wellness, and sustainability come together in a seamless residential concept. Developed by a European team and designed by architect Zane Tetere-Sulce of OAD, the project reflects a refined vision focused on comfort, natural harmony, and long-term well-being.

The development features an exclusive collection of 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences with 3 to 5 bedrooms, and expansive 5-bedroom penthouses. Each home is carefully planned to maximize natural light, enhance privacy, and offer uninterrupted panoramic views.

projects.name: Clover Residences
description: Clover Residences is the latest residential landmark by R3R Luxe Development, rising in the thriving community of Wadi Al Safa 5, Dubailand. Designed for those who value thoughtful design, comfort, and a well-connected lifestyle, this development offers a curated selection of studio and one-bedroom apartments that blend modern aesthetics with everyday practicality.

Situated in Wadi Al Safa 5, Dubailand, Clover Residences occupies a address that has steadily gained recognition among homeowners and investors alike. Dubailand is one of the emirate's most ambitious mixed-use districts, encompassing residential communities, entertainment destinations, academic institutions, and commercial zones — all within a well-planned, accessible urban layout.

projects.name: Rabdan Gate
description: Rabdan Gate is an upscale 27-storey residential tower developed by Rabdan Developments, situated in Dubai’s vibrant Majan district. Set to redefine luxury living, the development presents a curated collection of 1,2 and 3-bedroom apartments designed with elegance, smart technology, and sustainability at their core.
