This project carries forward Samana's commitment to delivering homes that combine modern aesthetics with functional, day-to-day comfort.

The development reflects a clear vision: creating living spaces where residents feel genuinely at home rather than merely accommodated. With a focus on clean architecture, green surroundings, and a curated selection of amenities, Samana Greenfield 2 stands as a strong residential option in one of Dubai's fastest-growing communities.

projects.name: Samana Hills South
description: SAMANA Hills South sets a new benchmark for contemporary residential living in Dubai. This premium off-plan development by Samana Developers offers a seamless blend of comfort, style, and modern convenience.

Scheduled for completion in May 2028, the project features a curated collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. Each unit is thoughtfully designed to maximize natural light, space, and functionality, while delivering a resort-style lifestyle.

projects.name: Samana Hills South 2
description: Samana Hills South 2 rises gracefully in the heart of Dubai Industrial City, offering a premium sanctuary where modern design meets natural serenity. This mid-rise residential development by Samana Developers creates a harmonious retreat from the bustle of city life, designed to restore balance, inspire calm, and elevate everyday living.

The project features a collection of stylish studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully crafted to maximize space, light, and comfort. With prices starting from AED 880,000 and completion expected in September 2028, Samana Hills South 2 presents an exceptional opportunity to invest in one of Dubai's most promising residential communities.

projects.name: Samana Hills South Phase 3
description: Samana Hills South Phase 3 by Samana Developers offers a refined approach to modern urban living in Dubai Industrial City. Strategically located within the prestigious Dubai South master development, this six-story architectural gem blends contemporary design with functional elegance, providing residents with premium apartments that cater to families and professionals alike.

With completion scheduled for December 2028 and prices starting from AED 987,778, the development presents an attractive entry point into Dubai’s residential market while offering a serene environment in a rapidly growing district.

projects.name: Samana Hills South 4 and 5
description: Samana Hills South 4 & 5 is a contemporary residential development that brings a refined approach to urban living in one of Dubai's most actively developing districts. Offering a carefully curated selection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, this project is designed for those who value quality, comfort, and thoughtful design in equal measure.

The development draws on clean architectural lines, modern interiors, and a community-first approach to create a living environment that feels both aspirational and genuinely liveable. Whether you are a first-time buyer, a growing family, or a seasoned investor, Samana Hills South 4 & 5 presents a compelling proposition in Dubai's residential market.

projects.name: Samana Ibiza
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubailand, Samana Ibiza offers an extraordinary off-plan residential development by Samana Developers. This project provides an exclusive range of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments that embody the luxurious yet carefree spirit of the famed island, Ibiza.
This location not only promises an enriching lifestyle but also represents a smart investment opportunity with significant potential for capital appreciation.

projects.name: Samana Imperial Garden
description: Located in the heart of Dubai's Arjan district, Samana Imperial Garden offers a premium lifestyle that combines modern elegance with natural serenity. This 7-storey low-rise development by Samana Developers features thoughtfully designed residences ranging from studios to 2-bedroom apartments, perfectly suited for families, young professionals, and investors alike.

With starting prices from AED 994,444 and completion scheduled for December 2028, this development provides a rare opportunity to own a contemporary home in one of Dubai's most sought-after communities. Construction is underway, and bookings have already commenced, making it an ideal time to secure a residence in this exclusive address.

projects.name: Samana Lake Views
description: Samana Lake Views in Dubai Production City offers the pinnacle of luxury living with a selection of premium studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. Developed by the renowned Samana Developers, this project combines modern elegance, premium facilities, and unsurpassed convenience, making it a great investment opportunity or dream home for discerning buyers.
All units include private pools, modern interiors, and premium finishes, ensuring a comfortable and stylish living environment.

projects.name: Samana Lake Views Phase 2
description: Experience luxury living with the launch of Samana Lake Views 2 at Dubai Production City offering premium studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments with pool, developed by Samana Developers. Crafted with esteemed design and architecture, after the successful launch of the first phase, this development seamlessly blends modern elegance with unparalleled convenience.

The highlight is undoubtedly the private pools adorning each unit's balcony, providing residents with an exclusive retreat to unwind amidst the breathtaking backdrop of the Dubai skyline. Beyond its opulent residences, the development boasts an impressive array of amenities tailored to cater to every aspect of residents' lifestyles.

projects.name: Samana Manhattan Phase 2
description: As part of the dynamic landscape of Dubai, Samana Developers presents Samana Manhattan Phase 2 in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). This architectural masterpiece seamlessly blends form with function, offering a range of studios, 1 & 2 bedroom apartments, and a unique poolside living experience.

Strategically located for optimal access and convenience, Samana Manhattan 2 provides easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road. This ideal location ensures that families can enjoy nearby schools and nurseries, all within a short drive from home.

projects.name: Samana Ocean Crest
description: At the heart of Dubai Islands, Samana Ocean Crest delivers a refined beachfront address shaped by contemporary design and natural surroundings. Developed by Samana Developers, the project blends modern architecture with uninterrupted sea views, creating a setting where everyday life feels effortlessly relaxed.

The development offers stylish 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, with prices starting from AED 2,150,000. Every residence is carefully planned to capture open water views and expansive skies, while maintaining privacy and comfort. Completion is scheduled for December 2028, positioning the project as a long-term opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.

projects.name: Samana Ocean Pearl
description: Samana Ocean Pearl, developed by Samana Developers, is the latest premium project situated on the exclusive Dubai Islands. This development epitomizes luxury island living, blending intelligent design, contemporary elegance, and unparalleled comfort. Its prime location offers residents a lifestyle enriched by stunning views, first-class amenities, and personalized experiences tailored to discerning individuals.

While specific details about unit types, sizes, and prices are yet to be revealed, Samana Ocean Pearl will feature a broad range of housing options to accommodate various needs and preferences. All units are designed to offer unparalleled comfort and elegance.

projects.name: Samana Ocean Pearls Phase 2
description: Samana Developers is proud to present Samana Ocean Pearl 2, an exceptional residential development located in the heart of Dubai Islands. This upcoming project promises to offer an unparalleled living experience with a range of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, each designed to provide ample space and modern conveniences.

Samana Ocean Pearl 2 by Samana Developers is situated in the highly sought-after Dubai Islands, a location renowned for its breathtaking natural beauty and exceptional lifestyle offerings. This prime destination offers stunning waterfront views, expansive beaches, and crystal-clear waters, providing residents with a serene and picturesque living environment.

projects.name: Samana Park Meadows
description: Under construction in the bustling DubaiLand Residence Complex is Samana Developers' spectacular new residential property, Samana Park Meadows. Situated on RC C 007, this new development is expected to draw in investors and homeowners with its promise of comfort, modernity, and ease. Here's a professional analysis of what makes Samana Park Meadows such a great option for your next residence or investment.
Proximity to Major Highways: Easy access to main roads ensures quick commutes to key areas in Dubai.

projects.name: Samana Parkville
description: Samana Parkville is a premier residential development by Samana Developers, located in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC). Designed to redefine luxury living, the project features contemporary architecture, world-class amenities, and private swimming pools in select units, making it an exceptional lifestyle destination.

Samana Parkville blends luxury, innovation, and investment potential, making it an outstanding choice for modern living. With private pools, smart home features, and a prime location, it stands as a benchmark for upscale urban residences in Dubai.

projects.name: Samana Portside
description: Samana Portside is a residential development by Samana Developers located in Jebel Ali, one of Dubai’s emerging growth corridors. The project brings together modern residences, lifestyle-focused amenities, and strong connectivity to major destinations across the city. Designed to support contemporary living, Samana Portside offers a residential environment that combines convenience, comfort, and accessibility within a rapidly developing district.

Samana Portside introduces a modern residential concept tailored to the needs of homeowners and investors seeking a well-connected address in Dubai. The development features thoughtfully designed apartments with contemporary interiors and practical layouts that support everyday living. The project reflects Samana Developers’ approach to creating communities that emphasize comfort, functionality, and leisure-oriented living.

projects.name: Samana Portside 2
description: Samana Portside 2 is a residential apartment development by Samana, situated in the heart of Downtown Jebel Ali — one of Dubai's steadily evolving urban districts. The project brings a thoughtfully designed collection of apartments to a location that balances city connectivity with a sense of calm residential living.

Downtown Jebel Ali occupies a strategic position in the western corridor of Dubai, offering residents a quieter pace of life without stepping too far from the city's energy. The district has matured considerably over the years, developing the infrastructure, services, and community character that residents look for in a long-term home.

projects.name: Samana Residences
description: Samana Residences is a distinguished residential development that redefines modern urban living in one of Dubai's most coveted corridors. Developed by Samana, this project brings together thoughtful design, premium finishes, and a carefully curated selection of amenities to create a home that genuinely reflects the aspirations of contemporary residents.

Few addresses in Dubai carry the prestige and practical advantage of Sheikh Zayed Road. Serving as the city's primary artery, this iconic stretch connects the historic heart of Dubai with its most dynamic modern districts. Residents of Samana Residences enjoy the rare privilege of being positioned along this celebrated thoroughfare, where the energy of the city meets the comfort of a well-appointed home.

projects.name: Samana Resorts
description: Samana Resorts is a luxurious residential development located in Dubai Production City. Developed by the renowned Samana Developers, this 19-story project offers a blend of modern design, premium amenities, and a strategic location. With 603 thoughtfully designed units, Samana Resorts promises to provide an elevated living experience in one of Dubai’s rapidly developing areas.

Samana Resorts offers a unique opportunity to live in a luxurious, resort-style environment in Dubai’s growing Production City. The development stands out with its prime location, impressive amenities, and modern living spaces. It presents an excellent investment opportunity with its potential for capital appreciation and strong rental demand.

projects.name: Samana Resorts Phase 2
description: Samana Resorts Phase 2 is a luxury residential development by Samana Developers, set in Dubai Production City . This 20-storey tower offers a range of resort-inspired living spaces, from studios to 2-bedroom apartments, combining opulence with modern design.
Located in Dubai Production City (IMPZ), Samana Resorts Phase 2 ensures seamless connectivity while providing a peaceful retreat.

projects.name: Rome By Samana
description: Discover the epitome of modern luxury and comfort at Rome by Samana, a premier residential development located in the prestigious Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City) District 11. Developed by the esteemed Samana Developers, this project promises an opulent living experience with a blend of contemporary design and state-of-the-art amenities. Scheduled for completion in December 2027, Rome by Samana is set to redefine luxury living in Dubai.

Rome by Samana is not just a place to live; it's a lifestyle choice. With its strategic location, luxurious amenities, and diverse housing options, it offers something for everyone. Whether you are looking for a new home or a smart investment, this development presents a unique opportunity to enjoy the best of Dubai living.

projects.name: Samana Rome 3
description: Situated in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Samana Rome 3 exemplifies contemporary premium living. This boutique development by Samana Developers features 80 meticulously designed apartments spread across twin 5-storey towers.
Offering 1- and 2-bedroom layouts, each residence includes a rare luxury in Dubai – private pools that elevate everyday life into a resort-style lifestyle.

projects.name: Samana Scenic Golf Oasis
description: Samana Scenic Golf Oasis, a new project by Samana Developers, boasts an array of residential units set against the lush and expansive backdrop of the Dubai Sports City's golf course. This 17 floor residential development, aptly named for its scenic views, offers a selection of studios, one, and two bedroom apartments.

Located in the heart of Dubai Sports City, Samana Scenic Golf Oasis is within easy reach of some of Dubai's largest shopping malls, including City Center Me'aisem and Mall of the Emirates. These retail hubs house a diverse range of outlets, from fashion to electronics and supermarkets, in addition to multiplex cinemas and a variety of dining options.

projects.name: Samana Sky Views
description: Samana Sky Views is a premium residential development by Samana Developers in Dubai Production City. Featuring carefully designed studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments, prices start from AED 941,007. Each unit includes private pools and premium finishes, offering a refined urban lifestyle.
Set for completion in July 2028, the development combines comfort, style, and functionality in every detail, catering to residents seeking tranquility alongside urban connectivity.

projects.name: Samana South Haven
description: Samana South Haven is a thoughtfully designed residential development located within Dubai Industrial City, part of the broader Dubai South master community. Developed by Samana Developers — a name synonymous with resort-inspired living in Dubai — this project continues the brand's commitment to delivering premium residences with a lifestyle-first approach.

Following the remarkable sell-out success of Samana's previous South Haven phases, this latest addition is built to meet the growing demand for quality homes that go beyond the ordinary. Residents can expect private terrace pools as a signature offering, smart home integrations, and high-grade interior finishes — all within a low-rise setting designed to feel intimate yet contemporary.

projects.name: Samana South Haven 2
description: Samana South Haven 2 is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Samana Holding Ltd, rising seven storeys in the emerging community of Saih Shuaib 2, Dubai Industrial City. This project brings a fresh approach to urban living — one that prioritises comfort, functionality, and aesthetic quality without compromise.

Dubai Industrial City has steadily transformed from a manufacturing hub into a well-rounded urban district with growing residential appeal. Saih Shuaib 2 sits within this evolving landscape, offering residents the rare combination of open space, lower density living, and easy access to the wider city.

projects.name: Renascent Tower
description: Renascent Tower is a refined residential development by Samara Development, rising confidently in the vibrant community of Majan, Wadi Al Safa 3, Dubai. Comprising 52 carefully designed apartments, this project reflects a clear vision: to offer contemporary urban living within a calm, well-planned neighborhood.

Majan is one of Dubai's quietly impressive residential communities, situated within Wadi Al Safa 3 along the Mohammed Bin Zayed Road corridor. What makes this location particularly appealing is its dual character — it carries the calm of a suburban setting while remaining firmly embedded in the wider urban fabric of Dubai.

projects.name: Lume Residence
description: Lume Residence is a premier residential development by S&S Development, located in the vibrant community of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. Designed to offer a refined lifestyle, the project combines contemporary architecture with elegant interiors and state-of-the-art amenities. With a focus on luxury and comfort, Lume Residence provides residents with a sophisticated urban living experience in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.
All units are designed with modern kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and premium-quality finishes, ensuring a sophisticated living experience.

projects.name: One Sankari
description: One Sankari, a premium property development by Sankari Properties, is the latest addition to the luxurious residential landscape in Marasi Marina, Business Bay. Promising a fusion of sophistication, convenience, and extraordinary living, it is the perfect dwelling for those who prefer an elite lifestyle with close proximity to iconic Dubai landmarks.

One Sankari enjoys a prime location in the vibrant district of Marasi Marina, Business Bay. Remarkably, it is just a 10 minute drive to Downtown Dubai, with Dubai Marina and Dubai International Airport about 15 minutes away. Renowned points of interest including Dubai Mall, the Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Opera, City Walk, and The Track Meydan Golf can be reached within a 10 minute drive.

projects.name: Regent Residences
description: Regent Residences Dubai, Sankari Place introduces an extraordinary chapter in luxury living, setting a global benchmark as the first-ever residential project under the prestigious Regent brand. Developed by Sankari Properties and nestled in the heart of Business Bay, this iconic twin-tower development redefines the essence of opulence and innovation in Dubai's real estate market.

Strategically located in the vibrant Business Bay district, Regent Residences Dubai ensures seamless access to Dubai’s most important commercial and leisure destinations. This central positioning places residents at the crossroads of convenience and serenity, where world-class attractions, financial hubs, and waterfront views converge. Living here means residing in a peaceful retreat within walking distance of the city’s energetic pulse.

projects.name: Sunlight Homes
description: Sunlight Homes offers a perfect blend of contemporary design and accessible premium living in Dubai's International City. This G+8 storey development, including a convenient basement level, sets a new benchmark for mid-rise residential living.

Designed with families, professionals, and investors in mind, Sunlight Homes features 3 to 4-bedroom duplex apartments. Each unit is thoughtfully planned to maximize natural light, ventilation, and spatial flow, creating homes that feel both inviting and refined.

projects.name: The Willows Residences
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai's prestigious Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), The Willows Residences is a luxury residential development by SCC Vertex Development. This exclusive project blends modern design with serenity, offering residents a tranquil retreat while being connected to the vibrant city life of Dubai.

The Willows Residences stands as a testament to sophisticated urban living in Dubai. With its limited collection of 54 premium apartments, exceptional design, prime location, and holistic living experience, this project offers exclusivity, comfort, and unmatched luxury. Whether for investment or as a home, The Willows Residences promises a lifestyle of elegance and long-term value.

projects.name: At 85 Residences
description: At 85 Residences stands as a testament to sophisticated living in the heart of Dubai's prestigious Wasl Gate district. Developed by the renowned Scope Properties, this exceptional residential community redefines the concept of luxury family living by seamlessly blending elegant design, generous layouts, and world-class amenities.

This thoughtfully planned development offers a diverse portfolio of living options, featuring meticulously designed studio, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive townhouses. Each residence is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring that every home serves as a sanctuary where families can grow, thrive, and create lasting memories.

projects.name: Olivia Gardens Residence
description: Olivia Gardens Residence by Segrex Development LLC sets a bold new benchmark for elegant urban living in Dubai. Located in the vibrant district of Jumeirah Garden City, Al Satwa, this five-storey boutique residential complex offers an artful fusion of modern architecture and tranquil surroundings.
Strategically located in Jumeirah Garden City, Olivia Gardens Residence offers unmatched convenience, connectivity, and cultural vibrancy.

projects.name: Artistry One Residences
description: Rising majestically in the heart of Dubai Design District, Artistry One Residences stands as a testament to architectural excellence and refined urban living. This sculptural residential tower, developed by the renowned Select Group, represents a harmonious fusion of creativity, balance, and sophisticated design.

The tower's distinctive architecture seamlessly integrates panoramic city views as an integral part of daily life, offering residents uninterrupted vistas of Dubai's iconic skyline, pristine waterfront, and landmark destinations. With completion scheduled for February 2029, this exceptional development promises to redefine luxury living standards in one of Dubai's most dynamic creative neighborhoods.

projects.name: Artistry Phase 2
description: Artistry Phase 2 stands as a testament to thoughtful residential design in the heart of Dubai's most creative neighborhood. This impressive 38-storey residential tower, developed by the renowned Select Group, represents a sophisticated approach to urban living that prioritizes functionality, aesthetic appeal, and genuine livability over flashy gimmicks.

The building's design philosophy centers on creating spaces that residents will actually use and enjoy, rather than merely admire. Every element has been carefully considered to support real daily routines, from morning fitness sessions to evening relaxation, ensuring that Artistry Phase 2 becomes not just a place to live, but a foundation for a well-balanced lifestyle.

projects.name: Nautica By Select Group
description: Imagine waking up to the rhythmic sound of waves, with the azure ocean as your backyard, and luxury at every corner of your home. That's the life Nautica by Select Group offers in the heart of Dubai Maritime City.

Located in thriving Dubai Maritime City, Nautica Apartments offer a world class living experience. The residents will enjoy easy connectivity to all major roads and proximity to various attractions and amenities of the city.

projects.name: Nautica Phase 2 Select Group
description: Nautica Phase 2 by Select Group is the latest high-rise marvel gracing the vibrant Dubai Maritime City. This stunning development offers luxurious 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, making it one of the most sought-after destinations for both tourists and residents. Nestled along the coast, Nautica Phase 2 provides breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the bustling cityscape, promising a perfect blend of nature's serenity and urban conveniences.

Select Group's Nautica Phase 2 will revolutionize opulent living in Dubai Maritime City. It offers to provide a lifestyle that combines comfort, convenience, and elegance with its excellent location, creative design, and extensive array of amenities. Nautica Phase 2 is the ideal option whether you're searching for a calm seaside residence or an energetic neighborhood with seamless connectivity. Discover the height of opulence at Nautica Phase 2 .

projects.name: Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina
description: The Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina offers a distinctive combination of well-being and luxury. This 122-story tower, developed by Select Group, sits in the heart of Dubai Marina and provides a premium living environment comprising apartments and duplexes. Part of the Six Senses Dubai portfolio under IHG Hotels & Resorts, the development delivers exceptional quality, design, and lifestyle standards.

Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina by Select Group offers more than a home; it presents a carefully curated lifestyle. The combination of a central Dubai Marina address, extensive wellness amenities, and spacious apartments or duplexes creates a living environment designed for comfort and convenience. Each residence benefits from waterfront views, integrated community services, and direct access to Dubai’s key business and leisure districts.

projects.name: Avida Residences
description: Avida Residences brings a fresh perspective to modern coastal living, blending wellness-focused design with refined comfort. Set within the prestigious Dubai Islands and developed by Serene Marina Real Estate Developments, the project introduces a lifestyle shaped around balance, clarity, and mindful living.

With completion scheduled for December 2027 and prices starting from AED 1,790,000, Avida Residences offers an appealing entry into one of Dubai’s most exclusive waterfront communities. Each home — from one, two, and three-bedroom apartments to its signature penthouses — is crafted to maximize natural light and create calm, flowing interiors that support everyday well-being.

projects.name: Mayfair Vista
description: Seven Mayfair Real Estate Development created the exclusive residential complex known as Mayfair Vista, which is tucked away in Dubai's quickly expanding Wadi Al Safa 7 neighborhood. Tony Ashai created nine architecturally sophisticated buildings that blend classic elegance with contemporary efficiency in this boutique-style, low-rise community.

Mayfair Vista, which is situated in the burgeoning Wadi Al Safa 7 area, enjoys great access to key thoroughfares including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Dubai Marina are all easily accessible to residents.. The area is known for its peaceful environment, robust infrastructure, and a growing community, offering an ideal balance between city life and calm suburban living.

projects.name: Courtyard
description: Courtyard is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Seven Mayfair Real Estate Development, forming part of the broader Mayfair Nexus master community within Dubai Lifestyle City. With a clean architectural language that balances contemporary form with everyday function, Courtyard introduces a living experience where aesthetics and comfort coexist naturally.

Offering a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, the project is built for those who value considered design, community connection, and urban convenience. Each residence reflects a commitment to quality — from the finishes to the floor plans — making Courtyard a compelling choice for both end-users and investors looking to plant roots in one of Dubai's most evolving districts.

projects.name: Horizon
description: Horizon at Mayfair Nexus is a distinguished residential development by Seven Mayfair Real Estate Development, thoughtfully positioned within the vibrant Dubai Lifestyle City in Dubai Land. Designed for those who value both aesthetic refinement and day-to-day comfort, Horizon presents a curated collection of apartments that bring together sleek architecture, premium finishes, and a sense of place that genuinely feels like home.

Whether you are a first-time homebuyer, a growing family, or a seasoned investor looking for meaningful returns, Horizon offers a living experience that adapts to your ambitions. Every detail — from the building's façade to the interiors — reflects a commitment to quality that goes beyond the ordinary.

projects.name: Pavillion
description: Pavillion is a carefully conceived residential development by Seven Mayfair Real Estate Development, rising as a distinguished address within Dubai Lifestyle City in Dubailand. From the moment you encounter the project, it communicates something beyond mere construction — it speaks of deliberate design, considered living, and a clear understanding of what modern residents truly need.

The architecture draws from a vocabulary of clean geometry, premium materials, and thoughtful spatial planning. Inside, the residences carry this same logic — generous proportions, quality finishes, and layouts that invite natural light while offering a sense of privacy that feels rare in a city as dynamic as Dubai.

projects.name: Springs
description: Springs is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Seven Mayfair Real Estate Development, offering a refined collection of apartments within the vibrant community of Dubai Lifestyle City, Dubailand. With architecture that prioritizes both comfort and contemporary elegance, Springs presents a compelling opportunity for residents and investors seeking quality living in one of Dubai's most dynamic growth corridors.

Positioned within Dubai Lifestyle City — a master-planned district inside Dubailand — Springs enjoys a strategic address that combines a tranquil residential atmosphere with seamless access to the wider emirate. Dubai Lifestyle City is designed around the concept of integrated living, bringing together retail, leisure, and community amenities within a single, cohesive environment.

projects.name: Golf Views Seven City JLT
description: Golf Views Seven City, an elegant residential project by Seven Tides, offers a sophisticated lifestyle in the heart of the city. With fully furnished apartments, state-of-the-art amenities, and an excellent location, it’s designed to give residents a unique blend of urban convenience and luxury. Here’s an overview of what makes this development truly stand out.

Located amidst various leisure, entertainment, and recreational facilities, Golf Views Seven City ensures all essential conveniences are close at hand. The ideal location, combined with the development’s premium features, creates a compelling living experience.

projects.name: Blue Marina Residence
description: Situated on the pristine Dubai Islands, Blue Marina Residence redefines waterfront living with a seamless blend of contemporary design, premium amenities, and breathtaking marina views. This exceptional 11-storey development by Shakirov Developments offers a lifestyle that combines serenity with sophistication, perfectly capturing the essence of Dubai's evolving luxury market.

The project features thoughtfully designed 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and duplexes, each crafted to maximize natural light and showcase panoramic views of the marina and surrounding landscapes. Starting from AED 1,750,000, these residences provide outstanding value in Dubai’s premium waterfront market, with completion scheduled for September 2028.

projects.name: Baccarat Hotel & Residences Phase 2 By Shamal
description: Baccarat Hotel & Residences II offers an unparalleled living experience in the heart of Downtown Dubai. With its prime location, world-class amenities, and luxurious services, this development presents a unique opportunity to enjoy a sophisticated lifestyle surrounded by iconic landmarks such as the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountain.

projects.name: Cheval Blanc Maison
description: Cheval Blanc Maison Dubai is a landmark residential development by Shamal Holding, rising as part of the exclusive Naia Island community in Umm Suqeim, Dubai. Drawing on the heritage of one of the world's most celebrated luxury hospitality brands, this rare collection of beachfront villas brings together the intimacy of private residential living and the elevated service standards associated with the Cheval Blanc name.

With only 70 residences in total — including a select offering of four- and five-bedroom villas — Cheval Blanc Maison is deliberately limited in scale to protect privacy and exclusivity. Each home is thoughtfully designed to feel both grand and personal, delivering a lifestyle that is quietly extraordinary rather than loudly opulent.

projects.name: Naia Island
description: Naia Island is a distinctive residential development by Shamal Holding, rising along the coveted shores of Umm Suqeim in Dubai. Conceived as a private island community, this project reimagines what modern waterfront living truly means — blending thoughtful design, direct beach access, and a curated selection of residences that balance personal comfort with refined sophistication.

Far from the noise of the city yet within reach of everything that matters, Naia Island is a place where residents come home to calm waters, open skies, and a community that values both privacy and connection. Whether you're seeking a primary residence, a seasonal retreat, or a high-yield investment, Naia Island presents an opportunity that is rare in today's Dubai real estate landscape.

projects.name: The Dubai Beach EDITION
description: The Dubai Beach EDITION Residences & Hotel brings a fresh approach to premium coastal living in Dubai Harbour. At the heart of this landmark address is a seamless blend of EDITION’s signature hospitality with the comfort of private beachfront homes, creating a lifestyle shaped by attentive service, refined design, and unforgettable views.
With striking modern architecture and a prime stretch of shoreline, the development offers a calm escape where home feels like a five-star retreat—without sacrificing privacy or exclusivity.

projects.name: Marea Residence
description: Marea Residence brings a fresh perspective to waterfront living on Dubai Islands, offering a premium coastal lifestyle shaped by modern architecture and serene natural surroundings. Designed for those who appreciate comfort, elegance, and peaceful sea views, the development creates a refined environment where every detail supports a relaxed island rhythm.

The property features a curated selection of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and penthouses, each planned with attention to space, light, and livability. With prices starting from AED 2.6 million and completion scheduled for June 2027, Marea Residence stands out as a promising opportunity within one of Dubai’s most anticipated coastal communities.

projects.name: Enclave Greens
description: Enclave Greens is a thoughtfully conceived residential development by Shriya Properties, offering a compelling blend of modern architecture, community-centered living, and everyday comfort in one of Dubai's most promising growth corridors. Set within the vibrant Majan district of Dubailand, this mid-rise development is designed for those who value a calm, green environment without giving up easy access to the city's key destinations.

The project brings together premium residential units in a landscaped setting that prioritizes natural light, open spaces, and a sense of belonging. Whether you are a young professional, a growing family, or a discerning investor, Enclave Greens presents a lifestyle proposition that is both aspirational and genuinely attainable.

projects.name: Signature Lifestyle Residences
description: Signature Lifestyle Residences is an architectural masterpiece in Jumeirah Lake Towers, developed by Signature Developers Ltd. This mixed-use development redefines luxury living with innovative design, premium comfort, and unparalleled elegance. With 187 meticulously designed units, it offers a sophisticated and tranquil lifestyle in the heart of Dubai.
All units include floor-to-ceiling windows, gourmet kitchens, smart home automation, and energy-efficient features.

projects.name: W Residences at JLT By Signature
description: The W Residences at JLT By Signature establishes a new standard for luxury living in Dubai. Signature Developers Ltd created this project in partnership with Marriott International, promising a unique blend of high-end resort-style living and modern refinement. Residents in Jumeirah Lakes Towers benefit from both urban convenience and peaceful surroundings.

Nestled in the affluent JLT sector, W Residences at JLT By Signature puts its occupants at the center of Dubai's bustling lifestyle. This region is well-known for its stunning waterfront environment, which includes serene lakes and lush green spaces that provide a haven of peace within the bustling city. The strategic position guarantees easy access to major attractions such as Downtown Dubai, the Burj Khalifa, and the Mall of the Emirates.

projects.name: Myra Residences
description: It is designed to cater to those who seek contemporary aesthetics, smart technologies, and functional urban layouts. Dubailand, a landmark project by the renowned Dubai Properties, is known for its diverse offerings, which include thrilling amusement parks, large shopping malls, tranquil eco-tourism initiatives, and thriving residential communities.

Time 3's strategic location in the heart of Dubailand provides unparalleled access to a wide range of amenities and services. This great location means that residents and tourists can enjoy the best that Dubai has to offer without having to travel far. Everything is close by, including world-class cuisine, top-tier educational institutions, and cutting-edge healthcare services.

projects.name: The Bay Interiors by Missoni
description: The Bay Interiors by Missoni is an exclusive waterfront residential development in Dubai Islands by World Group, created in collaboration with the renowned Italian fashion house Missoni. The project brings together contemporary architecture, artistic interiors, and a refined coastal lifestyle, offering residents a distinctive living experience inspired by modern design and hospitality.

Designed with a focus on elegance, comfort, and attention to detail, The Bay Interiors by Missoni combines stylish residences with thoughtfully planned amenities. The development reflects Missoni's signature approach to colors, patterns, and textures, creating homes that feel unique while maintaining practical functionality for everyday living.

projects.name: Tomorrow 166
description: Tomorrow 166 sets a new standard for luxury island living in Dubai. Nestled within the vibrant Dubai Islands development, this iconic project by Tomorrow World Group offers a harmonious blend of modern design, world-class amenities, and a tranquil lifestyle.

Tomorrow 166 is more than a residence; it’s a lifestyle. With its prime location, cutting-edge design, and unmatched amenities, it offers an exceptional living experience. Perfect for homeowners and investors alike, Tomorrow 166 redefines the art of luxury island living in Dubai.

projects.name: Tomorrow Gem Harbor
description: Tomorrow Gem Harbor by Tomorrow World Group is a boutique residential development set in the prestigious Dubai Islands. Designed as a low-density G+2P+10-floor building, the project offers 77 exclusive apartments alongside six retail units, combining privacy, comfort, and long-term investment value.

Tomorrow Gem Harbor is strategically located on Plot 225 within the Dubai Islands, a dynamic waterfront destination poised to define the future of coastal living in the city. The islands are envisioned as a mixed-use district, featuring residential areas, leisure facilities, and retail destinations, all set against serene water views. Residents of Gem Harbor enjoy a calm and exclusive setting while remaining connected to Dubai’s urban core.

projects.name: 11 Hills Park
description: 11 Hills Park, an exceptional new residential development brought to you by TownX Developments. Nestled in the heart of Dubai Science Park, this exclusive project promises a sophisticated and luxurious living experience. Whether you're seeking a chic studio or a stylish one-bedroom apartment, 11 Park Hills offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and elegant style.
11 Hills Park offers a variety of housing options to suit different needs and preferences. Studio and 1-bedroom apatments with expansive layout, high-end finishes ,and modern fittings.

projects.name: Ashley Hills
description: Ashley Hills is a boutique residential development located in the lively Arjan district, within the prestigious Art Gardens community. This project offers residents and investors an exceptional opportunity to enjoy contemporary urban living combined with smart investment potential in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing areas.

The development consists of two thoughtfully designed residential blocks – Block A (North) and Block B (South) – rising across B+G+6+Roof levels. With 616 apartments ranging from studios to 3-bedroom units, Ashley Hills accommodates diverse lifestyle preferences while emphasizing comfort, quality, and modern design.

projects.name: Blossom 40
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai's prestigious Majan district within Dubailand, Blossom 40 represents the epitome of contemporary luxury living. This exceptional boutique residential development by Tranquil Infra Developers offers an exclusive collection of 66 meticulously designed apartments, creating an intimate community that perfectly balances modern sophistication with serene residential charm.

The development's carefully curated unit mix features 30 elegant one-bedroom and 36 spacious two-bedroom residences, each designed to cater to the evolving needs of modern urban professionals, young families, and discerning investors. With its strategic positioning and boutique scale, Blossom 40 offers residents an exclusive lifestyle experience that larger developments simply cannot match.

projects.name: Blossom76
description: When designing Blossom76, no expense was spared in creating a building that was exceptional, both inside and out. Rising majestically amidst the city skyline, this architectural masterpiece boasts a regal stature of Ground (Retail) + 4P + 16 + RF, adorned with 111 exclusive residences. From exquisite studios to palatial 2-bedroom suites featuring private plunge pools, each dwelling is a testament to unrivalled grandeur.

Finished with high-quality claddings and glass, the innovative design simply exudes class. Most of the apartments enjoy excellent views of the community and surroundings through large-picture windows.

projects.name: Future Avenue Tower
description: True Future Real Estate Development presents Future Avenue Tower, an off-plan 17 storey development at Meydan Horizon offering luxury apartments with high-end specifications. The orientation of this tower is planned in a way to let maximum daylight fill every unit with natural light and fresh air, while the glass facade keeps the tower cool during hot summer days.

Future Avenue Tower by True Future Developer at Meydan Horizon, Dubai offers luxurious apartments at very reasonable prices. The property features contemporary design and high-end facilities together with its potential for future growth and establishes suitable pricing which will attract both residents and intelligent investors who seek financial returns from their assets.

projects.name: Future Residence
description: Future Residence at Meydan Horizon brings a fresh, contemporary vision to Dubai’s residential scene, crafted by True Future Real Estate for those who want a premium lifestyle paired with everyday practicality. The development blends clean architectural lines with intuitive layouts, creating homes that feel inviting from the moment you step inside.

Offering a curated mix of 1-bedroom apartments, 1-bedroom layouts with a private pool, and generous 2.5-bedroom residences, each home is finished with high-quality materials and cutting-edge smart features. Prices begin at AED 1,350,000, with handover set for October 2027.

projects.name: High Best Tower
description: High Best Tower is a premium residential project in Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), developed by True Future. This luxurious development consists of two five-story buildings featuring 2 and 3-bedroom apartments with smart home technology and high-end finishes, offering residents a modern urban lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most prestigious locations.

High Best Tower offers sophisticated urban living in a prime Dubai location, combining luxury, convenience, and investment potential. With top-tier amenities and seamless connectivity, it’s an ideal choice for homeowners and investors alike.

projects.name: Auria Gardens
description: Nestled in Dubai's pulsating Arjan, the shimmering Auria Gardens beams with the latest in luxury and good taste. The newest masterpiece from the renowned Tuscany Real Estate Development will raise the bar on city living to a completely new level. Thanks to the striking architectural design, resort-style amenities, and well-planned living space, Auria Gardens is ready to turn itself into the latest hallmark of the sumptuous urban lifestyle.
Auria Gardens' selected location, Arjan, is one of the most dynamic and popular hotspots in Dubai. Arjan has a perfect setting that merges modern city convenience with serene life.

projects.name: Ayana Gardens
description: In the center of Dubai, Ayana Gardens, developed by Tuscany Real Estate Development, represents the height of opulence.

This exquisite residential development offers a range of studio, 1, and 2 bedroom apartments with premium finishing and fixtures. The five story building stands as a beacon of opulence, promising residents a sophisticated lifestyle amidst meticulously crafted interiors and state of the art

projects.name: Mirdad
description: Nestled in the lively core of Dubai Motor City, Mirdad offers a premium residential experience designed for comfort, convenience, and community. Developed by Union Properties P.J.S.C, this exceptional project lives up to its name – “where the heart belongs.” Mirdad is more than a residence; it’s a thoughtfully planned community where modern sophistication meets everyday comfort.

The development features four distinctive towers, with Tower 1 as the flagship launch. Rising to G+19 stories, it offers a diverse collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive loft units. Every home is crafted with premium finishes and contemporary interiors, designed to maximize functionality and space while reflecting Dubai’s commitment to refined living.

projects.name: Mirdad 2
description: Mirdad 2 by Union Properties represents a revolutionary approach to luxury residential living in Dubai, seamlessly blending sustainable design with contemporary urban sophistication. This exceptional development in Motor City's prestigious Mirdad district introduces a new paradigm of community-driven living, where modern luxury meets environmental consciousness.

Starting from AED 799,000, this thoughtfully designed community promises to deliver an unparalleled living experience by December 2028, with flexible installment options available for discerning investors and homeowners.

projects.name: Mirdad 3
description: Mirdad 3 represents the newest chapter in Motor City's residential evolution, brought to life by Union Properties. This carefully planned development introduces a collection of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments designed for modern Dubai living. The project balances intimate living spaces with generous communal zones, creating an environment that naturally encourages connection and active lifestyles.

Starting at AED 763,000, these residences offer an accessible entry point into one of Dubai's most distinctive themed communities. The development's design philosophy centers on fluidity and movement, with interiors that maximize functionality while maintaining an airy, open feel.

projects.name: Mirdad 4
description: Mirdad 4 represents the final chapter in Motor City's distinguished residential cluster, bringing a fresh collection of contemporary apartments to one of Dubai's most established family-oriented communities. Developed by Union Properties, this upcoming project introduces thoughtfully designed studio, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom residences that blend modern living with extensive recreational infrastructure.

The project focuses on creating environments where daily convenience meets recreation. Future residents will have access to an impressive range of shared facilities including dual gymnasiums, a full-scale sports complex, golf simulator, dedicated gaming zones, two spa facilities, and a collaborative coworking space.

projects.name: Takaya
description: Union Properties has unveiled Takaya, a new and interesting development in Dubai Motor City. This is a major project, as it is the company's first new development since 2015. Takaya's luxury services and cutting-edge amenities are ready to transform Dubai's urban lifestyle.

Takaya is located in Dubai Motor City, a busy and energetic neighborhood. This great location provides residents with a perfect blend of excitement and tranquility, as well as quick access to main attractions and necessities. The close proximity to vital places makes it an excellent alternative for both families and professionals.

projects.name: Takaya Kaia
description: Takaya Kaia offers an exclusive collection of Studio-5 bedroom apartments in Dubai Motor City, designed for families seeking a perfect blend of modern elegance and practical comfort. Developed by Union Properties P.J.S.C, this prestigious community combines refined architecture with functional living, creating a serene retreat amid the city’s dynamic energy.

Each villa showcases a striking façade and thoughtfully planned interiors, complemented by rooftop terraces featuring infinity pools, lounge pools, and expansive decks—ideal for relaxation and entertaining in a premium, private setting.

projects.name: Takaya Kalina
description: Takaya Kalina is the newest gem by Union Properties P.J.S.C., located in the bustling Motor City of Dubai. This high-rise tower redefines luxury urban living with its architectural elegance and premium living spaces. Offering a perfect blend of modern design and community-centric living, Takaya Kalina promises a lifestyle of comfort, convenience, and sophistication.

Takaya Kalina is more than a residential project; it’s a vision of luxurious urban living in one of Dubai’s most dynamic locations. Whether you are a discerning homeowner or an investor, Takaya Kalina offers an unmatched lifestyle and strong investment potential.

projects.name: Takaya Melody
description: Developed by Union Properties P.J.S.C, Takaya Melody offers a collection of 4-bedroom premium townhouses in Dubai's prestigious Motor City. Starting from AED 7,075,756, these homes combine modern architecture, lush landscaping, and thoughtfully integrated community features to create a sophisticated lifestyle for families who value space, privacy, and convenience.

The innovative podium-level design seamlessly links residents to nearby high-rise towers, bridging villa-style comfort with lively urban living. Completion is scheduled for December 2027, with flexible installment plans available for early investors.

projects.name: Saray Prime Residence
description: Situated within the rapidly growing Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), Saray Prime Residence offers a collection of thoughtfully designed apartments that combine contemporary style with peaceful living. This mid-rise development features studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each carefully crafted to provide a premium lifestyle for individuals and families seeking comfort, functionality, and elegance.

With generous layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and high-quality finishes, every home maximizes natural light while providing a serene retreat. Whether you’re a professional seeking a cozy studio or a family looking for a spacious apartment, each residence offers a tranquil environment amidst greenery and modern urban design.

projects.name: Saray South
description: Saray South is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Unique Saray Development, offering a refined living experience in the heart of Dubai South. Rising across a stylish G+4 structure, the project presents fully furnished studios and apartments that blend clean, contemporary aesthetics with practical, space-maximising layouts.

Whether you are a first-time buyer, a growing family, or a savvy investor seeking strong returns in one of Dubai's most rapidly expanding corridors, Saray South delivers a compelling proposition: premium quality, a desirable address, and a lifestyle shaped around comfort and convenience.

projects.name: Timber Terrace
description: Timber Terrace introduces a fresh chapter of refined residential living in the heart of Dubai South. Set within a growing and lively district, this boutique development by Vakson Group offers a thoughtfully curated collection of 77 apartments crafted for those who appreciate modern design, generous layouts, and a lifestyle rooted in convenience and community.

Featuring a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each home has been shaped to make the most of space, natural light, and everyday functionality. The result is a place where comfort feels effortless, and where every corner reflects careful architectural intention.

projects.name: Villa 55
description: Villa 55 is a 5-bedroom freehold luxury villa by Vakson First Property Development in Al Wasl, Jumeirah, Dubai.

This spacious 5-bedroom villa, located in the prestigious Al Wasl – Jumeirah area, represents the epitome of luxury living in the heart of Dubai. The built-up area totals 7,500 sq ft, while the plot spans 10,000 sq ft, providing a sense of privacy and freedom. The villa is fully furnished and equipped with German-brand appliances, underscoring a high standard of quality and attention to detail.

projects.name: Elevia Residences
description: Elevia Residences redefines modern urban living in the heart of Dubai's thriving International City. Developed by Valores Property Development, this innovative project features an 8-story residential tower designed to cater to the needs of Dubai’s cosmopolitan residents. The residences blend contemporary architecture with functional living spaces, offering an exceptional lifestyle in one of Dubai's most rapidly developing neighborhoods.

Located in Dubai International City Phase 3, Elevia Residences provides unbeatable connectivity to major parts of the city. Positioned strategically along MBZ Road (E311), residents enjoy quick access to key destinations across Dubai. Proximity to major highways, the Dubai Central Fruit & Vegetable Market, and easy connections to public transport make it an ideal place for both business and leisure.

projects.name: Elevia Residences Phase 2 by Valores
description: At the heart of Dubai International City 2, Elevia Residences Phase 2 by Valores Property Development builds on the strong momentum of its first phase, presenting a refined approach to modern residential design. Perfectly designed for urban lifestyles, the development features a carefully planned mix of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments within a calm suburban setting.

The project balances elegant architecture with solid construction, shaping a comfortable and contemporary lifestyle in one of Dubai’s steadily emerging residential districts. Every detail feels intentional, from the exterior presence to the internal layouts, creating homes that are practical, welcoming, and visually appealing.

projects.name: Elevia Residences Phase 3 by Valores
description: Elevia Residences Phase 3 in International City, Dubai, combines contemporary architecture with metropolitan convenience. Developed by Valores Property Development, this 8-storey residential project features thoughtfully designed studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, offering residents a premium lifestyle in a dynamic neighborhood.

The development maximizes natural light, functionality, and comfort. From young professionals to growing families, Elevia Residences Phase 3 caters to diverse lifestyle needs while maintaining high standards of design and quality.

projects.name: Aptos Residenza
description: Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Aptos Residenza is a luxury residential development by Vantage Properties, blending Italian-inspired elegance with contemporary design. This mid-rise architectural gem promises refined living with unparalleled sophistication.
Located in JVC, Aptos Residenza is within easy reach of key Dubai destinations, offering residents the tranquility of a suburban neighborhood with proximity to major city attractions.

projects.name: Livel Residenza
description: A Premier residential development crafted by Vantage Properties in collaboration with Vittoria Group. This stunning 20-floor building brings the charm and elegance of Italian-inspired living to the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), one of Dubai's most desirable neighborhoods.

Nestled in the vibrant community of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Livel Residenza offers a peaceful atmosphere with top-notch amenities, making it an ideal choice for professionals, families, and those seeking a balanced lifestyle. JVC's central location provides easy access to Dubai's key areas, blending convenience and tranquility.

projects.name: Crystal Tower
description: Crystal Tower by VHS stands as a testament to modern architectural excellence in the vibrant landscape of Dubai International City. This contemporary residential tower represents the perfect fusion of practical urban living and sophisticated design, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in one of Dubai's most dynamic neighborhoods.

The development showcases VHS Developments' commitment to creating residential spaces that prioritize both form and function, delivering a product that seamlessly integrates contemporary aesthetics with everyday practicality. Starting from AED 671,999, Crystal Tower presents an attractive entry point into Dubai's prestigious real estate market, making luxury living accessible without compromising on quality or location advantages.

projects.name: Vincitore Aqua Dimore
description: Experience a new realm of luxury living with Vincitore Aqua Dimore at Dubai Science Park, an exquisite project by Vincitore Real Estate with luxury studios, 1 & 2 bedroom apartments and 2 & 3 bedroom aqua villas with designer private pool. This development promises to be a grand new landmark on the horizon, offering a unique and opulent lifestyle in the heart of a vibrant city.

Situated in the prime address at Dubai Science Park (DSP), the development is a part of a thriving and buzzing community. It enjoys excellent connectivity to prominent business areas, shopping destinations, education, medical facilities and leisure avenues. For those seeking to elevate their lifestyle to new heights, it is a perfect address to call home.

projects.name: Vincitore Aqua Dimore Phase 2 By Vincitore
description: At the famous Vincitore Aqua Dimore Phase 2 project by Vincitore Development, experience an unmatched level of luxury. This upscale residential building is tucked away in the center of Dubai Science Park (DSP). With its magnificent choice of possibilities, which includes private pools, this property redefines life in luxury.

Vincitore Aqua Dimore Phase 2 is set to become a landmark in luxury living in Dubai Science Park. With its prime location, unique features, and comprehensive lifestyle amenities, it offers an unmatched living experience. Whether you're a young professional, a family, or a retiree, this development caters to all, providing a holistic and opulent lifestyle.

projects.name: Vincitore Aqua Flora
description: Nestled amidst Dubai's vibrant cityscape, Vincitore Aqua Flora is a visionary residential project by Vincitore Development. Set to redefine luxury living, this architectural marvel blends modern elegance with the tranquillity of nature. Designed to perfection, it promises an unparalleled living experience that exudes sophistication and style.

Properly situated in Dubai Science Park, Vincitore Aqua Flora provides its occupants with breathtaking views of the city skyline and the serene waterfront. Convenience and luxury are sought after, and this property's excellent location guarantees quick access to major commercial areas, retail malls, and cultural hotspots.

projects.name: Vincitore The House
description: Vincitore The House is a limited-edition residential collection that redefines what it means to live well in Dubai. Developed by Vincitore Real Estate, this exclusive address brings together meticulous design, intimate scale, and a carefully considered lifestyle offering that sets it apart from the broader market.

Arjan has steadily emerged as one of Dubai's most sought-after residential neighborhoods, and Vincitore The House occupies a particularly desirable position within it. Located adjacent to the Miracle Garden and Butterfly Garden, Arjan offers a rare blend of green surroundings and urban convenience that is difficult to find elsewhere in the city.

projects.name: Vincitore Wellness Estate
description: Vincitore Wellness Estate stands as a revolutionary concept in Dubai's luxury residential landscape, seamlessly blending sophisticated living with holistic wellness principles. Located in the prestigious Majan community within Dubai Land, this exceptional development by Vincitore Real Estate Development represents a paradigm shift in modern urban living.

This premium apartment complex introduces a unique approach to residential design, where every element has been carefully curated to promote healthy living and well-being. From the moment residents step into the development, they are enveloped in an atmosphere of tranquility and sophistication that sets the tone for a truly exceptional lifestyle experience.

projects.name: Lumina
description: Lumina is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Vision Developments, located in Liwan, Wadi Al Safa 2, within the larger DubaiLand community. The project brings together contemporary architecture, practical living spaces, and a well-rounded set of amenities — all in a neighbourhood that offers both everyday convenience and a genuine sense of calm.

Liwan sits within DubaiLand, one of the city's most established and growing residential zones. The area has developed steadily over the years into a community that works well for families, young professionals, and investors alike. Streets are wide, green spaces are accessible, and the overall atmosphere is one of a settled, functioning neighbourhood rather than an overcrowded urban centre.

projects.name: Reem by Vision
description: Reem by Vision, a premium development by Vision Development, is set to redefine luxury living in Liwan, Dubai’s rapidly growing district. The project promises unparalleled design, amenities, and community-focused living.
Reem by Vision offers a diverse range of apartments, including Studio, 1, 2 & 3 Bedroom. Spacious layouts feature high-quality finishes, panoramic views, and smart home technology.

projects.name: Sera Gardens
description: Sera Gardens by Vision Developments represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential living in Dubai Production City (IMPZ), offering a sophisticated blend of modern design, premium amenities, and strategic location advantages. This exceptional 8-floor residential development has been meticulously crafted to provide residents with an unparalleled living experience that seamlessly combines urban convenience with tranquil comfort.

Featuring a thoughtfully curated collection of apartments ranging from studios to spacious 3-bedroom units, including exclusive duplex options, Sera Gardens caters to diverse lifestyle needs while maintaining the highest standards of luxury and functionality. With direct views toward the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates, residents enjoy an open, scenic outlook that enhances the overall living experience.

projects.name: Soul by Vision
description: Located in the heart of Dubai Production City (IMPZ), Soul by Vision offers a unique blend of contemporary design, premium amenities, and a lifestyle that captures the dynamic spirit of Dubai. With completion expected in December 2026, this development features thoughtfully designed residences ranging from cozy studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments, each crafted to provide privacy, comfort, and a sense of community.

Every home at Soul by Vision is designed with attention to detail, balancing functional living spaces with natural light and elegant finishes. Residents can enjoy a harmonious environment that supports both relaxation and social interaction.

projects.name: Verde by Vision
description: At the heart of Dubai Sports City, Verde by Vision offers a perfect blend of modern design and strategic location. This contemporary residential development provides an exceptional lifestyle, with thoughtfully designed studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments starting from AED 602,000.

Set for handover in Q2 2027 and available with a flexible 20/80 payment plan, Verde by Vision delivers a rare opportunity for both homeowners and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most dynamic communities. Each unit is designed to maximize natural light, create a sense of spaciousness, and ensure every square foot contributes to a premium living environment.

projects.name: Vista by Vision
description: Vista by Vision stands as a testament to contemporary urban living, strategically positioned in the vibrant heart of Dubai Production City. This exceptional residential development by Vision Development represents the perfect fusion of modern sophistication and practical convenience, designed specifically for discerning residents who refuse to compromise on quality of life.

The development embodies a forward-thinking approach to residential design, where every element has been carefully considered to enhance the daily lives of its residents. From the moment you step into Vista by Vision, you're welcomed into a world where luxury isn't just an aspiration—it's a way of life.

projects.name: Arthouse Private Residences
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai's coveted Meydan district, Arthouse Private Residences by Viva Development represents the pinnacle of contemporary luxury living. This exceptional residential development redefines modern elegance through its carefully curated collection of 1, 1.5, and 2-bedroom apartments, each designed with meticulous attention to detail and a refined aesthetic sensibility.

More than just a residential complex, Arthouse Private Residences embodies a lifestyle philosophy that seamlessly blends sophistication with comfort, privacy with connectivity, and luxury with practicality. Every element of this distinguished development has been thoughtfully crafted to create homes that don't just shelter, but inspire and elevate the daily living experience.

projects.name: Cybele by Wadan
description: Nestled within the Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), Cybele by Wadan sits in a community that continues to gain attention for its balance of calm residential living and quick access to the city’s most important destinations.

Just across from the community park, the development enjoys open green views that bring a sense of quiet and comfort to everyday life. This park-facing advantage isn’t just visually appealing—it’s one of the features that consistently boosts property value and demand in Dubai.

projects.name: Nuvana By Wadan
description: Situated on the prestigious Dubai Islands, Nuvana by Wadan Developments sets a new benchmark for premium waterfront living. This exclusive community combines cutting-edge technology with serene coastal surroundings, creating a lifestyle that’s both modern and tranquil. With only 56 thoughtfully designed residences, Nuvana offers an intimate environment where privacy and comfort come together seamlessly.

Starting from AED 1,849,033, each residence features AI-powered smart-home systems, premium finishes, and fully furnished interiors. Scheduled for completion in September 2027, Nuvana reflects Dubai’s dedication to innovation, design excellence, and modern living.

projects.name: Seraph By Wadan
description: At the heart of Dubai Land, Seraph by Wadan stands as a beacon of contemporary premium living. Developed by WADAN Developments, this residential tower combines elegant design with exceptional comfort, offering studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments that redefine urban lifestyle.
Starting from AED 595,900, Seraph by Wadan presents a rare opportunity to invest in Dubai’s thriving real estate market while enjoying a move-in-ready, elevated lifestyle.

projects.name: Tresora by Wadan
description: Nestled in the heart of Dubai's thriving Jumeirah Village Circle, Tresora by Wadan represents the pinnacle of contemporary urban living. This exceptional mixed-use development seamlessly blends residential comfort with commercial convenience, creating a harmonious environment where modern lifestyle aspirations meet smart investment opportunities.

Starting from AED 670,000, Tresora offers an accessible entry point into Dubai's luxury property market while maintaining the high standards of quality and sophistication that discerning residents expect. The development's completion timeline, extending to 2028, allows investors to benefit from flexible payment plans and witness the continued growth of one of Dubai's most promising communities.

projects.name: Weston
description: Weston is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Wadan Developments, situated in the heart of Dubai Land Residence Complex — one of Dubai's most rapidly evolving urban communities. Offering fully furnished residences with refined interiors and high-quality finishes, Weston is crafted for those who value comfort, convenience, and contemporary living.

Dubai Land Residence Complex occupies a strategic position within one of Dubai's most ambitious mixed-use destinations. The area has matured significantly over recent years, transforming from an emerging district into a well-established residential and leisure hub that continues to attract families, young professionals, and international buyers.

projects.name: Weston Phase 2
description: Weston Phase 2 by Wadan Developments is a thoughtfully designed residential project that brings together contemporary living, green surroundings, and a well-connected address in one of Dubai's most promising communities. Offering a curated selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, this development is built for those who value both comfort and a well-rounded lifestyle.

Positioned within the Dubai Land Residence Complex, Weston Phase 2 occupies a strategic spot in one of the emirate's fastest-growing residential corridors. Dubai Land has steadily evolved from a development project into a fully functioning community, with everyday conveniences, green open spaces, and a growing network of schools, retail outlets, and healthcare facilities all within easy reach.

projects.name: Ashwood Estates
description: Perched within the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates, Ashwood Estates offers a premium residential lifestyle in Dubai. This exclusive collection features 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas, each designed to blend architectural elegance with functional comfort.

Every home celebrates space, light, and natural materials, creating interiors that flow seamlessly into the outdoors. Warm-toned finishes and textured surfaces ensure each villa feels both sophisticated and inviting. With prices starting from AED 11.8 million and completion expected in 2029, Ashwood Estates presents a rare opportunity to live amid Dubai’s most coveted golf course community.

projects.name: Avenue Park Towers
description: Welcome to Avenue Park Towers, an exciting new residential development by Wasl Properties in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Wasl 1 community. This stunning project is set to redefine urban living, offering residents a blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Avenue Park Towers is the perfect choice for both families and individuals seeking a refined lifestyle in one of Dubai's most sought-after locations.

Avenue Park Towers is ideally situated in the bustling Wasl 1 community, a strategic location that provides easy access to various parts of Dubai. This area is known for its vibrant atmosphere and proximity to key city attractions, making it an attractive choice for those looking to enjoy the best of Dubai.

projects.name: Avenue Park Towers 2
description: Avenue Park Towers 2 is a striking dual-tower residential development by Wasl Properties, rising confidently in the heart of Wasl 1, one of Dubai's most thoughtfully planned urban communities. Designed for those who want more than just a place to sleep, this development brings together refined apartment living, curated retail experiences, and a genuine sense of neighborhood — all within a single, well-connected address.

The towers are built around a simple but powerful idea: that everyday life should feel good. From the quality of finishes in each apartment to the community spaces shared between residents, every element of Avenue Park Towers 2 reflects a commitment to comfort, practicality, and long-term livability. Whether you are a working professional, a growing family, or a savvy investor, this development offers a compelling case for calling Bur Dubai home.

projects.name: Boulevard Living 1
description: Boulevard Living 1 is a contemporary residential development by Wasl Properties, thoughtfully positioned within the vibrant Wasl Gate community in Dubai. Designed to meet the evolving demands of modern city living, this project brings together refined architecture, functional interiors, and a well-curated set of amenities to create a home environment that truly supports daily life.

The development reflects a clear vision: to offer residents a place where quality of life is not a luxury reserved for a few, but a standard built into every detail. From its spatial planning to its community layout, Boulevard Living 1 is conceived for those who value comfort, convenience, and a genuine sense of belonging in one of Dubai's most dynamic districts.

projects.name: Boulevard Living 2
description: Boulevard Living 2 is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Wasl Properties, located in the dynamic Wasl Gate community in Jebel Ali First, Dubai. Conceived for those who value contemporary living in a well-connected, vibrant urban setting, this project brings together modern architecture, practical layouts, and a curated selection of community amenities.

Wasl Gate is one of Dubai's most ambitious mixed-use communities, and Boulevard Living 2 sits at its heart. The Wasl Gate precinct is designed as a self-contained urban village, incorporating residential towers, retail outlets, dining options, and open green spaces within a single, thoughtfully planned district.

projects.name: Boulevard Park
description: Boulevard Park at Wasl Gate by Wasl Properties combines the energy of Dubai’s city life with the calm of lush green spaces, creating a premium urban sanctuary. This thoughtfully designed community blends modern architectural elegance with expansive landscaped areas, offering residents a serene retreat without compromising on convenience.

The development features six contemporary buildings across two interconnected plots, comprising 1,248 residential units. From cozy studios to spacious 4-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and townhouses, Boulevard Park caters to diverse lifestyle needs, offering a harmonious balance between city living and natural tranquility.

projects.name: Boulevard Park 2
description: Boulevard Park 2 is the latest residential chapter in the ever-evolving Wasl Gate community, brought to life by one of Dubai's most trusted property developers, Wasl Properties.
